concepts.title: ΔR2*

concepts.definition: 约30-100Hz的高频神经振荡活动。在TCD理论框架中，当丘脑输入丧失或门控活动异常导致thalamo-cortical column频率减慢至theta/delta波段时，侧向抑制失效，gamma频段活动出现在较慢活动区域周围。Gamma band与positive symptoms（如幻听、幻痛）相关，与theta相关的negative symptoms形成对照。

concepts.label: 淀粉样斑块
concepts.title: 淀粉样斑块
concepts.definition: 细胞外淀粉样蛋白沉积物，主要由淀粉样β蛋白（Aβ）组成，主要存在于人类及其他灵长类动物大脑的灰质中。斑块可伴有退行性神经元成分以及大量小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞。少量斑块可随衰老自然出现，但大量斑块与神经原纤维缠结是阿尔茨海默病的特征性病理表现。斑块形状和大小高度可变，平均面积约400–450平方微米，最小斑块（<200平方微米）常由弥散性Aβ沉积构成。Aβ错误折叠并聚集成寡聚体及更长聚合物后形成斑块。

concepts.label: 海马体积
concepts.title: 海马体积
concepts.definition: 海马体积指海马这一脑结构的大小。海马与记忆形成和空间导航密切相关。在认知心理学中，它被用作可测量的脑特征，用以解释不同个体间或随时间变化的记忆差异。慢性应激、抑郁和老化常与海马体积减小相关，而规律有氧运动和认知训练可能支持海马健康。该指标通常通过MRI影像的体积分割技术测量。

concepts.label: 血组织分配系数
concepts.title: 血组织分配系数
concepts.definition: 血组织分配系数（lambda），定义为毛细血管血液水含量与灌注组织水含量的比值，用于将T1弛豫测量转换为绝对心肌灌注量。在心肌组织中近似值为0.9 ml/g。该系数是双室模型中计算绝对灌注P（ml/g/min）的关键参数，公式为 P = lambda/T1(blood) × ([T1(global)/T1(selective)] - 1)。

concepts.label: central lateral thalamotomy
concepts.title: central lateral thalamotomy
concepts.definition: 一种神经外科手术方法，通过毁损丘脑中央外侧核治疗丘脑皮层节律失常(TCD)，因具有侵入性仅用于对常规治疗耐药的患者。

concepts.label: 脑血流量
concepts.title: 脑血流量

concepts.label: SIMPLE（尺度无关的记忆、知觉与学习模型）
concepts.title: SIMPLE（尺度无关的记忆、知觉与学习模型）
concepts.definition: 一种局部相对显著性模型（local relative distinctiveness model），用于解释记忆任务表现。核心主张：干扰任务将项目在时间中拉开间距，记忆表现取决于目标项目在回忆时刻的相对显著性（relative distinctiveness）。该模型已被拟合到Brown-Peterson任务、操作广度任务和持续干扰任务等多种任务，认为这些任务可归因于同一机制而非不同记忆系统。
aliases: Scale Independent Memory, Perception, and Learning

concepts.label: slice-selective preparation
concepts.title: slice-selective preparation
concepts.definition: 层面选择性准备：一种自旋准备技术，仅对特定成像层面（slice-selective）施加饱和脉冲。由于未饱和的质子自旋流入该层面，与global saturation相比，组织中的T1会缩短。在心肌灌注测量中，该技术与global saturation配合使用，通过比较两种准备后的T1值（T1(selective) vs T1(global)）来计算绝对灌注量。

concepts.label: two compartment model
concepts.title: two compartment model
concepts.definition: 双室模型：一种用于心肌灌注定量计算的简化模型，假设存在两个室（毛细血管血液和灌注组织），且两室间存在快速质子交换。基于该模型，绝对灌注P（单位ml/g/min）可通过公式P = lambda/T1(blood) ([T1(global)/T1(selective)] - 1)计算，其中lambda为血组织分配系数（约0.9 ml/g），T1(blood)为动脉血纵向弛豫时间，T1(global)和T1(selective)分别为global saturation和slice-selective preparation后的心肌T1值。

concepts.label: 虚报（false alarms）
concepts.title: 虚报（false alarms）
concepts.definition: 在N-back任务中，当呈现诱饵（lure）干扰项时，参与者错误地将不匹配n项前的刺激判断为匹配的反应。诱饵比控制干扰项引发更多虚报。

concepts.label: 一致的（BOLD反应）
concepts.title: 一致的（BOLD反应）
concepts.definition: 在fMRI中，指BOLD信号变化与氧代谢方向相同的体素；与'discordant'体素相对，主要依赖脑血流量变化来调节，而非通过氧摄取分数变化。

concepts.label: saturation recovery FLASH
concepts.title: saturation recovery FLASH
concepts.definition: 一种快速ECG门控饱和恢复FLASH序列，用于心肌灌注的动脉自旋标记。该序列通过全局和层面选择性自旋准备后的T1测量，利用未饱和质子自旋流入导致的T1缩短效应，计算心肌绝对灌注量。公式为P = lambda/T1(blood) ([T1(global)/T1(selective)] - 1)。
aliases: fast ECG-gated saturation recovery FLASH sequence

concepts.label: plaque calcification
concepts.title: plaque calcification
concepts.definition: 斑块钙化；冠状动脉斑块中钙盐沉积的程度，作为评估冠状动脉疾病严重程度的影像学指标之一。原文中与noncalcified areas（非钙化区域，斑块易损性标志）并列，用于描述病变范围，但脂肪量与疾病严重程度之间的渐进性关联尚未得到充分证实。

concepts.label: ECG门控
concepts.title: ECG门控
concepts.definition: 心电图门控（ECG-gated），指利用心电图R波触发MRI数据采集的技术，用于同步心脏周期进行成像。在本研究中，ECG门控应用于饱和恢复FLASH序列，以确保T1测量与心脏运动同步，减少心脏搏动对心肌灌注定量测量的影响。

concepts.label: 功能磁共振成像（fMRI）
concepts.title: 功能磁共振成像（fMRI）
concepts.definition: 用于研究脑功能的一类磁共振成像方法，可用于观察认知任务相关的脑区活动。此处是一般主题入口，具体信号机制、测量条件与推断边界需要继续学习。

concepts.label: Reality Monitoring
concepts.title: Reality Monitoring
concepts.definition: 由 Marcia K. Johnson 提出的认知过程术语，指个体区分记忆来源的认知判断机制——即辨别某段记忆是源于实际知觉（perception）还是源于反思性生成（reflectively generated，如思维、想象、梦境、幻想）。与"reality testing"（对当下经验的实时辨别）相区分。其核心机制依赖于两类记忆在知觉细节丰富度与认知操作可及性上的差异。失败时导致信息来源混淆（source misattribution）。

concepts.title: 细胞信号事件
concepts.definition: 学习与记忆形成过程中，在突触可塑性（尤其是长时程增强LTP）的诱导与维持阶段被激活或发生改变的细胞内及细胞间信号转导过程。原文语境中特指用于分析LTP和记忆巩固的分子探针所检测到的信号级联反应，而非泛指所有细胞信号。

concepts.label: demyelination（脱髓鞘）
concepts.title: demyelination（脱髓鞘）
concepts.definition: 神经纤维髓鞘的丧失，可导致神经纤维的神经失同步（neural dys-synchrony）或传导阻滞（conduction block），是听觉神经病的获得性病因之一

concepts.label: 先验功效分析
concepts.title: 先验功效分析
concepts.definition: 基于先前研究效应量预先确定所需样本量的统计方法，本研究中依据既往tACS研究设定30人、80%检验力、α=0.05

concepts.label: 心力衰竭功能状态
concepts.title: 心力衰竭功能状态
concepts.definition: MOGE(S)心肌病分类系统的可选属性（S），用于补充描述患者的心力衰竭功能状态，为五属性中的可选信息项。

concepts.label: 内感受
concepts.title: 内感受
concepts.definition: 身体、脑干、丘脑、岛叶、扣带与全脑网络共同进行的预测、校正和调节过程，为情绪与身体自我提供基础，但不能被简单等同于意识本身。

concepts.title: 左侧 小脑 9

concepts.label: CA1
concepts.title: CA1
concepts.definition: CA1，海马亚区。在物体识别记忆网络中，当大鼠探索熟悉物体时，通路从嗅周皮层→外侧嗅周皮层→CA1占主导。此通路属于颞-海马通路（temporoammonic pathway），与熟悉刺激的处理相关。从穿通纤维通路（新颖刺激）向颞-海马通路（熟悉刺激）的转换可能有助于新颖刺激促进的增强联合学习。

concepts.label: 化学遗传学增强
concepts.title: 化学遗传学增强
concepts.definition: 利用化学遗传学方法（如DREADDs）特异性增强特定神经投射的功能活性

concepts.label: 事件相关功能性磁共振成像

concepts.definition: 数字广度随年龄增长的速度显著快于其他语言材料广度的现象

concepts.label: 对数秩检验
concepts.title: 对数秩检验
concepts.definition: 一种用于生存分析的统计检验方法，用于比较两个或多个独立样本中事件发生时间的分布是否存在差异。该检验基于Kaplan-Meier生存曲线，计算各组在各时间点的期望事件数与实际观察事件数之差，汇总得到对数秩统计量。该统计量等价于卡方值，自由度为组数减1，通过卡方分布确定p值。适用于含删失数据的生存时间比较，但只能判断至少一条生存曲线不同，不能指明具体哪组不同，需配合多重比较校正的事后检验。

concepts.title: 右侧 岛叶 · Id2 区

concepts.title: QDLab电场模拟
concepts.definition: 基于T1加权MRI数据计算TI刺激电场分布的商业软件流程，包括头模型构建、电极位置注册和干涉模式计算

concepts.label: 刺激后负向反应（post-stimulus undershoot）
concepts.title: 刺激后负向反应（post-stimulus undershoot）
concepts.definition: 刺激终止后出现的负向 BOLD 反应，其振幅与枕叶 8-13Hz（alpha）EEG 神经活动功率相关；在初级反应振幅无法预测该相关性的条件下，反映与初级反应部分解耦的神经过程，研究提示可能由抑制性过程驱动。

concepts.title: RBV
concepts.definition: 毛细血管内血容量（intracapillary blood volume），占心肌组织的百分比，在血管内对比剂Feruglose研究中测定为12.9%，反映心肌微血管灌注的结构性指标

concepts.title: 中脑导水管

concepts.title: 左侧 顶上小叶 · 7P 区
concepts.definition: Area 7P (SPL)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 端脑（大脑半球）
concepts.title: 端脑（大脑半球）
concepts.definition: 端脑与间脑同属前脑；端脑包括大脑皮层及端脑深部结构。

concepts.label: 奖励敏感性
concepts.title: 奖励敏感性
concepts.definition: 个体对奖励价值变化的反应程度，在P05中通过二项logit混合模型的奖励×刺激交互项量化，β=0.308，p=.0168

concepts.label: 无差异点
concepts.title: 无差异点
concepts.definition: 在努力决策任务中，使个体对高努力选项与低努力选项选择概率相等的奖励金额，用于个性化确定低努力选项的奖励水平

concepts.label: 异稳态
concepts.title: 异稳态
concepts.definition: 异稳态（allostasis），指机体通过预测性调节主动维持稳定性的生理过程，与内感受（interoception）紧密耦合。在该文献语境中，异稳态—内感受系统是一个分布式全脑网络，涵盖扣带皮层、岛叶及多个脑干核团；2025年90人7T fMRI研究复现并扩展了该系统的拓扑结构，推动从岛叶中心论向全脑网络模型的转变。

concepts.label: 颞叶
concepts.title: 颞叶
concepts.definition: 颞叶听觉、颞上区及海马旁皮层；海马本体另列。

concepts.label: 小脑半球分叶
concepts.title: 小脑半球分叶
concepts.definition: 左右小脑半球分叶。

concepts.label: 右侧 前扣带皮层 · 33 区
concepts.title: 右侧 前扣带皮层 · 33 区
concepts.definition: Area 33 (ACC)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 配对脉冲比率
concepts.title: 配对脉冲比率
concepts.definition: 通过双脉冲电刺激测得的电生理参数，用于评估突触释放概率；PPR降低提示释放概率增强

concepts.label: GABA能抑制
concepts.title: GABA能抑制
concepts.definition: 由GABA（γ-氨基丁酸）介导的抑制性神经传递。在海马中，低剂量muscimol轻度增强GABA能抑制可阻断细胞放电和已形成记忆的提取，但保留LTP诱导和新记忆编码（即"沉默学习"）。

concepts.label: 混合成像
concepts.title: 混合成像
concepts.definition: 将两种或两种以上成像技术结合，以同时获取解剖结构、生理功能及代谢过程信息的综合诊断方法。原文示例包括：PET-CT（代谢活性与解剖细节结合）、SPECT/CT（功能与解剖层面定位病灶）、MRgFUS（MRI引导高强度聚焦超声）以及CT与MPI（如PET或SPECT）的整合系统。

concepts.label: T4
concepts.title: T4
concepts.definition: 甲状腺素（thyroxine），甲状腺激素（TH）的一种形式。原文中通过ELISA检测其在血清、皮层和海马的浓度，发现Asxl3+/-小鼠在2周龄和2月龄时T4水平显著低于野生型对照，与DIO3上调导致的TH失活相关。

concepts.title: 右侧 未定带

concepts.title: 回波时间
concepts.definition: 回波时间（echo time, TE）是MRI成像中的关键参数，指射频脉冲激发后到信号采集之间的时间。原文中T1结构像TE为2.3 ms，场图校正序列TE为4.92 ms，单波段图像TE为1 ms，静息态fMRI TE为30 ms。

concepts.title: 左侧 丘脑内腹核

concepts.label: R1
concepts.title: R1
concepts.definition: R1：纵向弛豫率（longitudinal relaxation rate），定义为T1弛豫时间的倒数（R1 = 1/T1）。在原文中，R1(myo)表示心肌组织的纵向弛豫率，R1(blood)表示血液的纵向弛豫率。使用血管内对比剂（如Feruglose）后，R1(myo)对R1(blood)的依赖性被用于表征毛细血管内外水质子交换频率和毛细血管血容量（RBV）。文中报告了线性响应范围ΔR1(myo)对ΔR1(blood)的关系。

concepts.title: 左侧 额中回 · 8v1 区
concepts.definition: Area 8v1 (MFG)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.definition: 背侧前扣带皮层（dorsal anterior cingulate cortex）。在该文献语境中，是异稳态—内感受系统的关键节点之一，也是低强度聚焦超声的可靶向深部脑区；针对dACC的超声刺激可对心跳诱发电位（HEP）产生可测影响。

concepts.title: lesioning

concepts.title: 右侧 颞上回 · Te 2.2 区

concepts.label: bicoherence
concepts.title: bicoherence
concepts.definition: 一种频谱分析指标，用于检测信号中的非线性相位耦合。在TCD研究中，与coherence一同用于分析功率谱，发现患者theta频段bicoherence较健康对照增加，提示皮层与丘脑在病理性theta节律产生中存在紧密耦合。

concepts.label: 前核群
concepts.title: 前核群
concepts.definition: 丘脑前部核团。

concepts.label: 脂毒性
concepts.title: 脂毒性
concepts.definition: 脂毒性（lipotoxicity）是一种代谢综合征，由脂质中间产物在非脂肪组织中累积引起，导致细胞功能障碍和死亡。正常细胞中脂质产生与氧化/运输处于平衡；脂毒性状态下，脂肪酸进入细胞后转化为二酰甘油、神经酰胺、脂肪酰辅酶A等脂质中间产物，而非中性无害的三酰甘油，这些中间产物损害细胞功能。当脂肪细胞储存能力超负荷，脂质溢出至无充足储存空间的非脂肪组织，超出其储存容量后即引发细胞功能障碍和/或死亡。脂毒性被认为与心力衰竭、肥胖和糖尿病有关。

concepts.label: 颞上回与颞上沟
concepts.title: 颞上回与颞上沟

concepts.label: 脑间相关频带特异性
concepts.title: 脑间相关频带特异性
concepts.definition: theta频段同步与直接社会互动关联，而beta和低gamma频段同步与视觉接触/注视关联的频带分工模式

concepts.label: 角度偏差
concepts.title: 角度偏差

concepts.label: toxic lipid species
concepts.title: toxic lipid species

concepts.label: Thalamocortical Dysrhythmia Default Mode Network Decoupling
concepts.title: Thalamocortical Dysrhythmia Default Mode Network Decoupling
concepts.definition: 2000年后发表的八个复杂视觉幻觉模型之一，与Deafferentation、Reality Monitoring等并列，源自对大脑组织的不同理解，被纳入整合性视觉幻觉框架以系统研究幻觉现象学与认知结构变化的关系。原文未提供该模型的独立机制阐述。

concepts.definition: 编码自噬体支架蛋白的基因，参与大分子细胞成分的选择性招募和降解，属于BEACH结构域蛋白家族，含BEACH、PH、WD40和FYVE结构域，参与自噬和内吞作用
aliases: WD repeat and FYVE domain-containing protein 3

concepts.label: 中线 小脑蚓部 4 5
concepts.title: 中线 小脑蚓部 4 5
concepts.definition: Vermis_4_5；图谱 aal，侧别 M。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 神经源性疼痛
concepts.title: 神经源性疼痛
concepts.definition: 任何由神经系统引起或起源于神经系统的疼痛；是通常由中枢或外周神经系统"功能障碍"所致疼痛的上位术语（umbrella term）。与神经病理性疼痛（neuropathic pain）的区别在于：神经源性疼痛由神经系统功能障碍引起，而神经病理性疼痛由躯体感觉神经系统损伤或疾病引起。在丘脑皮层节律失常（TCD）理论框架中，也被列为可用神经外科方法（如中央外侧丘脑切开术）治疗的适应症之一。

concepts.label: 右侧 中央前回 · 6v2 区
concepts.title: 右侧 中央前回 · 6v2 区
concepts.definition: Area 6v2 (PreCG)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 全部结构
concepts.title: 全部结构
concepts.definition: 按解剖从属逐级浏览；路径不等同于功能网络。

concepts.label: 左侧 小脑 10
concepts.title: 左侧 小脑 10
concepts.definition: Cerebelum_10_L；图谱 aal，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: delta band/delta频段
concepts.title: delta band/delta频段
concepts.definition: 0.5-4 Hz的EEG频率范围，是慢波睡眠（深NREM睡眠）的标志。在认知心理学中用于研究睡眠阶段、记忆巩固及脑恢复过程；在神经电生理研究中与皮层神经元同步化的高幅慢波振荡相关，其产生依赖于皮层细胞的超极化。

concepts.label: 右侧 中央后沟 · 2 区
concepts.title: 右侧 中央后沟 · 2 区
concepts.definition: Area 2 (PostCS)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 视网膜拓扑组织
concepts.title: 视网膜拓扑组织
concepts.definition: 视觉刺激在屏幕上的位置与皮层激活位置形成系统性的空间对应映射关系

concepts.label: 右侧 腹侧被盖区（VTA）
concepts.title: 右侧 腹侧被盖区（VTA）
concepts.definition: R Ventral Tegmental Area；图谱 cit168，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 血管分泌
concepts.title: 血管分泌
concepts.definition: 脂肪组织对邻近血管及心肌等下层组织施加调控作用的一种方式，与旁分泌（paracrine）并列，强调通过血管周围脂肪组织进行的信号传递控制。

concepts.label: 右侧 丘脑背内侧核
concepts.title: 右侧 丘脑背内侧核
concepts.definition: MD (Thalamus, mediodorsal Nucleus)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 左侧 嗅结节
concepts.title: 左侧 嗅结节
concepts.definition: Tu (Basal Forebrain, Tuberculum)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 背外侧前额叶皮层
concepts.title: 背外侧前额叶皮层
concepts.definition: 参与实施控制需求的脑区，与ACC共同评估控制需求并整合成本-收益信息

concepts.label: executive attention
concepts.title: executive attention
concepts.definition: 执行注意（executive attention）：一种高阶认知控制机制，通过自上而下的调节来分配注意资源，优先处理目标相关信息同时抑制干扰。其核心功能包括：在冲突条件下覆盖自动或习惯性反应、选择任务相关刺激并过滤竞争信息。与前额叶皮层密切相关，区别于基础的警觉和定向过程，是执行功能系统的组成部分。

concepts.label: 脂酰辅酶A
concepts.title: 脂酰辅酶A
concepts.definition: 脂肪酸进入细胞后可被转化形成的脂质中间产物之一，与二酰甘油和神经酰胺并列，能够损害细胞功能，导致脂毒性。是脂肪酸活化后的代谢形式，参与多种脂质合成与信号途径。

concepts.label: 右侧 岛叶 · Id6 区
concepts.title: 右侧 岛叶 · Id6 区
concepts.definition: Area Id6 (Insula)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 后扣带皮层
concepts.title: 后扣带皮层
concepts.definition: 位于扣带皮层后部。常按 Brodmann 23、31 区讨论，但论文和图谱边界并不完全一致；它与楔前叶、压后皮层相邻，却不是三者的同义词。

concepts.label: 右侧 顶内沟 · hIP3 区
concepts.title: 右侧 顶内沟 · hIP3 区
concepts.definition: Area hIP3 (IPS)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 预测性内感受
concepts.title: 预测性内感受
concepts.definition: 高层产生身体状态预测，低层传回预测误差；注意与精度加权决定哪类信号更能影响体验的计算框架。

concepts.label: 病毒感染
concepts.title: 病毒感染
concepts.definition: MOGE(S)心肌病分类系统中'E'（病因注释）维度下的获得性病因之一，指由病毒引起的感染性疾病，作为可诱导心肌病的病因类别，与心肌内炎症等并列。

concepts.label: 左侧 丘脑丘脑枕外侧部
concepts.title: 左侧 丘脑丘脑枕外侧部
concepts.definition: PUl (Thalamus, lateral pulvinar)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.title: 右侧 梭状回 · FG4 区
concepts.definition: Area FG4 (FusG)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 右侧 海马–杏仁核过渡区
concepts.title: 右侧 海马–杏仁核过渡区
concepts.definition: HATA (Hippocampus)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: TI刺激右EC方案
concepts.title: TI刺激右EC方案
concepts.definition: 经颅干扰刺激右侧内嗅皮层的电极配置与参数方案：电极对1位于F9和FT9，电极对2位于CP4和C6，分别施加2000 Hz与2040 Hz、1.5 mA峰值电流，产生40 Hz差频包络

concepts.label: TI刺激脱靶效应
concepts.title: TI刺激脱靶效应
concepts.definition: TI刺激中因优化策略仅最大化靶区强度而未显式最小化周围神经结构刺激，导致包络幅度区域常远大于靶区的现象

concepts.label: 右侧 终纹床核
concepts.title: 右侧 终纹床核
concepts.definition: BST (Basal Forebrain, Bed Nucleus)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 小胶质细胞敲除小鼠
concepts.title: 小胶质细胞敲除小鼠
concepts.definition: 本研究中用于消除小胶质细胞以探究其功能缺失效应的基因工程小鼠模型

concepts.label: 上丘脑
concepts.title: 上丘脑
concepts.definition: 缰核等上丘脑结构。

concepts.label: 左侧 额叶岛盖 · Op8 区
concepts.title: 左侧 额叶岛盖 · Op8 区
concepts.definition: Area Op8 (Frontal Operculum)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 小胶质细胞密度
concepts.title: 小胶质细胞密度
concepts.definition: 单位面积或体积内小胶质细胞的数量，本研究通过IBA1免疫染色在伏隔核（NAc）中进行定量

concepts.label: 嗅觉通路例外
concepts.title: 嗅觉通路例外
concepts.definition: 嗅觉信息不先经丘脑中继即到达初级皮层的经典例外情况。

concepts.label: 国际10-10系统
concepts.title: 国际10-10系统
concepts.definition: 脑电电极放置的标准化定位系统，本研究用于确定TI刺激电极的头皮位置

concepts.label: 左侧 眶额皮层 · Fo5 区
concepts.title: 左侧 眶额皮层 · Fo5 区
concepts.definition: Area Fo5 (OFC)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 臂旁核复合体
concepts.title: 臂旁核复合体
concepts.definition: 脑桥被盖的臂旁核复合体，包括内侧和外侧臂旁核；不等于中脑的臂旁色素核 PBP。

concepts.label: FLASH序列
concepts.title: FLASH序列
concepts.definition: 一种快速梯度回波MRI脉冲序列，属于T1加权成像技术。与常规自旋回波序列相比，成像时间缩短7-8倍，但信噪比和对比噪声比显著降低，更易受磁化率伪影影响。存在标准FLASH和Turbo-FLASH（超快速变体）两种形式，后者可实现快速动态MR成像。该序列常用于对比增强扫描、放射治疗靶区定义及心肌灌注成像等临床场景。

concepts.label: AMPA/NMDA比值
concepts.title: AMPA/NMDA比值
concepts.definition: AMPA受体介导的电流与NMDA受体介导的电流之比，用于评估突触成熟度和受体组成；本研究在-70mV（AMPA峰值）和+40mV（NMDA，刺激后50ms）下分别记录

concepts.label: 右侧 膝下前扣带皮层 · 25 区
concepts.title: 右侧 膝下前扣带皮层 · 25 区
concepts.definition: Area 25 (sACC)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。
aliases: 膝下前扣带皮层 · 25 区

concepts.label: 平均角度偏差
concepts.title: 平均角度偏差
concepts.definition: 认知地图任务中用于测量路径整合表现的指标，反映多节点角度估计的平均精度

concepts.label: TrueBlack Plus
concepts.title: TrueBlack Plus
concepts.definition: 用于淬灭组织自发荧光的试剂，本段中对DARPP32和R15B信号影响可忽略

concepts.label: 脑成像数据处理与分析工具箱
concepts.title: 脑成像数据处理与分析工具箱
concepts.definition: DPABI（Data Processing & Analysis for Brain Imaging）是用于脑成像数据预处理和分析的工具箱。原文中用于静息态fMRI预处理，包括：剔除前10个volume以稳定梯度磁场、颅骨剥离（结合Brain Extraction Tool手动校正）、BOLD信号分割为灰质/白质/脑脊液、空间平滑（6mm全宽半高斯核）和时域滤波。
aliases: Data Processing & Analysis for Brain Imaging

concepts.label: 体细胞CAG重复扩增
concepts.title: 体细胞CAG重复扩增
concepts.definition: HTT基因中CAG重复序列的体细胞扩增现象，单独存在不一定导致神经元死亡，其他年龄依赖性事件对突变HTT毒性和神经退行性变是必需的

concepts.label: alpha节律/alpha频段
concepts.title: alpha节律/alpha频段
concepts.definition: 枕叶8-13Hz的EEG神经活动功率，作为刺激后神经元活动的电生理指标。其刺激后功率大小与BOLD和CBF信号幅值相关：EEG功率最高的试次在皮层对侧视觉皮层表现出最大的fMRI undershoot。该相关关系不能被初级反应幅值预测。

concepts.label: 左侧 膝下前扣带皮层 · s32 区
concepts.title: 左侧 膝下前扣带皮层 · s32 区
concepts.definition: Area s32 (sACC)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。
aliases: 膝下前扣带皮层 · s32 区

concepts.label: C4电极
concepts.title: C4电极
concepts.definition: EEG记录中使用的特定电极位置，位于右侧感觉运动皮层区域。在本研究中，C4电极用于测量静息态和辣椒素诱导持续性疼痛状态下的delta、theta和alpha频段功率变化，其中theta频段功率变化与α-HD-tACS在SM1上的镇痛效果显著相关。

concepts.label: 首过技术
concepts.title: 首过技术
concepts.definition: 使用对比剂（CA）检测心肌灌注的MRI技术，通过追踪对比剂首次通过心肌时的信号变化来评估灌注。多数首过技术为定性而非定量，定量应用需建立信号强度与对比剂浓度的确定关系。

concepts.label: 左侧 顶枕沟 · hPO1 区
concepts.title: 左侧 顶枕沟 · hPO1 区
concepts.definition: Area hPO1 (POS)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 右侧 顶内沟 · hIP1 区
concepts.title: 右侧 顶内沟 · hIP1 区
concepts.definition: Area hIP1 (IPS)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 右侧 齿状核腹侧部
concepts.title: 右侧 齿状核腹侧部
concepts.definition: Ndentv (Cerebellum, Ventral Dentate Nucleus)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 过表达
concepts.title: 过表达
concepts.definition: 在细胞或动物中使特定基因表达水平高于正常内源水平的技术手段，常与基因敲除技术并列用于研究基因功能。

concepts.label: segmented gradient echo pulse sequence
concepts.title: segmented gradient echo pulse sequence
concepts.definition: 分段梯度回波脉冲序列。原文用于T2*测量，每次射频激励采集10个连续梯度回波(ten successive gradient echoes per rf excitation)，在单次屏气内完成(single breathhold)。

concepts.label: adenosine
concepts.title: adenosine
concepts.definition: 一种用于心脏MRI药理学应激试验的药物，通过静脉输注（0.56 mg/kg体重，4分钟）诱导冠状动脉扩张，用于评估心肌灌注储备。灌注储备定义为腺苷诱导应激状态下的灌注与静息灌注之比。

concepts.label: tonic firing/紧张性放电
concepts.title: tonic firing/紧张性放电
concepts.definition: 丘脑皮层神经元的一种基础放电模式，表现为持续、规则的单个动作电位发放。在TCD理论中，正常状态下丘脑皮层神经元维持tonic放电；当丘脑水平兴奋性输入减少或抑制性输入增加时，神经元从tonic模式切换为burst firing模式，进而诱发病理性振荡。

concepts.label: 左侧 顶上小叶 · 5Ci 区
concepts.title: 左侧 顶上小叶 · 5Ci 区
concepts.definition: Area 5Ci (SPL)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 行为实验样本
concepts.title: 行为实验样本
concepts.definition: 本研究行为实验招募63名参与者（35名女性，19–28岁，M=22.57，SD=1.85），均为右利手，教育年限≥12年，无自我报告的神经或精神疾病史，无心肺脑金属植入物，无眩晕或梅尼埃综合征

concepts.label: 右侧 额极 · Fp2 区
concepts.title: 右侧 额极 · Fp2 区
concepts.definition: Area Fp2 (FPole)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 左侧 顶下小叶 · PF 区
concepts.title: 左侧 顶下小叶 · PF 区
concepts.definition: Area PF (IPL)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.title: 左侧 黑质网状部
concepts.definition: L Substantia-Nigra-pars-reticulata ；图谱 cit168，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.title: 左侧 外侧枕叶 · hOc5 区
concepts.definition: Area hOc5 (LOC)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.title: 脑干整合
concepts.definition: 在意识出现之前完成大量稳态反射，并把身体状态送往丘脑、下丘脑、杏仁核和皮层的非被动加工阶段，以孤束核（NTS）与臂旁核（PBN）为关键中继。

concepts.label: 视野交叉投射
concepts.title: 视野交叉投射
concepts.definition: 视觉信息从单侧视野交叉投射至对侧大脑半球

concepts.label: 左侧 颞横回 · Te 1.1 区
concepts.title: 左侧 颞横回 · Te 1.1 区
concepts.definition: Area Te 1.1 (HESCHL)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 脑桥
concepts.title: 脑桥
concepts.definition: 脑桥位于中脑与延髓之间，区分脑桥基底部与脑桥被盖；当前没有对应三维模型。

concepts.label: 左侧 伏隔核内侧部
concepts.title: 左侧 伏隔核内侧部
concepts.definition: AcbM (Ventral Striatum, Medial Accumbens)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 脑脊液
concepts.title: 脑脊液
concepts.definition: 脑脊液是一种清澈、无色的跨细胞体液，存在于包裹脊椎动物脑和脊髓的脑膜组织内，以及脑室中。主要由脑室脉络丛的上皮细胞产生，经蛛网膜颗粒吸收。成人约125 mL，每日生成约500 mL。功能包括：作为缓冲垫提供机械保护；输送营养并清除废物；参与脑血流自动调节。

concepts.label: 深部脑刺激
concepts.title: 深部脑刺激
concepts.definition: 一种已应用于人类深部脑区的神经调控技术，因其侵入性特点，应用限于帕金森病或重度抑郁障碍等严重疾病患者。原文指出该技术可用于探索内嗅皮层与路径整合任务的关系，但在患者中开展会引发因果推断有效性的顾虑。

concepts.label: pathological oscillations/病理性振荡
concepts.title: pathological oscillations/病理性振荡
concepts.definition: 在丘脑皮层节律失常（TCD）中，由丘脑皮层神经元从紧张性放电切换为爆发式放电所诱发的约5Hz异常节律活动，该振荡随后夹带（entrain）丘脑和皮层区域，形成病理性theta节律性活动，是TCD的核心电生理特征。

concepts.label: 右侧 膝前前扣带皮层 · p24c 区
concepts.title: 右侧 膝前前扣带皮层 · p24c 区
concepts.definition: Area p24c (pACC)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。
aliases: 膝前前扣带皮层 · p24c 区

concepts.label: 不一致的（BOLD反应）
concepts.title: 不一致的（BOLD反应）
concepts.definition: 在fMRI中，指BOLD信号变化与氧代谢方向相反的体素；约占各种任务中显著BOLD信号变化体素的40%，尤其见于默认模式网络；此类体素基线氧摄取分数较高，主要通过调节氧摄取分数来改变氧需求，而非依赖脑血流量变化。

concepts.label: 对称ROC
concepts.title: 对称ROC
concepts.definition: 在再认记忆的双过程模型中，基于熟悉性（familiarity）的判断所产生的接收者操作特征曲线，其斜率等于1。该对称性区别于回忆（recollection）过程引入的偏斜（斜率降低）。

concepts.label: 左侧 颞横回 · Te 1.2 区
concepts.title: 左侧 颞横回 · Te 1.2 区
concepts.definition: Area Te 1.2 (HESCHL)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 疑核
concepts.title: 疑核
concepts.definition: 延髓内的脑神经相关核团。

concepts.label: 腰椎穿刺
concepts.title: 腰椎穿刺
concepts.definition: 一种临床操作，通过穿刺蛛网膜下腔（脊髓周围）获取脑脊液样本。用于检测颅内压及诊断脑或脑膜感染等疾病。

concepts.label: 左侧 海马旁回 · Ph2 区
concepts.title: 左侧 海马旁回 · Ph2 区
concepts.definition: Area Ph2 (PhG)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 左侧 丘脑腹后内侧核
concepts.title: 左侧 丘脑腹后内侧核
concepts.definition: VPM (Thalamus, ventral posterior medial Nucleus)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 右侧 颞顶交界区 · TPJ 区
concepts.title: 右侧 颞顶交界区 · TPJ 区
concepts.definition: Area TPJ (STG, SMG)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。
aliases: 颞顶交界区 · TPJ 区

concepts.label: 左侧 小脑中间核
concepts.title: 左侧 小脑中间核
concepts.definition: Ninterp (Cerebellum, Interposed Nucleus)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: burst firing
concepts.title: burst firing
concepts.definition: 爆发式放电，指神经元的一种放电模式。在TCD理论中，丘脑皮层神经元因兴奋性输入减弱或抑制性输入增强，从紧张性放电(tonic firing)切换为爆发式放电，进而以约5Hz频率牵引丘脑和皮层区域产生病理性振荡。

concepts.label: 中脑—脑桥交界相关结构
concepts.title: 中脑—脑桥交界相关结构
concepts.definition: 用于索引跨中脑与脑桥分界的结构，不是额外的一块脑组织。具体范围依物种和图谱定义。

concepts.label: 内部运动模型
concepts.title: 内部运动模型
concepts.definition: 神经系统中存储的感觉-运动映射表征，可在经验基础上更新，表现为棱镜摘除后的方向后效。

concepts.label: SimNIBS
concepts.title: SimNIBS
concepts.definition: 用于脑刺激电流流动模拟的计算工具，本研究中用于估计tTIS干涉场的空间分布强度

concepts.label: GSK3B
concepts.title: GSK3B
concepts.definition: 糖原合成酶激酶3β，在WDFY3敲低后上调；LiCl通过抑制该酶激活WNT/β-catenin信号

concepts.label: 心理生理交互作用分析
concepts.title: 心理生理交互作用分析
concepts.definition: 表示任务条件下脑区间功能关联变化的统计方法，不提供信息流方向，P05中用于ACC-纹状体关联分析

concepts.label: CD68
concepts.title: CD68
concepts.definition: 溶酶体/吞噬体标志物，本研究与小胶质细胞标志物IBA1共染以标记小胶质细胞溶酶体

concepts.label: 甲状腺激素信号通路
concepts.title: 甲状腺激素信号通路
concepts.definition: 通过核受体THRA和THRB调控神经前体细胞增殖、神经元分化及PV中间神经元成熟的激素信号系统

concepts.label: 左侧 顶下小叶 · PFop 区
concepts.title: 左侧 顶下小叶 · PFop 区
concepts.definition: Area PFop (IPL)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 左侧 枕颞沟 · OTS1 区
concepts.title: 左侧 枕颞沟 · OTS1 区
concepts.definition: Area OTS1 (OTS)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: RIPK3激酶失活突变体
concepts.title: RIPK3激酶失活突变体
concepts.definition: RIPK3第51位赖氨酸突变为丙氨酸的敲入突变（Ripk3K51A/K51A），用于区分RIPK3的支架功能与激酶活性

concepts.label: synaptic plasticity and memory hypothesis
concepts.title: synaptic plasticity and memory hypothesis
concepts.definition: 突触可塑性与记忆假说：海马网络能够在长时程增强（LTP）诱导机制完整的情况下介导新记忆编码，即使胞体动作电位发放被阻断；该假说将LTP作为记忆编码的关键细胞机制，而非依赖神经元胞体放电。

concepts.label: HDYAC128小鼠模型
concepts.title: HDYAC128小鼠模型
concepts.definition: 表达全长人源突变亨廷顿蛋白（mHTT）、由内源性启动子调控、表达水平与内源性小鼠蛋白相近的亨廷顿病转基因小鼠模型，表现出进行性认知和运动缺陷

concepts.label: 背外侧被盖核
concepts.title: 背外侧被盖核
concepts.definition: 被盖内的特定核团；不等于整个 tegmentum，也不等于背侧被盖核 DTN。

concepts.label: autoregulatory adaptation
concepts.title: autoregulatory adaptation
concepts.definition: 心肌微循环参数，指微血管系统对血流动力学变化的自身调节性适应反应。具体表现为：严重狭窄时通过毛细血管招募（capillary recruitment）增加区域心肌血容量（RBV），以降低血管阻力、维持静息状态下的足够血供；在瘢痕区域则表现为RBV降低。该概念强调微血管系统的代偿性结构-功能调整，而非单纯的大血管狭窄程度。

concepts.label: R2*
concepts.title: R2*
concepts.definition: BOLD MRI获取的弛豫率参数，反映组织脱氧血红蛋白含量相关的磁敏感性效应，用于评估肿瘤氧合状态和缺氧程度。本研究中作为非侵入性缺氧生物标志物，通过测量治疗前后R2*值变化（ΔR2*、Δ%R2*）预测食管鳞癌对根治性放化疗的反应及预后。

concepts.label: 背侧纹状体
concepts.title: 背侧纹状体
concepts.definition: 尾状核与壳核。

concepts.label: 后部与枕核群
concepts.title: 后部与枕核群
concepts.definition: 枕核及其他丘脑后部核团。

concepts.label: 左侧 基底前脑 Ch1–3 细胞群
concepts.title: 左侧 基底前脑 Ch1–3 细胞群
concepts.definition: Ch 123 (Basal Forebrain)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。
aliases: 基底前脑 Ch1–3 细胞群

concepts.label: 间脑
concepts.title: 间脑
concepts.definition: 包括丘脑、下丘脑、上丘脑和丘脑底区等。

concepts.label: 左侧 海马旁回 · Ph3 区
concepts.title: 左侧 海马旁回 · Ph3 区
concepts.definition: Area Ph3 (PhG)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 楔前叶
concepts.title: 楔前叶
concepts.definition: 位于顶叶内侧面，是内侧顶叶的一部分；它与后扣带皮层及压后皮层相邻，不能仅凭“后内侧皮层”一词确定论文实际指向哪一部分。

concepts.label: 左侧 顶下小叶 · PFm 区
concepts.title: 左侧 顶下小叶 · PFm 区
concepts.definition: Area PFm (IPL)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 脚桥被盖核
concepts.title: 脚桥被盖核
concepts.definition: 位于中脑—脑桥交界相关被盖区域；不同图谱的分界和命名不同，不强行限定为仅在某一侧。

concepts.label: 原代小胶质细胞
concepts.title: 原代小胶质细胞
concepts.definition: 体外培养的原代小胶质细胞（MG），用于HSV-1感染实验，评估GSK872处理对Ifnb1、Ifng转录的影响

concepts.label: CCND1
concepts.title: CCND1
concepts.definition: 细胞周期蛋白D1，Wnt/β-catenin通路靶基因，在WDFY3 KD SH-SY5Y细胞中表达未受显著影响

concepts.label: saturation recovery
concepts.title: saturation recovery
concepts.definition: 一种快速心电图门控的饱和恢复FLASH序列，用于T1测量。在全局饱和和层面选择性自旋准备之后执行，通过未饱和质子自旋的流入效应，使层面选择性准备后的组织T1相较于全局饱和情况缩短。

concepts.label: 右侧 小脑 8
concepts.title: 右侧 小脑 8
concepts.definition: Cerebelum_8_R；图谱 aal，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 辣椒素
concepts.title: 辣椒素
concepts.definition: 一种用于在实验研究中诱发持续性疼痛状态的化学物质。在本研究中，参与者接受辣椒素诱导的持续性疼痛，并在该状态下进行EEG评估，以研究个体脑振荡差异对α-HD-tACS镇痛效果的影响。

concepts.label: 左侧 海马 CA3 区
concepts.title: 左侧 海马 CA3 区
concepts.definition: CA3 (Hippocampus)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 右侧 丘脑中央中核
concepts.title: 右侧 丘脑中央中核
concepts.definition: CM (Thalamus, centromedian Nucleus)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 左侧 丘脑背内侧核
concepts.title: 左侧 丘脑背内侧核
concepts.definition: MD (Thalamus, mediodorsal Nucleus)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: dendritic computation
concepts.title: dendritic computation
concepts.definition: 神经元树突进行的非线性信息整合与计算过程，包括：突触输入在时空上足够聚集时产生树突棘波；NMDA受体激活形成电压依赖性正反馈；兴奋性与抑制性输入的相对空间位置决定线性求和或局部"分流"抑制等非线性运算。

concepts.label: 右侧 丘脑腹前核大细胞部
concepts.title: 右侧 丘脑腹前核大细胞部
concepts.definition: VAmc (Thalamus, ventral anterior Nucleus, magnocellular part)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。
aliases: VAmc (Thalamus, ventral anterior Nucleus, magnocellular part)

concepts.label: 脑干核团
concepts.title: 脑干核团
concepts.definition: 位于脑干内的神经元集群。原文语境中指Zhang等（2025）7T fMRI研究复现并扩展的分布式异稳态—内感受系统所覆盖的脑干核团，用于将内感受从岛叶中心论推进为包含脑干的全脑网络系统。

concepts.label: 左侧 丘脑腹内侧核
concepts.title: 左侧 丘脑腹内侧核
concepts.definition: VM (Thalamus, ventral medial Nucleus)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 前扣带皮层
concepts.title: 前扣带皮层
concepts.definition: 位于动机与认知交汇处的脑区，参与评估控制需求、整合成本-收益信息，并决定是否投入努力性控制以实现目标

concepts.label: deoxyhemoglobin
concepts.title: deoxyhemoglobin
concepts.definition: 脱氧血红蛋白，一种天然内源性对比剂。原文指出其具有顺磁性(paramagnetic property)，局限于血管内(intravascular confinement)，因心肌毛细血管动静脉氧合差大而含量可观，可通过磁敏感敏感(BOLD)MRI进行评估；在双嘧达莫负荷下其毛细血管内浓度降低。

concepts.label: 左侧 尾状核底部
concepts.title: 左侧 尾状核底部
concepts.definition: FuCd (Ventral Striatum, Fundus of Caudate Nucleus)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。
aliases: FuCd (Ventral Striatum, Fundus of Caudate Nucleus)

concepts.label: 弥散性树突样PSD95染色
concepts.title: 弥散性树突样PSD95染色
concepts.definition: 敲除小鼠中观察到的PSD95免疫反应信号呈弥散分布、类似树突形态的模式，与野生型点状突触定位不同，且个体间变异较大（部分动物极少，部分显著）

concepts.label: silent learning
concepts.title: silent learning
concepts.definition: 一种学习形式：尽管神经元胞体放电（somatic cell-firing）被大幅阻断，新的空间记忆编码仍可发生。其机制依赖于LTP诱导完整，而记忆提取需要细胞放电。该概念源于树突计算研究，通过海马内药物灌注实验建立。

concepts.label: 左侧 额中回 · MFG5 区
concepts.title: 左侧 额中回 · MFG5 区
concepts.definition: Area MFG5 (MFG, IFG)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: GFAP+星形胶质细胞密度
concepts.title: GFAP+星形胶质细胞密度
concepts.definition: 以GFAP免疫标记计数的单位面积星形胶质细胞数量，用于评估NAc反应性星形胶质细胞或星形胶质细胞总量的发育变化

concepts.label: 聚合效度缺失
concepts.title: 聚合效度缺失
concepts.definition: 测量工具与理论上应相关的其他测量之间未能表现出预期相关性的效度问题

concepts.label: 中央内侧核群
concepts.title: 中央内侧核群
concepts.definition: 中央核及邻近分区。

concepts.label: 左侧 小脑 8
concepts.title: 左侧 小脑 8
concepts.definition: Cerebelum_8_L；图谱 aal，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: Csf1rΔFIRE/ΔFIRE敲除小鼠
concepts.title: Csf1rΔFIRE/ΔFIRE敲除小鼠
concepts.definition: 携带Csf1r基因FIRE（Far Upstream Element）缺失的纯合子小鼠，用于特异性消除小胶质细胞；杂合子为Csf1rΔFIRE/WT，三角形符号标识

concepts.label: 右侧 额中回 · MFG4 区
concepts.title: 右侧 额中回 · MFG4 区
concepts.definition: Area MFG4 (MFG)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 遗传或家族遗传模式
concepts.title: 遗传或家族遗传模式
concepts.definition: MOGE(S)心肌病分类系统的五个核心属性之一（G），用于标注心肌病的遗传背景或家族遗传特征，涵盖基因突变相关知识及家族聚集性模式。

concepts.label: Exon1Htt103Q质粒
concepts.title: Exon1Htt103Q质粒
concepts.definition: 来自奥斯陆大学Anne Simonsen教授馈赠的质粒，与siRNA共转染时使用0.5μg/次转染

concepts.label: 薄束核
concepts.title: 薄束核
concepts.definition: 延髓内的核团，与薄束纤维通路区分。

concepts.label: MOGE(S)分类系统
concepts.title: MOGE(S)分类系统
concepts.definition: 2013年发表的肥厚型心肌病分类系统，基于五个属性：形态功能特征(Morphofunctional characteristics, M)、器官受累(Organ involvement, O)、遗传或家族遗传模式(Genetic or familial inheritance pattern, G)、病因注释(Etiological annotation, E)，以及可选的心力衰竭功能状态(Stage of heart failure, S)。该系统整合遗传突变、获得性病因（如心肌内炎症、病毒感染）及其他诱发条件（如贮积病、毒性）进行分类。

concepts.label: continual distractor tasks
concepts.title: continual distractor tasks
concepts.definition: 一种记忆任务，要求被试在分心任务进行期间持续保持信息。原文将其与Brown-Peterson任务、operation span任务并列，作为SIMPLE模型试图统一解释的三类任务之一，曾被归属为长时记忆（long-term memory）任务。

concepts.label: 左侧 尾状核
concepts.title: 左侧 尾状核
concepts.definition: L Caudate；图谱 cit168，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 左侧 额下沟 · IFS1 区
concepts.title: 左侧 额下沟 · IFS1 区
concepts.definition: Area IFS1 (IFS)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: RIPK3激酶活性
concepts.title: RIPK3激酶活性

concepts.label: Deafferentation
concepts.title: Deafferentation
concepts.definition: 指感觉传入神经纤维（afferent fibers）的丧失或中断，导致特定感觉信号无法传递至中枢神经系统。在听觉系统中，可表现为耳蜗内毛细胞完好但听神经纤维脱失；在疼痛领域，指外周或中枢传入通路损伤后出现的去传入性疼痛（deafferentation pain）。该术语强调结构性传入中断，而非单纯的神经活动抑制。

concepts.label: spin labeling
concepts.title: spin labeling
concepts.definition: 一种基于T1测量的心肌灌注评估技术，采用全局和层面选择性自旋准备，利用未饱和质子自旋流入导致的T1差异计算绝对灌注量。灌注计算公式为P = lambda/T1(blood) ([T1(global)/T1(selective)] - 1)，其中lambda为血组织分配系数（心肌约0.9 ml/g）。

concepts.label: 脑血流自动调节
concepts.title: 脑血流自动调节
concepts.definition: 脑血管阻力血管维持脑血流量（CBF）相对恒定的内在能力，通过改变脑血管阻力（CVR）来应对脑灌注压（CPP）变化。机制包括：肌源性（血管平滑肌对跨壁压反应）、代谢性（局部H+、腺苷、K+、乳酸及组织PO2/PCO2调节）、神经源性/内皮性（交感神经张力、NO、前列腺素调控）。典型成人平台期：平均动脉压（MAP）约50-150 mmHg；慢性高血压使曲线右移。

concepts.label: GluPVN→AChDMV通路
concepts.title: GluPVN→AChDMV通路
concepts.definition: 从下丘脑室旁核谷氨酸能神经元（GluPVN）到乙酰胆碱能DMV神经元（AChDMV）的神经通路，其抑制可减弱HCC–CSDS小鼠肿瘤生长

concepts.label: Visual Hallucination Framework（视觉幻觉框架）
concepts.title: Visual Hallucination Framework（视觉幻觉框架）
concepts.definition: 由八个视觉幻觉模型研究团队代表协商达成的整合性理论框架，旨在协调自2000年以来提出的八种复杂视觉幻觉模型（包括Deafferentation、Reality Monitoring、Perception and Attention Deficit、Activation-Input-Modulation、Hodological、Attentional Networks、Active Inference、Thalamocortical Dysrhythmia Default Mode Network Decoupling）。该框架界定与幻觉相关的认知系统，允许对视觉幻觉现象学与底层认知结构变化之间的关系进行系统性、一致性研究，区分幻觉发作、持续和终止的不同因素，并提示状态与特质风险标记物之间的复杂关系。

concepts.label: stenosis
concepts.title: stenosis

concepts.title: 外侧嗅周皮层
concepts.definition: 小鼠外侧嗅周皮层（LEC），在基于奖励的导航任务中表征关键经验时段（experiential epochs），包含三类神经元亚群：分别编码目标接近（goal approach）、目标离开（goal departure）和奖励消耗（reward consumption）。当奖励位置改变时，这些群体立即调整其相对于奖励的表征；光遗传学抑制LEC会破坏新奖励位置的学习。LEC向海马提供以奖励为中心的非空间'what'信息，与内侧嗅周皮层提供的空间'where'信息整合，以支持情景记忆形成。

concepts.label: capillary recruitment
concepts.title: capillary recruitment

concepts.label: 丘脑皮层节律失常
concepts.title: 丘脑皮层节律失常
concepts.definition: 丘脑皮层节律失常（Thalamocortical Dysrhythmia, TCD）是一种理论框架，用于解释神经系统疾病（如帕金森病、神经性疼痛、耳鸣、癫痫）及神经精神疾病（如抑郁症、精神分裂症、强迫症等）引发的阳性和阴性症状。其核心机制为：丘脑水平兴奋性输入减弱或抑制性输入增强，导致丘脑皮层神经元从紧张性发放（tonic firing）转换为爆发性发放（burst firing），进而以约5Hz的病理振荡夹带丘脑和皮层区域；在功率谱上表现为θ波段（theta band）相干性和双相干性增高，提示皮层与丘脑在病理性θ节律产生中存在紧密耦合。该理论得到脑磁图（MEG）、脑电图（EEG）及手术中局部场电位（LFP）记录的支持。

concepts.label: power spectra/功率谱
concepts.title: power spectra/功率谱
concepts.definition: 对MEG、EEG头皮记录及术中局部场电位（LFP）记录进行频谱分析所得的频率-功率分布。在TCD研究中，分析功率谱可发现theta波段（约5Hz）中相干性（coherence）和双相干性（bicoherence）相对于健康对照的异常增高，是检测病理性丘脑皮层耦合的主要量化手段。

concepts.title: HD-MSNs

concepts.label: 生物标志物
concepts.title: 生物标志物
concepts.definition: 在阿尔茨海默病诊断语境中，指可测量且能指示β-淀粉样蛋白和tau蛋白稳态失调的生物学参数，通过PET成像、脑脊液分析或血液检测获得，用于在体分子水平诊断AD病理（脑内β-淀粉样蛋白沉积和过度磷酸化tau蛋白），是确定抗淀粉样蛋白治疗资格的必要步骤。

concepts.label: non-CR（非完全缓解组）
concepts.title: non-CR（非完全缓解组）
concepts.definition: 在评估食管鳞癌根治性放化疗疗效的研究中，指未达到完全缓解（complete response, CR）的患者组别。该组与CR组对比，其post-R2*、ΔR2*及Δ%R2*参数显著较低，且3年总生存率显著差于CR组（29.27% vs. 76.47%）。作为治疗反应二分分类的阴性类别，用于ROC分析和生存分析。

concepts.label: storage diseases（贮积病）
concepts.title: storage diseases（贮积病）
concepts.definition: 在MOGE(S)分类系统中，storage diseases（贮积病）是引起肥厚型心肌病的病因类别之一，与毒性(toxicity)并列提及，属于导致心肌病的诱发条件。原文未展开具体机制或疾病类型，仅作为病因学注释(E)中的病因示例。

concepts.label: poststenotic dilation
concepts.title: poststenotic dilation

concepts.label: MR血管造影
concepts.title: MR血管造影
concepts.definition: 磁共振血管造影（MR angiography），一种非侵入性血管成像技术，用于显示偏头痛无先兆发作期间大脑大动脉扩张，并证实颅外动脉无扩张。

concepts.label: Δ%R2*
concepts.title: Δ%R2*
concepts.definition: BOLD MRI中R2*值在治疗前后变化的相对百分比（百分比变化率）。在食管鳞癌dCRT疗效评估中，CR组的Δ%R2*显著高于非CR组（P=0.006），与post-R2*、ΔR2*共同构成R2*相关参数体系，用于预测肿瘤治疗反应。

concepts.label: Gene Knockout
concepts.title: Gene Knockout
concepts.definition: 通过技术操作使特定基因失活的技术；原文中用于细胞和动物研究，以分析基因转录变化对学习和LTP的贡献

concepts.label: 假刺激条件
concepts.title: 假刺激条件
concepts.definition: 作为对照条件的无效刺激，用于排除非特异性效应

concepts.label: mEPSC上升时间
concepts.title: mEPSC上升时间
concepts.definition: 微小兴奋性突触后电流（miniature excitatory postsynaptic current）从起始到峰值所需的时间，反映突触后受体激活动力学

concepts.label: 右侧 丘脑室旁核
concepts.title: 右侧 丘脑室旁核
concepts.definition: Pv (Thalamus, paraventricular Nucleus)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 左侧 顶下小叶 · PFt 区
concepts.title: 左侧 顶下小叶 · PFt 区
concepts.definition: Area PFt (IPL)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: neural dys-synchrony（神经失同步）
concepts.title: neural dys-synchrony（神经失同步）
concepts.definition: 神经纤维因脱髓鞘而出现的神经冲动时间同步性丧失，与传导阻滞共同构成听觉神经病的病理生理机制

concepts.label: MAPK/ERK1/2信号通路
concepts.title: MAPK/ERK1/2信号通路
concepts.definition: WDFY3敲低后发生失调的信号通路之一，与神经系统发育相关，在转录组和蛋白水平均被验证

concepts.label: 下丘脑室旁核-迷走神经背核-肝脏回路
concepts.title: 下丘脑室旁核-迷走神经背核-肝脏回路
concepts.definition: 谷氨酸能PVH神经元投射至胆碱能DMV，再支配肝脏的神经回路，慢性应激下过度激活
aliases: glutamatergic paraventricular hypothalamic nucleus → cholinergic dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus → liver circuit

concepts.label: 假刺激对照
concepts.title: 假刺激对照
concepts.definition: 非全程维持相同强度的对照条件，P05明确说明"假刺激不是全程维持相同强度的主动对照"

concepts.label: 血管周围脂肪
concepts.title: 血管周围脂肪
concepts.definition: 围绕血管的脂肪组织储库，在生理状态下可对血管功能和能量分配发挥保护性调节作用，但其扩张会转变为促脂毒性、促血栓和促炎症的有害器官；在代谢性疾病和冠状动脉疾病患者中增多。

concepts.label: 时间线2
concepts.title: 时间线2
concepts.definition: 每日一次训练/测试，药物在每次 session 后立即给予，即 session 与前次给药间隔至少24小时

concepts.label: 右侧 杏仁核中央内侧核群
concepts.title: 右侧 杏仁核中央内侧核群
concepts.definition: CM (Amygdala)；图谱 julich，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 自发兴奋性突触后电流
concepts.title: 自发兴奋性突触后电流
concepts.definition: 自发产生的兴奋性突触后电流，记录频率与平均幅度以反映突触传递基础状态

concepts.label: 左侧 颞上沟 · STS1 区
concepts.title: 左侧 颞上沟 · STS1 区
concepts.definition: Area STS1 (STS)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: mIPSC衰减时间常数
concepts.title: mIPSC衰减时间常数
concepts.definition: 微小抑制性突触后电流衰减至峰值1/e的时间，反映GABA_A受体脱敏和Cl⁻通道关闭动力学

concepts.label: 右侧 下丘脑
concepts.title: 右侧 下丘脑
concepts.definition: R Hypothalamus；图谱 cit168，侧别 R。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: Ripk3K51A/K51A小鼠
concepts.title: Ripk3K51A/K51A小鼠
concepts.definition: 携带RIPK3激酶失活突变（K51A）的遗传修饰小鼠模型，用于区分激酶依赖性与非依赖性功能

concepts.label: 加速rotarod范式
concepts.title: 加速rotarod范式
concepts.definition: 用于评估运动协调性能的转棒实验方案，在本研究中于第4天用于确认HDYAC128小鼠2月龄时无运动缺陷

concepts.label: 腹侧与外侧核群
concepts.title: 腹侧与外侧核群
concepts.definition: 丘脑腹侧和外侧核团。

concepts.label: 身体传感器
concepts.title: 身体传感器
concepts.definition: 将血压、氧合、心跳、胃肠牵张、温度和组织状态转换为神经或体液信号的外周装置，包括动脉压力感受器、化学感受器、心肺和胃肠机械感受器、痛温与免疫信号。

concepts.label: 海马结构
concepts.title: 海马结构
concepts.definition: 海马本体、齿状回、下托复合体及相关过渡区。

concepts.label: 认知地图任务操作化
concepts.title: 认知地图任务操作化
concepts.definition: 在6×6m俯视网格图中标记两个缺失锥体位置，限时60秒，支持地图旋转操作

concepts.label: 慢性社会挫败应激
concepts.title: 慢性社会挫败应激
concepts.definition: 本研究使用的另一种慢性应激模型，与HCC联合构建HCC–CSDS小鼠

concepts.label: 左侧 顶叶岛盖 · Op1 区
concepts.title: 左侧 顶叶岛盖 · Op1 区
concepts.definition: Area Op1 (POperc)；图谱 julich，侧别 L。图谱条目范围不等于同名概念的完整体积。

concepts.label: 迷走神经背核
concepts.title: 迷走神经背核
concepts.definition: 脑干胆碱能自主神经核团，发出迷走神经纤维支配肝脏等外周器官，调控乙酰胆碱释放
aliases: dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus

concepts.label: 伏隔核兴奋性突触密度
concepts.title: 伏隔核兴奋性突触密度
concepts.definition: 以VGLUT2+/PSD95+共定位点密度为指标的谷氨酸能突触数量度量

concepts.label: 电场模拟后处理流程
concepts.title: 电场模拟后处理流程
concepts.definition: TI刺激研究中用于从原始模拟数据提取靶区ROI电场强度的标准化处理步骤，包括颅骨移除、图谱配准和ROI掩膜提取

concepts.label: 肝细胞癌
concepts.title: 肝细胞癌
concepts.definition: 原发性肝脏恶性肿瘤，全球主要癌症死亡原因之一，本研究中5年总生存率低于25%

concepts.label: 蛋白质组学变异系数分析
concepts.title: 蛋白质组学变异系数分析
concepts.definition: 对Log2转换后（含与不含分位数归一化）的蛋白质强度值计算生物学重复间变异系数，用于评估数据质量与重复性
aliases: coefficient of variation for individual proteins

concepts.label: 实时位置偏好
concepts.title: 实时位置偏好
concepts.definition: 一种行为学测试，动物在可自由探索的双室装置中，某一室与特定刺激配对，用于评估该刺激的情境强化或厌恶效应

concepts.label: CreER
concepts.title: CreER
concepts.definition: 一种他莫昔芬（tamoxifen）诱导型Cre重组酶系统。在本文中，Nkx2.1-CreER小鼠与Thra fl/+小鼠杂交后，通过连续三天腹腔注射他莫昔芬（75 ng/g，每24小时一次），可在Nkx2.1阳性的抑制性神经元前体细胞中诱导Cre活性，实现Thra的条件性敲除。

concepts.label: intravascular CA
concepts.title: intravascular CA
concepts.definition: 血管内造影剂（contrast agent），特指滞留于血管腔内、不渗出至血管外的造影剂。原文中具体实例为Feruglose（Amersham），用于稳态下增加心肌弛豫率R1(myo)，从而测定毛细血管内外水质子交换频率和区域血容量（RBV）。

concepts.label: 外侧臂旁核
concepts.title: 外侧臂旁核
concepts.definition: 位于脑桥的核团，接收下丘脑能量稳态信息，编码食物新异恐惧和饥饿状态下的正效价，向VTA投射

concepts.label: 双耳分听实验
concepts.title: 双耳分听实验
concepts.definition: 左右耳同时呈现不同音节，要求被试复述一侧或报告听到内容，通过正确率的耳侧差异研究听觉选择性注意与语言侧化的经典范式

concepts.label: Abducens Nerve
concepts.title: Abducens Nerve
concepts.definition: The 6th cranial nerve which originates in the ABDUCENS NUCLEUS of the PONS and sends motor fibers to the lateral rectus muscles of the EYE. Damage to the nerve or its nucleus disrupts horizontal eye movement control.

concepts.label: Congenital Abnormalities
concepts.title: Congenital Abnormalities
concepts.definition: Malformations of organs or body parts during development in utero.

concepts.label: Abnormalities, Multiple
concepts.title: Abnormalities, Multiple
concepts.definition: Congenital abnormalities that affect more than one organ or body structure.

concepts.label: Abreaction
concepts.title: Abreaction
concepts.definition: A process in psychotherapy in which the patient is desensitized to emotionally painful, often forgotten (repressed) memories by recalling and reacting to them in the safety of the treatment setting.

concepts.label: Abscess
concepts.title: Abscess
concepts.definition: Accumulation of purulent material in tissues, organs, or circumscribed spaces, usually associated with signs of infection.

concepts.label: Absenteeism
concepts.title: Absenteeism
concepts.definition: Chronic absence from work or other duty.

concepts.label: Absorption
concepts.title: Absorption
concepts.definition: The physical or physiological processes by which substances, tissue, cells, etc. take up or take in other substances or energy.

concepts.label: Accessory Nerve
concepts.title: Accessory Nerve
concepts.definition: The 11th cranial nerve which originates from NEURONS in the MEDULLA and in the CERVICAL SPINAL CORD. It has a cranial root, which joins the VAGUS NERVE (10th cranial) and sends motor fibers to the muscles of the LARYNX, and a spinal root, which sends motor fibers to the TRAPEZIUS and the sternocleidomastoid muscles.

concepts.label: Accident Proneness
concepts.title: Accident Proneness
concepts.definition: Tendency toward involvement in accidents. Implies certain personality characteristics which predispose to accidents.

concepts.label: Driving Under the Influence
concepts.title: Driving Under the Influence
concepts.definition: Operating a motor vehicle while impaired by alcohol or other drugs including those prescribed by physicians.

concepts.label: Criminal Behavior
concepts.title: Criminal Behavior
concepts.definition: Conduct leading to commission of unlawful acts.

concepts.label: Cognitive Neuroscience
concepts.title: Cognitive Neuroscience
concepts.definition: Field of study concerning MENTAL PROCESSES; LEARNING; and the brain regions associated with them.

concepts.label: Emotional Adjustment
concepts.title: Emotional Adjustment
concepts.definition: Psychological process that occurs when an individual adapts to a significant emotional event or stimulus.

concepts.label: Facial Recognition
concepts.title: Facial Recognition
concepts.definition: Ability to identify an individual from their facial features.

concepts.label: Grandparents
concepts.title: Grandparents
concepts.definition: Member of a family who has children and grandchildren.

concepts.label: Help-Seeking Behavior
concepts.title: Help-Seeking Behavior
concepts.definition: Form of social behavior in which assistance is sought from others.

concepts.label: Heuristics
concepts.title: Heuristics
concepts.definition: Experience-based techniques for problem-solving, learning, and discovery that find a solution which is not guaranteed to be optimal, but sufficient for a given set of goals.

concepts.label: Problem Behavior
concepts.title: Problem Behavior
concepts.definition: Troublesome or disruptive behavioral displays.

concepts.label: Underage Drinking
concepts.title: Underage Drinking
concepts.definition: Consumption of ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES by persons under the legal drinking age.

concepts.label: Cell Plasticity
concepts.title: Cell Plasticity
concepts.definition: The ability of a cell to change its PHENOTYPE in response to changes in the environment.

concepts.label: Neuroprotection
concepts.title: Neuroprotection
concepts.definition: The physiological processes and techniques used by the body to prevent neuronal injury and degeneration in the central nervous system following acute disorders or as a result of chronic neurodegenerative diseases.

concepts.label: Diet, Food, and Nutrition
concepts.title: Diet, Food, and Nutrition
concepts.definition: Concepts involved with nutritional physiology, including categories of substances eaten for sustenance, nutritional phenomena and processes, eating patterns and habits, and measurable nutritional parameters.

concepts.label: Literacy
concepts.title: Literacy
concepts.definition: Ability to read and write.

concepts.label: Psychological Trauma
concepts.title: Psychological Trauma
concepts.definition: An emotionally painful, shocking, stressful, and sometimes life-threatening experience. It can result from witnessing distressing events such as natural disasters, physical or sexual abuse, and terrorism or other acts of violence. (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Peer Influence
concepts.title: Peer Influence
concepts.definition: The effect or sway that a PEER GROUP exerts on the beliefs, value systems and behavior of each member of a group. The social expectations for individuals to conform to peer group influence is known as peer pressure.

concepts.label: Behavior Observation Techniques
concepts.title: Behavior Observation Techniques
concepts.definition: A wide range of formal and informal techniques used to document behavior.

concepts.label: Behavior Rating Scale
concepts.title: Behavior Rating Scale
concepts.definition: Instrument designed to assess human or animal behavior, using a standardized format.

concepts.label: Alcohol Drinking in College
concepts.title: Alcohol Drinking in College
concepts.definition: Alcohol consumption among college students.

concepts.label: Social Communication Disorder
concepts.title: Social Communication Disorder
concepts.definition: Persistent difficulties in the social uses of verbal and nonverbal communications. (DSM-V)

concepts.label: Anger Management Therapy
concepts.title: Anger Management Therapy
concepts.definition: System of psychological and/or therapeutic techniques used to control and or reduce the triggers, degrees, and effects of ANGER.

concepts.label: Psychology, Sports
concepts.title: Psychology, Sports
concepts.definition: Field of research that studies mental factors influencing the attainment of athletic skills and athletic performance.

concepts.label: Childhood-Onset Fluency Disorder
concepts.title: Childhood-Onset Fluency Disorder
concepts.definition: Disturbances in the normal fluency and time patterning of speech that are inappropriate for the individual's age and language skills. (DSM-V)

concepts.label: No-Show Patients
concepts.title: No-Show Patients
concepts.definition: PATIENTS who do not turn up for scheduled healthcare appointments. Do not confuse with PATIENT DROPOUTS.

concepts.label: Metacognition
concepts.title: Metacognition
concepts.definition: Awareness and understanding of one's own thought processes.

concepts.label: Prescription Drug Overuse
concepts.title: Prescription Drug Overuse
concepts.definition: The use of a medication in an amount more than as prescribed.

concepts.label: Healthcare Failure Mode and Effect Analysis
concepts.title: Healthcare Failure Mode and Effect Analysis
concepts.definition: Prospective risk assessment tool aimed at identifying potential risks and their impact in healthcare settings.
aliases: Failure Mode and Effect Analysis, Healthcare

concepts.label: Computer Heuristics
concepts.title: Computer Heuristics
concepts.definition: Trial-and-error methods of problem-solving used when an algorithmic approach is impractical

concepts.label: Ataxins
concepts.title: Ataxins
concepts.definition: A family of predominantly nuclear proteins that regulate gene transcription and protein degradation. The expansion of CAG trinucleotide repeats in genes that encode Ataxins is associated with SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIAS (SCA). In SCA patients, the number of CAG repeats correlates with the severity of disease and inversely correlates with the age of disease onset.

concepts.label: Diplomacy
concepts.title: Diplomacy
concepts.definition: The art and practice of conducting negotiations between people, nations or other parties such as organizations.

concepts.label: Specific Learning Disorder
concepts.title: Specific Learning Disorder
concepts.definition: Diagnosed when there are specific deficits in an individual’s ability to perceive or process information efficiently and accurately. This  disorder first manifests during the years of formal schooling and is characterized by persistent and impairing difficulties with learning foundational academic skills in reading, writing, and/or math. The individual’s performance of the affected academic skills is well below average for age, or acceptable performance levels are achieved only with extraordinary effort. Specific learning disorder may occur in individuals identified as intellectually gifted and manifest only when the learning demands or assessment procedures (e.g., timed tests) pose barriers that cannot be overcome by their innate intelligence and compensatory strategies. For all individuals, specific learning disorder can produce lifelong impairments in activities dependent on the skills, including occupational performance. (from DSM-V)

concepts.label: Social Learning
concepts.title: Social Learning
concepts.definition: The concept of new knowledge acquisition through observation and interaction with others.

concepts.label: Optimism
concepts.title: Optimism
concepts.definition: Mental attitude that interprets life events as generally being positive.

concepts.label: Pessimism
concepts.title: Pessimism
concepts.definition: Mental attitude that interprets life events as generally being negative.

concepts.label: Ataxin-1
concepts.title: Ataxin-1
concepts.definition: A chromatin-binding factor that represses Notch signaling and associates with RNA. Expansion of the polyglutamine tract by expanded CAG repeats in the ATXN1 gene coding region is associated with SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIA 1.

concepts.label: Ataxin-2
concepts.title: Ataxin-2
concepts.definition: A Poly(A) RNA-binding protein that negatively regulates EGFR ENDOCYTOSIS. An increased risk for developing AMYOTROPHIC LATERAL SCLEROSIS 13 is observed in patients who have more than 23 CAG repeats in the ATXN2 gene coding sequence. Larger CAG expansions in the ATXN2 gene occur in SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIA 2 patients.

concepts.label: Ataxin-3
concepts.title: Ataxin-3
concepts.definition: A deubiquitinating enzyme of the ATAXINS family. It functions in protein homeostasis, GENETIC TRANSCRIPTION; CYTOSKELETON regulation, and MYOGENESIS. CAG TRINUCLEOTIDE REPEAT EXPANSION in the Ataxin-3 gene coding region is associated with spinocerebellar ataxia-3 (MACHADO-JOSEPH DISEASE).

concepts.label: Ataxin-7
concepts.title: Ataxin-7
concepts.definition: A component of the STAGA transcription coactivator-HAT complex that functions in Cone Rod Homeobox Protein (CRX)-dependent gene activation. It also stabilizes MICROTUBULES. CAG repeat expansion in the ATXN-7 coding region is associated with the development of SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIA 7.

concepts.label: Hoarding Disorder
concepts.title: Hoarding Disorder
concepts.definition: Disordered behavior associated with clinically significant distress or impairment in social, occupational or other important areas of functioning and persistent difficulty parting with possessions due to a perceived need to save the items and distress associated with discarding them. (from DSM-V) The quantity of collected items sets the behavior apart from normal collecting behaviors.

concepts.label: Autism Spectrum Disorder
concepts.title: Autism Spectrum Disorder
concepts.definition: Wide continuum of associated cognitive and neurobehavioral disorders, including, but not limited to, three core-defining features: impairments in socialization, impairments in verbal and nonverbal communication, and restricted and repetitive patterns of behaviors. (from DSM-V)

concepts.label: Motor Disorders
concepts.title: Motor Disorders
concepts.definition: Motor skills deficits that significantly and persistently interfere with ACTIVITIES OF DAILY LIVING appropriate to chronological age.  (from DSM-5)

concepts.label: Trauma and Stressor Related Disorders
concepts.title: Trauma and Stressor Related Disorders
concepts.definition: Disorders in which exposure to a traumatic or stressful event is explicitly a diagnostic criterion.

concepts.label: Bipolar and Related Disorders
concepts.title: Bipolar and Related Disorders
concepts.definition: These disorders are related to both SCHIZOPHRENIA SPECTRUM AND OTHER PSYCHOTIC DISORDERS and DEPRESSIVE DISORDER in terms of symptomatology, family history, and genetics. (DSM-5).

concepts.label: Gender Dysphoria
concepts.title: Gender Dysphoria
concepts.definition: A marked difference between the individual’s expressed/experienced gender and the gender others would assign to the individual, and it must continue for at least six months. (from DSM-5)

concepts.label: Formative Feedback
concepts.title: Formative Feedback
concepts.definition: Information communicated to the learner that is intended to modify the learner’s thinking or behavior for the purpose of improving learning.

concepts.label: Distance Counseling
concepts.title: Distance Counseling
concepts.definition: Counseling conducted via electronic or other non-face-to-face interactions.

concepts.label: Self-Control
concepts.title: Self-Control
concepts.definition: An individual's ability to manage and monitor their emotions, behaviors, and desires in the face of external demands in order to function in society.

concepts.label: Compassion Fatigue
concepts.title: Compassion Fatigue
concepts.definition: Emotional distress caused by repeated or prolonged expression of compassion or empathy. It may occur in individuals working in care giving professions.

concepts.label: Clinical Studies as Topic
concepts.title: Clinical Studies as Topic
concepts.definition: Works about research studies that evaluate interventions or exposures on biomedical or health-related outcomes.  The two main types of clinical studies are interventional studies (clinical trials) and observational studies.

concepts.label: Serotonin and Noradrenaline Reuptake Inhibitors
concepts.title: Serotonin and Noradrenaline Reuptake Inhibitors
concepts.definition: Drugs that selectively block or suppress the plasma membrane transport of SEROTONIN and NORADRENALINE into axon terminals and are used as ANTIDEPRESSIVE AGENTS.

concepts.label: Sleep Aids, Pharmaceutical
concepts.title: Sleep Aids, Pharmaceutical
concepts.definition: Drugs used to induce SLEEP, prevent SLEEPLESSNESS, or treat SLEEP INITIATION AND MAINTENANCE DISORDERS.

concepts.label: Orexin Receptor Antagonists
concepts.title: Orexin Receptor Antagonists
concepts.definition: Substances that bind to and inhibit the action of OREXIN RECEPTORS. Drugs in this class have been used as SLEEP AIDS, PHARMACEUTICAL.

concepts.label: Spatial Regression
concepts.title: Spatial Regression
concepts.definition: Methods used to take into account and incorporate spatial autocorrelation and regional variation into regression analysis models of data that has spatial dependency, and also to provide information on the spatial relationships among the variables.

concepts.label: Memory Consolidation
concepts.title: Memory Consolidation
concepts.definition: Neurological process involving the conversion of learned information into long-term memory.

concepts.label: Radiation Exposure
concepts.title: Radiation Exposure
concepts.definition: Phenomenon in which organisms are subjected to radiation.

concepts.label: Gastrointestinal Microbiome
concepts.title: Gastrointestinal Microbiome
concepts.definition: All of the microbial organisms that naturally exist within the GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT.

concepts.label: Drug Resistant Epilepsy
concepts.title: Drug Resistant Epilepsy
concepts.definition: Epileptic condition in which adequate trials of two tolerated and appropriately chosen and used ANTIEPILEPTIC DRUGS schedules to achieve sustained seizure freedom failed.

concepts.label: Autoimmune Hypophysitis
concepts.title: Autoimmune Hypophysitis
concepts.definition: Immune-mediated inflammation of the PITUITARY GLAND often associated with other autoimmune diseases (e.g., HASHIMOTO DISEASE; GRAVES DISEASE; and ADDISON DISEASE).

concepts.label: Neuropathology
concepts.title: Neuropathology
concepts.definition: The branch of medicine and biomedical science concerned with diseases of the nervous system.

concepts.label: Bone-Implant Interface
concepts.title: Bone-Implant Interface
concepts.definition: Region of interaction between the bone and PROSTHESES AND IMPLANTS which becomes bonded through cellular and extracellular interactions similar to OSSEOINTEGRATION.

concepts.label: Telerehabilitation
concepts.title: Telerehabilitation
concepts.definition: Delivery of therapeutic rehabilitation at a distance or offsite using telecommunication technologies.

concepts.label: Infectious Encephalitis
concepts.title: Infectious Encephalitis
concepts.definition: Brain inflammation caused by an infectious agent.

concepts.label: Machine Learning
concepts.title: Machine Learning
concepts.definition: A type of ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE that enable COMPUTERS to independently initiate and execute LEARNING when exposed to new data.

concepts.label: Environmental Psychology
concepts.title: Environmental Psychology
concepts.definition: The field that studies interactions between individuals and the built and natural environment. It includes investigating behaviors that inhibit or foster sustainable, climate-healthy, and nature-enhancing choices.

concepts.label: Adult Survivors of Child Adverse Events
concepts.title: Adult Survivors of Child Adverse Events
concepts.definition: Persons who experienced traumatic events during childhood.

concepts.label: Presenteeism
concepts.title: Presenteeism
concepts.definition: Reporting for work despite feeling ill.

concepts.label: Sleep Hygiene
concepts.title: Sleep Hygiene
concepts.definition: Habits and practices conducive to getting the right amount and quality of sleep, and include  responding to environmental factors that may influence one's sleep.

concepts.label: Anti-Vaccination Movement
concepts.title: Anti-Vaccination Movement
concepts.definition: Group activities directed against VACCINATION.

concepts.label: Attentional Bias
concepts.title: Attentional Bias
concepts.definition: An increased focus or awareness of certain stimuli over others, which influence behavior.

concepts.label: Healthy Lifestyle
concepts.title: Healthy Lifestyle
concepts.definition: A pattern of behavior involving LIFE STYLE choices which ensure optimum health. Examples are eating right; maintaining physical, emotional, and spiritual wellness, and taking preemptive steps against communicable diseases.

concepts.label: Parkinson Disease Associated Proteins
concepts.title: Parkinson Disease Associated Proteins
concepts.definition: Proteins associated with sporadic or familial cases of PARKINSON DISEASE.

concepts.label: Mental Navigation Tests
concepts.title: Mental Navigation Tests
concepts.definition: Measures of spatial cognition and memory.

concepts.label: Rib Cage
concepts.title: Rib Cage
concepts.definition: The bony thoracic enclosure consisting of the vertebral column; the RIBS; the STERNUM; and the COSTAL CARTILAGE.

concepts.label: Morton Neuroma
concepts.title: Morton Neuroma
concepts.definition: A nerve inflammation in the foot caused by chronic compression of the plantar nerve between the METATARSAL BONES.

concepts.label: Brain Contusion
concepts.title: Brain Contusion
concepts.definition: A bruise of the brain from an impact of the skull.

concepts.label: Brain Injuries, Diffuse
concepts.title: Brain Injuries, Diffuse
concepts.definition: Brain injuries occurring over a wide area instead of specific focal area.

concepts.label: Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy
concepts.title: Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy
concepts.definition: Degenerative brain disease linked to repetitive brain trauma. Progressive symptoms may include MEMORY LOSS; AGGRESSION; or DEPRESSION.

concepts.label: Non-Neuronal Cholinergic System
concepts.title: Non-Neuronal Cholinergic System
concepts.definition: The system of ACETYLCHOLINE-synthesizing enzymes, transporters, receptors and degrading enzymes that characterize non-neuronal cholinergic cells such as airway and skin EPITHELIAL CELLS.

concepts.label: Brain Injuries, Traumatic
concepts.title: Brain Injuries, Traumatic
concepts.definition: A form of acquired brain injury which occurs when a sudden trauma causes damage to the brain.

concepts.label: Hyperekplexia
concepts.title: Hyperekplexia
concepts.definition: A neurological disorder characterized by an excessive startle reaction with ABNORMAL REFLEX;  MYOCLONIC JERKS; and MUSCLE HYPERTONIA.

concepts.label: Place Cells
concepts.title: Place Cells
concepts.definition: Pyramidal neurons in the HIPPOCAMPUS that play a role in cognitive representation of a specific location within a space.

concepts.label: Grid Cells
concepts.title: Grid Cells
concepts.definition: Neurons in the ENTORHINAL CORTEX that project to the HIPPOCAMPUS. Grid cells and PLACE CELLS play a role in cognitive representation of spatial memory and navigation.

concepts.label: Perirhinal Cortex
concepts.title: Perirhinal Cortex
concepts.definition: An area in the temporal lobe that is important for memory encoding and retrieval. It is bordered caudally by the parahippocampal cortex (see HIPPOCAMPUS) and ventrally and medially by the ENTORHINAL CORTEX.

concepts.label: Axon Initial Segment
concepts.title: Axon Initial Segment
concepts.definition: First segment of axon that connects distal axon segments to the neuronal CELL BODY at the axon hillock region. The axon initial segment is not protected by the MYELIN SHEATH and has properties critical for axonal growth. The axon initial segment and the axon hillock form an axonal trigger zone.

concepts.label: Tardive Dyskinesia
concepts.title: Tardive Dyskinesia
concepts.definition: Drug-related movement disorder characterized by uncontrollable movements in certain muscles. It is associated with a long-term exposure to certain neuroleptic medications (e.g., METOCLOPRAMIDE).

concepts.label: Alert Fatigue, Health Personnel
concepts.title: Alert Fatigue, Health Personnel
concepts.definition: Mental fatigue experienced by health care providers who encounter numerous alerts and reminders from the use of CLINICAL DECISION SUPPORT SYSTEMS. As the numbers of alerts and reminders designed to provide meaningful assistance to the patient care process increases, many health personnel may ignore them.

concepts.label: Acute Febrile Encephalopathy
concepts.title: Acute Febrile Encephalopathy
concepts.definition: Acute onset of fever accompanied by seizures, cerebral inflammation and a change in mental status (e.g., confusion, disorientation, and coma).

concepts.label: Small Fiber Neuropathy
concepts.title: Small Fiber Neuropathy
concepts.definition: Disorder of the peripheral nerves that primarily impair small nerve fibers. The affected small nerve fibers include myelinated A-delta fibers (see A FIBERS) and unmyelinated C FIBERS. Because these small fibers innervate skin and help control autonomic function, their neuropathy presents with neuropathic pain, reduced thermal and pain sensitivity, and autonomic dysfunction (e.g. abnormal sweating or facial flushing). Small fiber neuropathy can be idiopathic or associated with underlying diseases (e.g., AMYLOIDOSIS; DIABETES MELLITUS; SARCOIDOSIS; or VASCULITIS).

concepts.label: Cortical Excitability
concepts.title: Cortical Excitability
concepts.definition: Measurable changes in activities in the CEREBRAL CORTEX upon a stimulation. A change in cortical excitability as measured by various techniques (e.g., TRANSCRANIAL MAGNETIC STIMULATION) is associated with brain disorders.

concepts.label: Emergence Delirium
concepts.title: Emergence Delirium
concepts.definition: A form of DELIRIUM which occurs after GENERAL ANESTHESIA.

concepts.label: Harassment, Non-Sexual
concepts.title: Harassment, Non-Sexual
concepts.definition: The act of systematic and/or continuous unwanted and irritating actions of a non-sexual nature, by a party or group against another. This behavior may include threats, BULLYING, taunts, blackmail, and demands.

concepts.label: Axon Guidance
concepts.title: Axon Guidance
concepts.definition: The mechanism by which a neuronal process outgrows toward a target led by the GROWTH CONE. Local guidance cues are provided by cell surface proteins that act on the growing axon.

concepts.label: Emotion-Focused Therapy
concepts.title: Emotion-Focused Therapy
concepts.definition: Intervention that relies on free expression of emotions with coaching to enhance awareness of emotional experiences.

concepts.label: Taxis Response
concepts.title: Taxis Response
concepts.definition: A behavior in free-moving organism that results in motion or orientation toward or away from an external stimulus.

concepts.label: Phototaxis
concepts.title: Phototaxis
concepts.definition: A behavioral change that results in an organism moving or orienting toward or away from the light source.

concepts.label: Neuronal Outgrowth
concepts.title: Neuronal Outgrowth
concepts.definition: Formation of neuronal processes (AXONS; NEURITES) toward a target cell.

concepts.label: Axon Fasciculation
concepts.title: Axon Fasciculation
concepts.definition: Process of organizing neighboring AXONS into a bundle or a fascicle during neurite outgrowth mediated by CELL ADHESION MOLECULES.

concepts.label: Bilateral Vestibulopathy
concepts.title: Bilateral Vestibulopathy
concepts.definition: Impairment of the vestibular function of both inner ears which can cause difficulties with balance, gait, VERTIGO, and visual blurring.

concepts.label: Diet, Healthy
concepts.title: Diet, Healthy
concepts.definition: Dietary patterns which have been found to be important in reducing disease risk.

concepts.label: Prion Proteins
concepts.title: Prion Proteins
concepts.definition: Membrane glycosylphosphatidylinositol-anchored glycoproteins that may aggregate into rod-like structures. The prion protein (PRNP) gene is characterized by five TANDEM REPEAT SEQUENCES that encode a highly unstable protein region of five octapeptide repeats. Mutations in the repeat region and elsewhere in this gene are associated with CREUTZFELDT-JAKOB DISEASE; FATAL FAMILIAL INSOMNIA; GERSTMANN-STRAUSSLER DISEASE; Huntington disease-like 1, and KURU.

concepts.label: Deubiquitinating Enzymes
concepts.title: Deubiquitinating Enzymes
concepts.definition: Enzymes that remove UBIQUITIN from a protein substrate, including POLYUBIQUITIN, or from other molecules.

concepts.label: Vaping
concepts.title: Vaping
concepts.definition: Inhaling of vapors produced by ELECTRONIC NICOTINE DELIVERY SYSTEMS such as E-CIGARETTES.

concepts.label: Sexual and Gender Minorities
concepts.title: Sexual and Gender Minorities
concepts.definition: Individuals including lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, intersex, asexual, gender non-conforming people, and other populations whose sexual orientation or GENDER IDENTITY and reproductive development is considered outside cultural, societal, or physiological norms.

concepts.label: Applied Behavior Analysis
concepts.title: Applied Behavior Analysis
concepts.definition: Behavioral science applied with the aim of improving socially important issues such as behavior problems and learning. For individuals diagnosed with intellectual and developmental disabilities including AUTISM, techniques can be categorized as comprehensive or focused.

concepts.label: Protein Structural Elements
concepts.title: Protein Structural Elements
concepts.definition: Distinguishing three-dimensional structures characteristically formed by homologous protein sequences.

concepts.label: Protein Domains
concepts.title: Protein Domains
concepts.definition: Discrete protein structural units that may fold independently of the rest of the protein and have their own functions.

concepts.label: Orientation, Spatial
concepts.title: Orientation, Spatial
concepts.definition: Change in position or alignment in response to an external stimulus.

concepts.label: Cognitive Remediation
concepts.title: Cognitive Remediation
concepts.definition: Behavioral treatment that uses drill and practice, compensatory and adaptive strategies to facilitate improvement in targeted learning areas.

concepts.label: Heterocyclic Compounds, Fused-Ring
concepts.title: Heterocyclic Compounds, Fused-Ring
concepts.definition: Multiple ring heterocyclic compounds containing two or more rings that share two atoms and one bond in common.

concepts.label: Fused-Ring Compounds
concepts.title: Fused-Ring Compounds
concepts.definition: Polycyclic compounds with adjacent rings that share the same two adjacent atoms.

concepts.label: Moral Status
concepts.title: Moral Status
concepts.definition: A philosophical description of intrinsic self-worth and dignity which bestows basic rights of life, liberty, and freedom from harm.

concepts.label: Cardiorespiratory Fitness
concepts.title: Cardiorespiratory Fitness
concepts.definition: A measure of the functional capabilities of the heart, lungs and muscles, relative to the demands of specific exercise routines such as running or cycling.

concepts.label: Perfectionism
concepts.title: Perfectionism
concepts.definition: A personality trait characterized by a person's striving for flawlessness and setting excessively high performance standards, accompanied by overly critical self-evaluations and concerns regarding others' evaluations.

concepts.label: Hypophysitis
concepts.title: Hypophysitis
concepts.definition: Inflammation of the PITUITARY GLAND.

concepts.label: Ciliopathies
concepts.title: Ciliopathies
concepts.definition: Genetic disorders caused by defects in genes related to the primary CILIUM; BASAL BODY; or CENTROSOME. Primary features may include obesity, SKELETAL DYSPLASIA; POLYDACTYLY and malformations that primarily involve the liver, eye or kidneys.

concepts.label: High-Intensity Interval Training
concepts.title: High-Intensity Interval Training
concepts.definition: A cardiovascular exercise strategy with alternating short periods of intense anaerobic exercise with less-intense recovery periods.

concepts.label: Social Segregation
concepts.title: Social Segregation
concepts.definition: Barriers based on group membership.

concepts.label: Cancer Pain
concepts.title: Cancer Pain
concepts.definition: Pain that may be caused by or related to cellular, tissue, and systemic changes that occur during NEOPLASM growth, tissue invasion, and METASTASIS.

concepts.label: Invasive Fungal Infections
concepts.title: Invasive Fungal Infections
concepts.definition: Mycoses which manifest as infections of deep tissue or blood.

concepts.label: Vaccination Refusal
concepts.title: Vaccination Refusal
concepts.definition: Refusal to receive VACCINATION.

concepts.label: Host-Seeking Behavior
concepts.title: Host-Seeking Behavior
concepts.definition: Searching behavior by parasitic or commensal organisms, to find animals or plants that are a source of nourishment and habitation.

concepts.label: Walking Speed
concepts.title: Walking Speed
concepts.definition: The rate at which steps are made while walking.

concepts.label: Stair Climbing
concepts.title: Stair Climbing
concepts.definition: Ascending or descending stairs.

concepts.label: Ecological Momentary Assessment
concepts.title: Ecological Momentary Assessment
concepts.definition: Repeated reports by a research participant of symptoms, affect, behavior, and cognition close in time to experience and in the participant's natural environment.

concepts.label: Phobia, Social
concepts.title: Phobia, Social
concepts.definition: Anxiety disorder characterized by the persistent and irrational fear, anxiety, or avoidance of social or performance situations.

concepts.label: Mental Status and Dementia Tests
concepts.title: Mental Status and Dementia Tests
concepts.definition: Tests designed to assess various aspects of neurocognitive function or dementia.

concepts.label: Wisconsin Card Sorting Test
concepts.title: Wisconsin Card Sorting Test
concepts.definition: A neuropsychological test designed to assess EXECUTIVE FUNCTION typically assigned to the FRONTAL LOBE (e.g., abstract thinking, and strategic planning). The subjects are asked to sort numbered response cards according to different principles and to alter their approach during testing.

concepts.label: Memory and Learning Tests
concepts.title: Memory and Learning Tests
concepts.definition: Tests designed to evaluate general and specific areas of behaviors and abilities associated with memory and/or learning.

concepts.label: Wechsler Memory Scale
concepts.title: Wechsler Memory Scale
concepts.definition: A neuropsychological test designed to assess different memory functions. It may incorporate an optional cognitive exam (Brief Cognitive Status Exam) that helps to assess memory related cognitive function.

concepts.label: Patient Health Questionnaire
concepts.title: Patient Health Questionnaire
concepts.definition: A self-administered version of the Primary Care Evaluation of Mental Disorders (PRIME-MD), a diagnostic tool containing modules on multiple mental health disorders including anxiety, alcohol, eating, and somatoform modules. The Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-9) is designed specifically for mood/depression scoring each of the 9 DSM-IV criteria based on the mood module from the original PRIME-MD. The Generalized Anxiety Disorder scale (GAD-7) scores 7 common anxiety symptoms.

concepts.label: Models, Spatial Interaction
concepts.title: Models, Spatial Interaction
concepts.definition: Estimates of the flow of people, material or information between locations in geographic space.

concepts.label: Psycho-Oncology
concepts.title: Psycho-Oncology
concepts.definition: A specialty which deals with the interrelationship of physical, psychological, social, behavioral, and ethical aspects of cancer. Psycho-oncology examines the behavioral and psychosocial factors that may influence the course of the disease, cancer risk, prevention, and detection.

concepts.label: Epileptic Syndromes
concepts.title: Epileptic Syndromes
concepts.definition: EPILEPTIC SEIZURES that are of similar type and age of onset and have other similar features (e.g., clinical course, EEG findings, genetic association and neuropathology).

concepts.label: Occupational Stress
concepts.title: Occupational Stress
concepts.definition: Adverse psychological and behavioral reactions caused by the pressures and demands of employers or clients or other factors, such as the physical environment of the workplace, WORKPLACE VIOLENCE; or WORKPLACE BULLYING.

concepts.label: Multitasking Behavior
concepts.title: Multitasking Behavior
concepts.definition: Simultaneous task performance, or switching between tasks in a concentrated period of time.

concepts.label: Eutheria
concepts.title: Eutheria
concepts.definition: Mammals which nourish their young in utero by means of a complex placenta, and give birth to their young alive. They include PRIMATES; CARNIVORA, WHALES; RUMINANTS; BATS; and RODENTS.

concepts.label: Shift Work Schedule
concepts.title: Shift Work Schedule
concepts.definition: Job schedule in which working hours deviate from the standard hours (e.g., evening shift, night shift or rotating shift).

concepts.label: Stakeholder Participation
concepts.title: Stakeholder Participation
concepts.definition: A process between an entity and those groups or individuals potentially or actually impacted by the actions of that entity over a range of activities and approaches.

concepts.label: Health Risk Behaviors
concepts.title: Health Risk Behaviors
concepts.definition: Pattern of behavior which predisposes certain individuals to increased risk for contracting disease or sustaining personal injury. These behaviors may cluster into a risky lifestyle.

concepts.label: Varicella Zoster Virus Infection
concepts.title: Varicella Zoster Virus Infection
concepts.definition: Infection caused by HUMAN HERPES VIRUS 3 (e.g., CHICKENPOX and HERPES ZOSTER).

concepts.label: Symbolic Interactionism
concepts.title: Symbolic Interactionism
concepts.definition: Theoretical approach to social processes with a fundamental concern with power phenomena. There is a focus on the analysis of culture, the influence of Foucault, and the development of feminist perspectives.

concepts.label: Oligodendrocyte Precursor Cells
concepts.title: Oligodendrocyte Precursor Cells
concepts.definition: Neuroglial cells that first appear during mid-embryogenesis in the central nervous system of mammals and give rise to OLIGODENDROCYTES. Mitotically-active populations remain through late adulthood and are capable of regenerating MYELIN lost to disease or injury.

concepts.label: Healthy Aging
concepts.title: Healthy Aging
concepts.definition: The development and maintenance of optimal physical, mental, spiritual, and social well-being and function with advancing age.

concepts.label: Water Sports
concepts.title: Water Sports
concepts.definition: Activities or games performed in a body of water.

concepts.label: P-type ATPases
concepts.title: P-type ATPases
concepts.definition: A highly conserved family of ATPases that facilitate the transport of lipids and cations across the plasma membrane. Structurally, they are elongated ALPHA-HELICES constituting five functionally distinct domains: three cytoplasmic domains A, N, and P which contain the catalytic sites, and two transmembrane domains. The N domain phosphorylates the P-domain at an invariant ASPARTATE residue, which, in turn, is dephosphorylated by the A domain.  The phosphorylation and dephosphorylation cycles drive conformational changes in the protein between two states (E1 and E2), which allow the substrate to access the other side of the membrane.

concepts.label: Procedural Pain
concepts.title: Procedural Pain
concepts.definition: Pain associated with examination, treatment or procedures.

concepts.label: Self-Directed Learning as Topic
concepts.title: Self-Directed Learning as Topic
concepts.definition: Process in which individuals take the initiative, in diagnosing their learning needs, formulating learning goals, identifying resources for learning, choosing and implementing learning strategies and evaluating learning outcomes (Knowles, 1975)

concepts.label: Scholarly Communication
concepts.title: Scholarly Communication
concepts.definition: System through which research and other scholarly writings are created, evaluated for quality, disseminated to the scholarly community, and preserved for future use. It includes both formal means of communication, such as publication in peer-reviewed journals, and informal channels, such as electronic listservs. (from Association of College & Research Libraries, “Principles and Strategies for the Reform of Scholarly Communication 1,” 2003)

concepts.label: Trisomy 13 Syndrome
concepts.title: Trisomy 13 Syndrome
concepts.definition: A chromosome disorder associated with TRISOMY of all or part of CHROMOSOME 13. Clinical manifestations include CONGENITAL HEART DEFECTS (e.g., PATENT DUCTUS ARTERIOSUS), facial malformations (e.g., CLEFT LIP; CLEFT PALATE; COLOBOMA; MICROPHTHALMIA); HYPOTONIA, digit malformations (e.g., POLYDACTYLY or SYNDACTYLY), and SEIZURES and severe INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY associated with NERVOUS SYSTEM MALFORMATIONS.

concepts.label: Copper-Transporting ATPases
concepts.title: Copper-Transporting ATPases
concepts.definition: P-type ATPases which transport copper ions across membranes in prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells. They possess a conserved CYSTEINE-HISTIDINE-SERINE (CPx) amino acid motif within their transmembrane helices that functions in cation translocation and catalytic activation, and an N-terminal copper-binding CxxC motif that regulates enzyme activity. They play essential roles in intracellular copper homeostasis through regulating the uptake, efflux and storage of copper ions, and in cuproprotein biosynthesis.

concepts.label: Smoking, Non-Tobacco Products
concepts.title: Smoking, Non-Tobacco Products
concepts.definition: SMOKING of non-TOBACCO (or NICOTINE-containing) substances.

concepts.label: Survivorship
concepts.title: Survivorship
concepts.definition: Functional, psychosocial, emotional and spiritual domains and needs of patients and families following life-threatening disease or events.

concepts.label: Cigar Smoking
concepts.title: Cigar Smoking
concepts.definition: The SMOKING of CIGARS.

concepts.label: Cigarette Smoking
concepts.title: Cigarette Smoking
concepts.definition: The SMOKING of CIGARETTES.

concepts.label: Water Pipe Smoking
concepts.title: Water Pipe Smoking
concepts.definition: A process by which SMOKE produced from burning substance is mixed with flavor-altering substances and drawn through water or other liquid into the mouth.

concepts.label: Pipe Smoking
concepts.title: Pipe Smoking
concepts.definition: SMOKING by use of a narrow conveying tube which feeds from an open cavity where smoked product is loaded and burned.

concepts.label: Tobacco Smoking
concepts.title: Tobacco Smoking
concepts.definition: The process of SMOKING specific to TOBACCO.

concepts.label: Sugars
concepts.title: Sugars
concepts.definition: Short chain carbohydrate molecules that have hydroxyl groups attached to each carbon atom unit with the exception of one carbon that has a doubly-bond aldehyde or ketone oxygen. Cyclical sugar molecules are formed when the aldehyde or ketone groups respectively form a hemiacetal or hemiketal bond with one of the hydroxyl carbons. The three dimensional structure of the sugar molecule occurs in a vast array of biological and synthetic classes of specialized compounds including AMINO SUGARS; CARBASUGARS; DEOXY SUGARS; SUGAR ACIDS; SUGAR ALCOHOLS; and SUGAR PHOSPHATES.

concepts.label: Adverse Outcome Pathways
concepts.title: Adverse Outcome Pathways
concepts.definition: Models connecting initiating events at the cellular and molecular level to population-wide impacts. Computational models may be at levels relating toxicology to adverse effects.

concepts.label: Food Addiction
concepts.title: Food Addiction
concepts.definition: A cluster of chemical dependencies to specific foods or food in general in which there develops a physical craving for these foods.

concepts.label: Narrative Medicine
concepts.title: Narrative Medicine
concepts.definition: NARRATION as a tool to collect and interpret information on a patient's experience of illness

concepts.label: Receptors, Histamine H4
concepts.title: Receptors, Histamine H4
