concepts.definition: G-Protein-coupled histamine receptors that are expressed primarily in BONE MARROW as well as in peripheral tissues and organs. They are expressed by immune cells that include EOSINOPHILS; T-CELLS; DENDRITIC CELLS; and MAST CELLS.

concepts.label: Cerebral Intraventricular Hemorrhage
concepts.title: Cerebral Intraventricular Hemorrhage
concepts.definition: Bleeding within the CEREBRAL VENTRICLES. It is associated with intraventricular trauma, aneurysm, vascular malformations, hypertension and in VERY LOW BIRTH WEIGHT infants.

concepts.label: Night Eating Syndrome
concepts.title: Night Eating Syndrome
concepts.definition: Little or no appetite for breakfast due to eating more food after dinner than during the meal and eating more than half of daily food intake after dinner hour.

concepts.label: Cocaine Smoking
concepts.title: Cocaine Smoking
concepts.definition: SMOKING of COCAINE.

concepts.label: Rumination, Cognitive
concepts.title: Rumination, Cognitive
concepts.definition: Obsessive thinking about an idea, situation, or choice.

concepts.label: Smoking Reduction
concepts.title: Smoking Reduction
concepts.definition: A decrease in the incidence and frequency of SMOKING. Smoking reduction differs from SMOKING CESSATION in that the smoker continues to smoke albeit at a lesser frequency without quitting.

concepts.label: Sleep Latency
concepts.title: Sleep Latency
concepts.definition: The time it takes to reach REM SLEEP. It is typically measured by POLYSOMNOGRAPHY or EEG as a part of various sleep pattern tests (e.g., multiple sleep latency test).

concepts.label: Sexual Health
concepts.title: Sexual Health
concepts.definition: A state of physical, emotional, mental and social well-being in relation to SEXUALITY, according to the World Health Organization.

concepts.label: Suprachiasmatic Nucleus Neurons
concepts.title: Suprachiasmatic Nucleus Neurons
concepts.definition: Neurons of the SUPRACHIASMATIC NUCLEUS.

concepts.label: Remyelination
concepts.title: Remyelination
concepts.definition: The reforming of the MYELIN SHEATH around AXONS following loss due to injury or DEMYELINATING DISEASES.

concepts.label: Opium Dependence
concepts.title: Opium Dependence
concepts.definition: Strong physiological and emotional dependence on OPIUM.

concepts.label: Marijuana Use
concepts.title: Marijuana Use
concepts.definition: Medicinal or recreational utilization of MARIJUANA.

concepts.label: Human Genetics
concepts.title: Human Genetics
concepts.definition: The scientific study of inherited human variation.

concepts.label: Treatment Adherence and Compliance
concepts.title: Treatment Adherence and Compliance
concepts.definition: Extent to which the patient follows prescribed treatment such as keeping APPOINTMENTS AND SCHEDULES and MEDICATION ADHERENCE for desired therapeutic outcome. It implies active responsibility shared by patient and health care providers.

concepts.label: Body Packing
concepts.title: Body Packing
concepts.definition: Concealing of drugs within the gastrointestinal tract or other body orifice for purposes of DRUG SMUGGLING or to avoid detection by law enforcement. Contraband other than drugs is also sometimes smuggled this way.

concepts.label: Substance Abuse, Oral
concepts.title: Substance Abuse, Oral
concepts.definition: Abuse, overuse, or misuse of a substance by ingestion.

concepts.label: Incivility
concepts.title: Incivility
concepts.definition: Low-intensity deviant behavior with ambiguous intent to harm the target, in violation of norms for mutual respect.

concepts.label: Heavy Metal Poisoning
concepts.title: Heavy Metal Poisoning
concepts.definition: Poisoning that results from chronic or acute ingestion, injection, inhalation, or skin absorption of HEAVY METALS. Acute and chronic exposures can cause ANEMIA; KIDNEY and LIVER damage; PULMONARY EDEMA; MEMORY LOSS and behavioral changes; bone deformities in children; and MISCARRIAGE or PREMATURE LABOR in PREGNANT PEOPLE.

concepts.label: Neuroticism
concepts.title: Neuroticism
concepts.definition: Personality trait related to tendency to respond to threat, frustration or a loss with negative emotions (e.g., ANGER; ANXIETY; FRUSTRATION; embarrassment and sadness).

concepts.label: Organ Motion
concepts.title: Organ Motion
concepts.definition: Movement of internal organs due to physiological processes.

concepts.label: Charles Bonnet Syndrome
concepts.title: Charles Bonnet Syndrome
concepts.definition: Repetitive visual hallucinations experienced mostly by elderly with diminished visual acuity or visual field loss, with awareness of the fictional nature of their hallucinations. It is not associated with delusions and other sensory hallucinations.

concepts.label: Recidivism
concepts.title: Recidivism
concepts.definition: Repeated criminal behavior.

concepts.label: Procrastination
concepts.title: Procrastination
concepts.definition: The deferment of actions or tasks to a later time, or to infinity.

concepts.label: Cell Phone Use
concepts.title: Cell Phone Use
concepts.definition: Utilization of wireless phones for communication.

concepts.label: Alcoholic Korsakoff Syndrome
concepts.title: Alcoholic Korsakoff Syndrome
concepts.definition: A neurological disorder characterized by inattentiveness and the inability to form short term memories. It is caused by THIAMINE DEFICIENCY due to chronic ALCOHOLISM.

concepts.label: Drug Misuse
concepts.title: Drug Misuse
concepts.definition: Use of a drug for a purpose not consistent with legal or medical guidelines.

concepts.label: Travel-Related Illness
concepts.title: Travel-Related Illness
concepts.definition: Health problems associated with TRAVEL.

concepts.label: Virtual Reality
concepts.title: Virtual Reality
concepts.definition: Using computer technology to create and maintain an environment and project a user's physical presence in that environment allowing the user to interact with it.

concepts.label: Wearable Electronic Devices
concepts.title: Wearable Electronic Devices
concepts.definition: Electronic implements worn on  the body as an implant or as an accessory. Examples include wearable diagnostic devices, wearable ACTIVITY TRACKERS, wearable INFUSION PUMPS, wearable computing devices, SENSORY AIDS, and electronic pest repellents.

concepts.label: Mentalization
concepts.title: Mentalization
concepts.definition: The mental process by which an individual implicitly and explicitly interprets the actions of self and others as meaningful on the basis of intentional mental states such as personal desires, needs, feelings, beliefs, and reasons.

concepts.label: Disenfranchised Grief
concepts.title: Disenfranchised Grief
concepts.definition: Expression of grief that society limits or may not allow a person to express. Examples include the grief of parents for stillborn babies, of teachers for the death of students, of nurses for the death of patients, or for the loss of an animal companion. (from APA Dictionary of Psychology, 2nd ed.)

concepts.label: Endurance Training
concepts.title: Endurance Training
concepts.definition: Exercise programs of relatively long duration and moderate intensity, which enhance maximal oxygen uptake, increasing PHYSICAL STAMINA.

concepts.label: Synthetic Drugs
concepts.title: Synthetic Drugs
concepts.definition: Legal or illegal drugs created using SYNTHETIC CHEMISTRY TECHNIQUES.

concepts.label: Pinealectomy
concepts.title: Pinealectomy
concepts.definition: Surgical removal of the PINEAL GLAND including resection of pineal tumor (PINEALOMA) and CYSTS.

concepts.label: Neonatal Brachial Plexus Palsy
concepts.title: Neonatal Brachial Plexus Palsy
concepts.definition: Perinatal nerve injury involving the BRACHIAL PLEXUS involving a weak or paralyzed upper extremity.

concepts.label: Burnout, Psychological
concepts.title: Burnout, Psychological
concepts.definition: An excessive reaction to stress caused by one's environment that may be characterized by feelings of emotional and physical exhaustion, coupled with a sense of frustration and failure.

concepts.label: Neurolymphomatosis
concepts.title: Neurolymphomatosis
concepts.definition: Infiltration of the nervous system by malignant lymphoma cells.

concepts.label: Cyberbullying
concepts.title: Cyberbullying
concepts.definition: Bullying that takes place over digital devices like cell phones and computers. It includes sending, posting, or sharing negative, harmful, false, or mean content about someone else. It can include sharing personal or private information about someone else causing embarrassment or humiliation. (from http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Dialectical Behavior Therapy
concepts.title: Dialectical Behavior Therapy
concepts.definition: A flexible, stage-based therapy that combines principles of behavior therapy, cognitive behavior therapy, and MINDFULNESS. It concurrently promotes acceptance and change, especially with difficult-to-treat patients.

concepts.label: Sleepiness
concepts.title: Sleepiness
concepts.definition: Compelling urge to sleep.

concepts.label: Latent Class Analysis
concepts.title: Latent Class Analysis
concepts.definition: A statistical algorithm used to analyze clusters of observed variables by constructing categorical unobserved or latent segment based on weighted analysis and the average probabilities. Such latent classes are used to infer variables whose relationships are not directly observed. In biomedical research, it is often used to categorize data that allows the determination of symptom clusters.

concepts.label: Bone-Anchored Prosthesis
concepts.title: Bone-Anchored Prosthesis
concepts.definition: A prosthesis designed to attach directly to the bone via fixtures implanted into the bone rather than a socket.

concepts.label: Forensic Psychology
concepts.title: Forensic Psychology
concepts.definition: A specialty in professional psychology characterized by activities primarily intended to provide professional psychological expertise within the judicial and legal systems.

concepts.label: Sleep, Slow-Wave
concepts.title: Sleep, Slow-Wave
concepts.definition: A stage of sleep characterized by synchronized wave activity as observed in the ELECTROENCEPHALOGRAM; the waves exhibit a frequency of 0.5 to 2 Hz, and a peak-to-peak amplitude greater than 75 microvolts.

concepts.label: Road Rage
concepts.title: Road Rage
concepts.definition: Extreme anger generated from a traffic incident or accident that leads to an assault with a motor vehicle or other dangerous weapon by the operator or passenger(s) of one motor vehicle on the operator or passenger(s) of another motor vehicle.

concepts.label: Biomineralization
concepts.title: Biomineralization
concepts.definition: Process by which living organisms produce MINERALS that accumulate into hardened tissues (e.g., bones, teeth and shells), and cellular nanostructures that sequester away into macromolecules. Biosynthesized minerals include CALCIUM CARBONATE; FLUOROAPATITE; HYDROXYAPATITE; and MAGNETITE.

concepts.label: Glymphatic System
concepts.title: Glymphatic System
concepts.definition: A vascular waste clearance system in the brain analogous to the lymphatic system that facilitates transporting of solutes and waste products from CEREBROSPINAL FLUID (CSF) and brain INTERSTITIAL FLUID (ISF). CSF from the SUBARACHNOID SPACE enters the brain periarterial spaces, into the interstitium via channels (e.g., AQUAPORIN 4 PROTEIN) on astrocytic endfeet and exchanges with brain ISF before perivenous drainage of solutes and waste.

concepts.label: Family Separation
concepts.title: Family Separation
concepts.definition: Geographic separation of members of a family.

concepts.label: Cauda Equina Syndrome
concepts.title: Cauda Equina Syndrome
concepts.definition: Compressive lesion affecting the nerve roots of the CAUDA EQUINA (e.g., compression, herniation, inflammation, rupture, or stenosis), which controls the function of the bladder and bowel. Symptoms may include neurological dysfunction of bladder or bowels, loss of sexual sensation and altered sensation or paralysis in the lower extremities.

concepts.label: Sitting Position
concepts.title: Sitting Position
concepts.definition: MeSH 已登记该主题词，但此条目未提供范围说明；需继续补全定义。

concepts.label: Cone Dystrophy
concepts.title: Cone Dystrophy
concepts.definition: A general term which describes a group of rare eye disorders that affect the cone cells of the RETINA. Cone dystrophy can cause a variety of symptoms including decreased visual clarity or acuity when looking straight ahead (central vision), a reduced ability to see colors, and an increased sensitivity to light (PHOTOPHOBIA).

concepts.label: Shared Governance, Nursing
concepts.title: Shared Governance, Nursing
concepts.definition: Model of nursing practice with shared decision processes designed to integrate core values and beliefs that professional practice embraces, as a means of achieving quality care.

concepts.label: Progression-Free Survival
concepts.title: Progression-Free Survival
concepts.definition: Length of time during and after the treatment of a disease, such as cancer, that a patient lives with the disease but the disease does not get worse.

concepts.label: Posttraumatic Growth, Psychological
concepts.title: Posttraumatic Growth, Psychological
concepts.definition: Positive change experienced as a result of the struggle with a major life crisis or a traumatic event.

concepts.label: Correlation of Data
concepts.title: Correlation of Data
concepts.definition: Determination of whether or not two variables are correlated. This means to study whether an increase or decrease in one variable corresponds to an increase or decrease in the other variable.

concepts.label: Data Analysis
concepts.title: Data Analysis
concepts.definition: Process of systematically applying statistical and/or logical techniques to describe and illustrate, condense and recap, and evaluate data (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Facilities and Services Utilization
concepts.title: Facilities and Services Utilization
concepts.definition: Extent of use of facilities or services. It includes overuse and underuse.

concepts.label: Procedures and Techniques Utilization
concepts.title: Procedures and Techniques Utilization
concepts.definition: Extent of use of procedures or techniques. It includes overuse and underuse.

concepts.label: Equipment and Supplies Utilization
concepts.title: Equipment and Supplies Utilization
concepts.definition: Extent of use of equipment or supplies. It includes overuse and underuse.

concepts.label: Disgust
concepts.title: Disgust
concepts.definition: A feeling of revulsion or strong disapproval aroused by something unpleasant or offensive.

concepts.label: Embarrassment
concepts.title: Embarrassment
concepts.definition: A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.

concepts.label: Epidermal Cells
concepts.title: Epidermal Cells
concepts.definition: Cells from the outermost, non-vascular layer (EPIDERMIS) of the skin.

concepts.label: Therapeutic Alliance
concepts.title: Therapeutic Alliance
concepts.definition: A relational factor in counseling that includes three dimensions: goal consensus between counselor and client, collaboration on counseling-related tasks, and emotional bonding.  It is referred to as the working alliance between a therapist and a client in psychotherapy and closely correlated with positive client outcomes.

concepts.label: Sadness
concepts.title: Sadness
concepts.definition: Feeling or showing sorrow; the sense of being unhappy. It is related to DEPRESSION but is not synonymous.

concepts.label: Egocentrism
concepts.title: Egocentrism
concepts.definition: Self-centered preoccupation or concern regarding one's own needs, abilities, wishes, desires, or preferences.

concepts.label: Respect
concepts.title: Respect
concepts.definition: A feeling of deep admiration for someone or something elicited by their abilities, qualities, or achievements and regard for the feelings, wishes, or rights of others.

concepts.label: Standing Position
concepts.title: Standing Position
concepts.definition: Human position in which the body is held in an upright orthostatic position and supported only by the feet.

concepts.label: Interpersonal Psychotherapy
concepts.title: Interpersonal Psychotherapy
concepts.definition: Interpersonal modification of psychodynamic psychotherapy. Therapy is present-focused and seeks to resolve problems in interpersonal relations. Aspects of attachment theory are used to analyze how past relationships affect current relationships.

concepts.label: Empowerment
concepts.title: Empowerment
concepts.definition: Process of increasing the capacity of individuals or groups to make choices and to transform those choices into desired actions as deigned by the individuals or groups.

concepts.label: Scope of Practice
concepts.title: Scope of Practice
concepts.definition: The services that licensed professionals are deemed competent to perform, and permitted to undertake in keeping with the terms of their professional license.

concepts.label: Body Dissatisfaction
concepts.title: Body Dissatisfaction
concepts.definition: Person’s negative thoughts about his or her own body.  This includes judgements about size and shape, muscle tone and generally involves a discrepancy between one's own body type and an ideal body type. (Grogan, 2008)

concepts.label: Demoralization
concepts.title: Demoralization
concepts.definition: Weakening of hope, courage, or confidence.

concepts.label: Psychological Distress
concepts.title: Psychological Distress
concepts.definition: Negative emotional state characterized by physical and/or emotional discomfort, pain, or anguish.

concepts.label: Involuntary Commitment
concepts.title: Involuntary Commitment
concepts.definition: Non-voluntary institutionalization or isolation following refusal or failure to take medication, to complete treatment, or to adhere to infection control precautions, or behavior that may or does endanger self or others.

concepts.label: Weight Prejudice
concepts.title: Weight Prejudice
concepts.definition: Negative attitudes towards and beliefs about others because of their weight. These negative attitudes are manifested by stereotypes and/or prejudice towards people with weight over or under a cultural norm.

concepts.label: Vector Borne Diseases
concepts.title: Vector Borne Diseases
concepts.definition: Infectious diseases transmitted by DISEASE VECTORS.

concepts.label: Claustrum
concepts.title: Claustrum
concepts.definition: A gray matter lamina located underneath the inner NEOCORTEX lateral to the PUTAMEN and medial to the INSULAR CORTEX. It is considered to be a part of the basal ganglia. Extensive claustral projections exist to most cortices and subcortical structures including the AMYGDALA, the CAUDATE NUCLEUS, the HIPPOCAMPUS and the THALAMUS.

concepts.label: Narcotic-Related Disorders
concepts.title: Narcotic-Related Disorders
concepts.definition: Disorders related to or resulting from abuse or misuse of NARCOTICS.

concepts.label: Rumination Syndrome
concepts.title: Rumination Syndrome
concepts.definition: A gastrointestinal disorder characterized by repetitive and effortless regurgitation of ingested food from the stomach to the oral cavity in the early POSTPRANDIAL PERIOD. It is associated with functional gastrointestinal pathology (e.g., increased intra-gastric pressure) and psychiatric disorders (e.g., anxiety, depression). It is not limited to infants and distinct from GERD and VOMITING.

concepts.label: Globus Sensation
concepts.title: Globus Sensation
concepts.definition: A feeling of a lump in the throat that occurs between meals in the absence of other gastrointestinal and motility disorders (e.g., DYSPHAGIA; GASTROESOPHAGEAL REFLUX).

concepts.label: Military Health
concepts.title: Military Health
concepts.definition: The physical and mental conditions of MILITARY PERSONNEL and the MILITARY FAMILY.

concepts.label: Opioid-Induced Constipation
concepts.title: Opioid-Induced Constipation
concepts.definition: CONSTIPATION associated with the use of OPIOIDS.

concepts.label: Postoperative Cognitive Complications
concepts.title: Postoperative Cognitive Complications
concepts.definition: COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT or functional decline after a surgical procedure.

concepts.label: Copper Transport Proteins
concepts.title: Copper Transport Proteins
concepts.definition: Membrane proteins that facilitate the transport of copper cations across biological membranes.

concepts.label: Psychology, Positive
concepts.title: Psychology, Positive
concepts.definition: The scientific study of the strengths that enable individuals and communities to thrive. It is founded on the belief that people want to lead meaningful and fulfilling lives, to cultivate what is best within themselves, and to enhance their experiences of love, work, and play. (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Historical Trauma
concepts.title: Historical Trauma
concepts.definition: Clinical distress among descendants of survivors of mass trauma, as if they had suffered through the same extreme historic circumstances. Symptoms may persist through generations.

concepts.label: Emotional Regulation
concepts.title: Emotional Regulation
concepts.definition: The manifestation of an emotional response by which individuals influence the intensity, duration, valence, or manifestation of their response. Emotion regulation either precedes (avoidance, interpretation) or follows an emotion (suppression, reappraisal). Emotion regulation is distinct from coping (focuses primarily on decreasing a negative emotional experience), and can include increasing or decreasing both positive and negative emotions consciously or unconsciously.

concepts.label: Avoidant Restrictive Food Intake Disorder
concepts.title: Avoidant Restrictive Food Intake Disorder
concepts.definition: An eating or feeding disturbance (e.g., apparent lack of interest in eating or food; avoidance based on the sensory characteristics of food; concern about aversive consequences of eating) as manifested by persistent failure to meet appropriate nutritional and/or energy needs associated with one (or more) of the following: significant weight loss (or failure to achieve expected weight gain or faltering growth in children); significant nutritional deficiency; dependence on enteral feeding or oral nutritional supplements; or marked interference with psychosocial functioning. (from DSM-V)

concepts.label: Synesthesia
concepts.title: Synesthesia
concepts.definition: The experience of involuntary sensory cross activation where the presentation of a particular stimulus elicits a secondary sensory-perceptual experience. It most commonly occurs in the association of color with linguistic stimuli such as letters, numbers, words, or music, but can also occur between other senses. Although synesthesia can be acquired or transient due to trauma or drug use, there is also a strong genetic component, with a prevalence of about 1 in 2,000 individuals and a female to male ratio of 6:1.

concepts.label: Optic Nerve Hypoplasia
concepts.title: Optic Nerve Hypoplasia
concepts.definition: A group of rare genetic disorders characterized by underdeveloped OPTIC NERVES, resulting in increased incidences of vision impairment, CONGENITAL NYSTAGMUS and STRABISMUS. It may be syndromic, and is often associated with CNS malformations.

concepts.label: Locked-In Syndrome
concepts.title: Locked-In Syndrome
concepts.definition: Acquired neuromuscular disorder characterized by complete paralysis of voluntary muscles and lower CRANIAL NERVES except for limited voluntary eye movements. It is due to various cerebrospinal disconnections at or near the PONS and the POSTERIOR CRANIAL FOSSA, typically secondary to pontine hemorrhage or infarct. Because cognitive function is intact it is sometimes referred to as a pseudocoma state.

concepts.label: Social Integration
concepts.title: Social Integration
concepts.definition: A dynamic and principled process where all members participate in dialogue to achieve and maintain peaceful social relations. It does not include coerced assimilation or forced integration. (from http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma
concepts.title: Diffuse Intrinsic Pontine Glioma
concepts.definition: A rare, aggressive brain tumor that forms in the GLIAL CELLS in the PONS.

concepts.label: Sudden Unexpected Death in Epilepsy
concepts.title: Sudden Unexpected Death in Epilepsy
concepts.definition: Sudden death in a patient with EPILEPSY associated with SEIZURES and seizure-related symptoms (e.g., APNEA; HYPOXEMIA) without other identifiable accidental causes (e.g., DROWNING; WOUNDS AND INJURIES).

concepts.label: Decision Making, Shared
concepts.title: Decision Making, Shared
concepts.definition: Collaborative process of reaching a decision.

concepts.label: Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport
concepts.title: Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport
concepts.definition: Health disorders associated with low caloric intake of individuals involved in high-activity SPORTS.
aliases: RED S Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport
RED-S Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport

concepts.label: Synucleinopathies
concepts.title: Synucleinopathies
concepts.definition: Neurodegenerative disorders involving deposition of abnormal ALPHA-SYNUCLEIN in dopaminergic neurons and glial cells in the brain. Pathological aggregations of alpha-synuclein proteins results in LEWY BODIES and Lewy neurites; melanin granules in the SUBSTANTIA NIGRA and LOCUS COERULEUS; and glial cytoplasmic inclusions. Synucleinopathies are associated with mutation in the ALPHA-SYNUCLEIN (SNCA) gene on chromosome 4. PARKINSON DISEASE; LEWY BODY DISEASE with dementia; and MULTIPLE SYSTEM ATROPHY are prominent examples of synucleinopathy.

concepts.label: Diabulimia
concepts.title: Diabulimia
concepts.definition: Eating disorder occurring typically in patients with DIABETES MELLITUS, TYPE 1 who restrict INSULIN intake in order to lose weight.

concepts.label: Specific Language Disorder
concepts.title: Specific Language Disorder
concepts.definition: Language disorder that delays the mastery of oral language skills or  in children who have no hearing loss or other developmental delays.

concepts.label: Mandibular Nerve Injuries
concepts.title: Mandibular Nerve Injuries
concepts.definition: Traumatic injuries to the MANDIBULAR NERVE and its branches. Note that marginal mandibular nerve injury is a type of FACIAL NERVE INJURIES. Injuries to LINGUAL NERVE branch of mandibular nerve is LINGUAL NERVE INJURIES.

concepts.label: Cerebellar Golgi Cells
concepts.title: Cerebellar Golgi Cells
concepts.definition: Inhibitory interneurons embedded in the granular layer of the CEREBELLAR CORTEX.

concepts.label: Post-Cardiac Arrest Syndrome
concepts.title: Post-Cardiac Arrest Syndrome
concepts.definition: A reperfusion syndrome characterized by various pathophysiological processes after CARDIAC ARREST.  It may include post-cardiac arrest brain injury (HYPOXIA-ISCHEMIA, BRAIN), cardiocirculatory dysfunction, (e.g., systemic ISCHEMIA), HYPERGLYCEMIA; MULTIPLE ORGAN FAILURE and delayed death.

concepts.label: Food Fussiness
concepts.title: Food Fussiness
concepts.definition: Patterns associated with eating including modes of feeding, rhythmic patterns of eating, and time intervals.

concepts.label: Suicide, Completed
concepts.title: Suicide, Completed
concepts.definition: The successful attempt to kill oneself.

concepts.label: Toxic Optic Neuropathy
concepts.title: Toxic Optic Neuropathy
concepts.definition: Damage to the eye or its function (e.g., VISUAL IMPAIRMENT) due to OPTIC NERVE damage secondary to toxic substances such as drugs used in CHEMOTHERAPY; IMMUNOTHERAPY; or RADIATION.

concepts.label: Myotoxicity
concepts.title: Myotoxicity
concepts.definition: Damage to the muscle or its function secondary to toxic substances such as drugs used in CHEMOTHERAPY; IMMUNOTHERAPY; or RADIATION.

concepts.label: Body Integrity Identity Disorder
concepts.title: Body Integrity Identity Disorder
concepts.definition: Condition in which individuals desire the amputation of one or more healthy limbs or who desire a paralysis.

concepts.label: Primary Immunodeficiency Diseases
concepts.title: Primary Immunodeficiency Diseases
concepts.definition: Genetic immunologic deficiency diseases and syndromes due to mutations in genes involved in IMMUNITY generally characterized by an increased susceptibility to infectious diseases. They are often associated with AUTOIMMUNE DISEASE manifestations.

concepts.label: Neurosteroids
concepts.title: Neurosteroids
concepts.definition: Endogenous compounds or drugs that affect neuronal excitability through modulation of specific ionotropic receptors (e.g., GABA-A RECEPTORS). Endogenous neurosteroids are steroid hormones de novo synthesized by neurons and glial cells from steroid metabolite precursors (e.g., PREGNENOLONE).

concepts.label: Marathon Running
concepts.title: Marathon Running
concepts.definition: A sporting event in which participants run a distance of approximately 26.2 miles in a race.

concepts.label: Betrayal
concepts.title: Betrayal
concepts.definition: Act of violation of trust or confidence of a moral standard, etc.

concepts.label: Dentist's Role
concepts.title: Dentist's Role
concepts.definition: The expected function of a member of the dental profession.

concepts.label: Human-Animal Interaction
concepts.title: Human-Animal Interaction
concepts.definition: Encompasses any situation where there is interchange between human(s) and animal(s) at an individual or cultural level. These interactions are diverse and idiosyncratic, and may be fleeting or profound. (http[已隐藏本地路径] accessed 8/22/2019).

concepts.label: Logotherapy
concepts.title: Logotherapy
concepts.definition: Directive existential psychotherapy that emphasizes the importance of meaning in the person's life.

concepts.label: Schema Therapy
concepts.title: Schema Therapy
concepts.definition: Therapy that emphasizes lifelong patterns, affective change techniques, and the therapeutic relationship. (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Mediation Analysis
concepts.title: Mediation Analysis
concepts.definition: A type of statistical analysis used to understand, clarify, and explain the relationship and pathway between a presumed cause (an independent variable) and effect (dependent variable) with respect to causal links (mediating variables) and/or to analyze the effect of an intervention (mediating factor/variable) on an outcome.

concepts.label: Sexual Trauma
concepts.title: Sexual Trauma
concepts.definition: Physical and psychological injuries resulting from SEXUAL VIOLENCE.

concepts.label: Compulsive Exercise
concepts.title: Compulsive Exercise
concepts.definition: Obsessive, excessive unhealthy levels of activity performed on a regular basis that overrides social activities and basic responsibilities and leads to anxiety when circumstances prevent exercise.

concepts.label: Internet Addiction Disorder
concepts.title: Internet Addiction Disorder
concepts.definition: Problematic, compulsive Internet use that results in significant impairment of person's function in daily life.

concepts.label: Open Field Test
concepts.title: Open Field Test
concepts.definition: A maze test in which an animal is placed in an open chamber designed to assess anxiety and exploratory behavior by movement patterns. In novel object recognition test various objects are added to open field to assess exploration and memory.

concepts.label: Elevated Plus Maze Test
concepts.title: Elevated Plus Maze Test
concepts.definition: A maze test in which an animal is placed on the center of elevated platform and is allowed to choose one of four arms configured like a plus sign. Animals are inherently wary of open elevated areas and tend to avoid the open arms.

concepts.label: Preoperative Exercise
concepts.title: Preoperative Exercise
concepts.definition: Various physical exercises implemented before a surgery designed for better TREATMENT OUTCOME.

concepts.label: Brain Cortical Thickness
concepts.title: Brain Cortical Thickness
concepts.definition: Measurements of the thickness of the CEREBRAL CORTEX often detected automatically from medical imaging. Abnormal changes in cortical thickness (e.g., CORTICAL THINNING) are potential biomarkers for various neuropathologies.

concepts.label: Cerebral Cortical Thinning
concepts.title: Cerebral Cortical Thinning
concepts.definition: Decrease in CEREBRAL CORTICAL THICKNESS.

concepts.label: Default Mode Network
concepts.title: Default Mode Network
concepts.definition: Brain regions which are functionally-connected that are active during resting state and deactivated when engaged in task- or attention-oriented behavioral activities as seen in cognitive imaging studies often with fMRI.

concepts.label: Sexual Selection
concepts.title: Sexual Selection
concepts.definition: A type of natural selection in which members of one sex choose to mate with members of the other sex that have genetically different components.

concepts.label: Heart Disease Risk Factors
concepts.title: Heart Disease Risk Factors
concepts.definition: Aspects of personal behavior or lifestyle, environmental exposure, inherited conditions and characteristics, which are determined to be associated with HEART DISEASES.

concepts.label: Aortic Valve Disease
concepts.title: Aortic Valve Disease
concepts.definition: Diseases involving the AORTIC VALVE functionality. Aortic valve disease often results in a backward and/or regurgitated blood flow into the LEFT VENTRICLE or a decreased blood flow from the heart. It includes congenital (e.g., bicuspid aortic valve), syndromic, and acquired (e.g., age-related, infection-associated) conditions.

concepts.label: Timbre Perception
concepts.title: Timbre Perception
concepts.definition: An ability to perceive and distinguish sound sources based on tonal quality or sound color (e.g., overtone).

concepts.label: Laminopathies
concepts.title: Laminopathies
concepts.definition: Congenital neuromuscular and muscular dystrophy diseases associated with mutations in the LAMIN TYPE A (Lamin A/C or LMNA gene). It includes CARDIOMYOPATHY, DILATED, 1A; CHARCOT-MARIE-TOOTH DISEASE, type 2B1; EMERY-DREIFUSS MUSCULAR DYSTROPHY, types 2 and 3; HUTCHINSON-GILFORD PROGERIA SYNDROME; LIPODYSTROPHY, FAMILIAL PARTIAL, TYPE 2; Malouf syndrome; Mandibuloacral dysplasia; LMNA-related muscular dystrophy; Restrictive dermopathy, lethal; Heart-hand syndrome, Slovenian type.

concepts.label: X-Linked Emery-Dreifuss Muscular Dystrophy
concepts.title: X-Linked Emery-Dreifuss Muscular Dystrophy
concepts.definition: Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy associated with mutations on emerin (EMD gene) or four and a half LIM domains 1 (FHL1 gene) both located on X chromosome.
aliases: Benign Scapuloperoneal Muscular Dystrophy with Early Contractures
X Linked Emery Dreifuss Muscular Dystrophy

concepts.label: Autosomal Emery-Dreifuss Muscular Dystrophy
concepts.title: Autosomal Emery-Dreifuss Muscular Dystrophy
concepts.definition: Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy associated with mutations on LAMINS (LMNA gene).

concepts.label: Cardiometabolic Risk Factors
concepts.title: Cardiometabolic Risk Factors
concepts.definition: A cluster of personal behavior or lifestyle, environmental exposure, inborn or inherited conditions and characteristics, which, on the basis of epidemiological evidence,  is known to be associated with CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASES and TYPE 2 DIABETES MELLITUS.

concepts.label: Ischemic Stroke
concepts.title: Ischemic Stroke
concepts.definition: Stroke due to BRAIN ISCHEMIA resulting in interruption or reduction of blood flow to a part of the brain. When obstruction is due to a BLOOD CLOT formed within in a cerebral blood vessel it is a thrombotic stroke. When obstruction is formed elsewhere and moved to block a cerebral blood vessel (see CEREBRAL EMBOLISM) it is referred to as embolic stroke. Wake-up stroke refers to ischemic stroke occurring during sleep while cryptogenic stroke refers to ischemic stroke of unknown origin.

concepts.label: Thrombotic Stroke
concepts.title: Thrombotic Stroke
concepts.definition: A type of ischemic stroke resulting from obstruction due to a BLOOD CLOT formed within in a CEREBRAL ARTERY often associated with ATHEROSCLEROSIS. A stroke due to a blood clot in a cerebral vein is a venous infarction (see VENOUS INFARCTION, BRAIN).

concepts.label: Embolic Stroke
concepts.title: Embolic Stroke
concepts.definition: An ischemic stroke due to a blood clot, emboli or other types of blockage which forms somewhere other than the brain and subsequently travels near and restricts blood flow to the brain. Most often the origin of the clot is from the heart and is referred to as cardioembolic stroke.

concepts.label: Social Cognition
concepts.title: Social Cognition
concepts.definition: Perception, interpretation, and categorizing self  judgement of one's own social behaviors and group position and those of others.

concepts.label: Hemorrhagic Stroke
concepts.title: Hemorrhagic Stroke
concepts.definition: Stroke due to rupture of a weakened blood vessel in the brain (e.g., CEREBRAL HEMISPHERES; CEREBELLUM; SUBARACHNOID SPACE).

concepts.label: Health Belief Model
concepts.title: Health Belief Model
concepts.definition: A model which is based on certain predictors of a person’s perception of threat severity, susceptibility, interventional benefits and self-efficacy about a health threat that can be used to promote and educate health behavior.

concepts.label: Transtheoretical Model
concepts.title: Transtheoretical Model
concepts.definition: A model which is based on a theory that people don’t change at once but instead rely on multiple stages of readiness to change. Each stage in turn is associated with strategies for progressing through that stage.

concepts.label: Uncinate Fasciculus
concepts.title: Uncinate Fasciculus
concepts.definition: A hook-shaped WHITE MATTER axon tract that connects the uncus and pole of the TEMPORAL LOBE, the LIMBIC SYSTEM and the FRONTAL LOBE. It innervates AMYGDALA proper.

concepts.label: Social Interaction
concepts.title: Social Interaction
concepts.definition: Process involving reciprocal response between two or more individuals. This includes the development of cooperation and competition, the influence of status and social roles, and the dynamics of group behavior, leadership, and conformity. Persistent social interaction between specific individuals leads to the formation of social relationships.

concepts.label: Test Anxiety
concepts.title: Test Anxiety
concepts.definition: Anxiety related to situations where abilities or knowledge are being tested.

concepts.label: Psychosocial Functioning
concepts.title: Psychosocial Functioning
concepts.definition: Level of and variations in social and emotional activity or behaviors.

concepts.label: Psychosocial Intervention
concepts.title: Psychosocial Intervention
concepts.definition: Psychological and social interventions by providers including psychologists, psychiatrists, social workers, counselors/therapists, primary care and other nonpsychiatric physicians, nurses, physical and occupational therapists, religious leaders, lay and peer providers, paraprofessionals and caregivers, and automated providers (e.g. internet/audio/video-delivered interventions). Combinations of provider options are sometimes used.

concepts.label: Social Comparison
concepts.title: Social Comparison
concepts.definition: Perception of one's abilities and attitudes in relation to those of others in a process that plays a significant role in self-image and subjective well-being.

concepts.label: Social Inclusion
concepts.title: Social Inclusion
concepts.definition: The process of improving the basis on which individuals and groups take part in society by improving the ability, opportunity, and dignity of those disadvantaged.

concepts.label: Social Evolution
concepts.title: Social Evolution
concepts.definition: The process of cumulative change that arises over successive generations in social interactions, especially between individuals of the same species.

concepts.label: Opiate Overdose
concepts.title: Opiate Overdose
concepts.definition: Accidental or deliberate use of an OPIOID in excess of normal dosage. It includes overdose for prescription and illicit opioids.

concepts.label: Social Defeat
concepts.title: Social Defeat
concepts.definition: Conflict between members of the same species that generates emotional and psychological stress and increased social distance.

concepts.label: Sexual Arousal
concepts.title: Sexual Arousal
concepts.definition: Physiological arousal elicited by sexual contact or by other erotic stimulation resulting in impulses being transmitted through the central nervous system.The impulses also trigger the release of sex hormones, dilation of the arteries supplying the genital areas, and inhibition of vasoconstrictor centers of the lumbar nerves.

concepts.label: Skeletal Muscle Enlargement
concepts.title: Skeletal Muscle Enlargement
concepts.definition: An increase in SKELETAL MUSCLE mass in normal muscle development. In human adults it results primarily from an increase in the size of SKELETAL MUSCLE FIBERS unlike in muscle hyperplasia where an increase in the number of skeletal muscle fibers is a major factor.

concepts.label: Multidimensional Scaling Analysis
concepts.title: Multidimensional Scaling Analysis
concepts.definition: A method of providing a visual representation of similarities among a set of data by plotting a map of perceived similarities on a set of vectors in p-dimensional space such that distances among them correspond to a function of the input matrix.

concepts.label: Chemotherapy-Related Cognitive Impairment
concepts.title: Chemotherapy-Related Cognitive Impairment
concepts.definition: The diminished or impaired mental and/or intellectual function associated with the chemical treatment of cancer.

concepts.label: Vestibulocochlear Physiological Phenomena
concepts.title: Vestibulocochlear Physiological Phenomena
concepts.definition: Processes and properties of the VESTIBULOCOCHLEAR SYSTEM and the CRANIAL NERVE VIII.

concepts.label: Morris Water Maze Test
concepts.title: Morris Water Maze Test
concepts.definition: A maze test often used to evaluate spatial learning and memory in rodent models by measuring the time it takes for a submerged platform in an open swimming arena to be found.

concepts.label: Sympathoadrenal System
concepts.title: Sympathoadrenal System
concepts.definition: A connection of the SYMPATHETIC NERVOUS SYSTEM and the ADRENAL MEDULLA of the ADRENAL GLANDS. Intra-adrenal connection from the medulla to the cortex connects the system to other neuroendocrine systems, which in concert participate in FLIGHT REACTION in stress situations. CATECHOLAMINES are the principle hormone in the system.

concepts.label: Recreational Drug Use
concepts.title: Recreational Drug Use
concepts.definition: Occasional or habitual non-prescribed, not health-related use of substances.

concepts.label: Caregiver Burden
concepts.title: Caregiver Burden
concepts.definition: The stresses or associated emotional responses experienced by CAREGIVERS when caring for the mentally or physically disabled.

concepts.label: Gender Role
concepts.title: Gender Role
concepts.definition: Social role encompassing a range of behaviors and attitudes that are considered acceptable based on person's biological sex.

concepts.label: Models, Biopsychosocial
concepts.title: Models, Biopsychosocial
concepts.definition: A systematic integration of biological, psychological, and social approaches to the study of mental health and specific mental disorders.

concepts.label: Financial Stress
concepts.title: Financial Stress
concepts.definition: Stress arising from personal financial concerns. (www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-terms/def/financial-stress).

concepts.label: Anosmia
concepts.title: Anosmia
concepts.definition: Complete or severe loss of the subjective sense of smell. Loss of smell may be caused by many factors such as a cold, allergy, OLFACTORY NERVE DISEASES, viral RESPIRATORY TRACT INFECTIONS (e.g., COVID-19), aging and various neurological disorders (e.g., ALZHEIMER DISEASE).

concepts.label: Rhinorrhea
concepts.title: Rhinorrhea
concepts.definition: Excess nasal drainage.

concepts.label: Automated Facial Recognition
concepts.title: Automated Facial Recognition
concepts.definition: Electronic identification of a human based on attributes of the face.

concepts.label: Blood-Borne Infections
concepts.title: Blood-Borne Infections
concepts.definition: Diseases due to or propagated by body fluids from hosts whose BLOOD has been contaminated with pathogens.

concepts.label: Identity Recognition
concepts.title: Identity Recognition
concepts.definition: Ability to identify another individual by their facial, vocal, and other bodily features or distinguishing characteristics such as BODY HEIGHT; EYE COLOR; a birth mark or TATTOO; or GAIT.

concepts.label: Voice Recognition
concepts.title: Voice Recognition
concepts.definition: Ability to identify an individual vocal patterns and expressions.

concepts.label: Mania
concepts.title: Mania
concepts.definition: A state of elevated excitement with over-activity sometimes accompanied with psychotic symptoms (e.g., PSYCHOMOTOR AGITATION, inflated SELF ESTEEM and flight of ideas). It is often associated with mental disorders (e.g., CYCLOTHYMIC DISORDER; and BIPOLAR DISEASES).

concepts.label: Bias, Implicit
concepts.title: Bias, Implicit
concepts.definition: The attitudes or stereotypes that affect understanding, actions, and decisions in an unconscious manner. These biases which include favorable and unfavorable assessments, are activated involuntarily without individual's intentional control. (from http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Self-Compassion
concepts.title: Self-Compassion
concepts.definition: Being kind and understanding toward oneself in times of pain or failure, perceiving one's own suffering as part of a larger human experience, and holding painful feelings and thoughts in mindful awareness. (from Rev General Psychology, 15(4), 289–303. http[已隐藏本地路径] accessed 8/11/2020)

concepts.label: Sluggish Cognitive Tempo
concepts.title: Sluggish Cognitive Tempo
concepts.definition: Defined by a constellation of caregiver-reported symptoms that includes daydreaming, difficulty initiating and sustaining effort, lethargy, and physical underactivity. These symptoms have been observed in both typically developing children and in some children with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), especially those with the predominantly inattentive presentation. (J Abnormal Child Psychology; 46: Jan 2018.127). .

concepts.label: Information Avoidance
concepts.title: Information Avoidance
concepts.definition: Choosing to not obtain knowledge even if having the information could be to one's benefit.

concepts.label: Brain-Gut Axis
concepts.title: Brain-Gut Axis
concepts.definition: An interactive network between the GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT (gut) and the brain principally mediated through the ENTERIC NERVOUS SYSTEM. Control of the gut activities during stress, for instance, is mediated by activation of neuroendocrine hormones (e.g., CORTICOTROPIN-RELEASING FACTOR). Conversely, INTESTINAL MICROBIOTA associate with the CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM through the axis via microorganism-derived products (e.g., UROCORTINS). Some functional GASTROINTESTINAL DISORDERS (e.g., IRRITABLE BOWEL SYNDROME) have dysregulated brain-gut axis.

concepts.label: Diaschisis
concepts.title: Diaschisis
concepts.definition: Loss or decreased brain function within intact region of the brain distant from the site of the lesion.

concepts.label: Insular Cortex
concepts.title: Insular Cortex
concepts.definition: A pyramidal shaped region of cerebral cortex located deep below the lateral fissure in PRIMATES. It is surrounded by the SUPERIOR TEMPORAL GYRUS, the rostral PARIETAL LOBE, the INFERIOR FRONTAL GYRUS and the ORBITAL GYRI. It is the primary gustatory cortex and is involved in sensorimotor and somatosensory as well as socioemotional functions.

concepts.label: Primary Visual Cortex
concepts.title: Primary Visual Cortex
concepts.definition: An area comprised of parts of OCCIPITAL LOBE and the CALCARINE SULCUS of the visual cortex in humans with direct connectivity to the LATERAL GENICULATE NUCLEUS. It is the end organ where visual stimuli are received in the visual cortex.

concepts.label: Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex
concepts.title: Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex
concepts.definition: The upper surfaces of the prefrontal cortex comprising the rostral parts of the superior frontal gyrus and the middle frontal gyrus. It is involved in EXECUTIVE FUNCTION.

concepts.label: Disinformation
concepts.title: Disinformation
concepts.definition: False information deliberately and often covertly spread in order to influence public opinion or obscure the truth. (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Mentalization-Based Therapy
concepts.title: Mentalization-Based Therapy
concepts.definition: Mentalization-based therapy (MBT) is a type of long-term psychotherapy that is based on the use of MENTALIZATION.

concepts.label: Orthorexia Nervosa
concepts.title: Orthorexia Nervosa
concepts.definition: An eating disorder that is characterized by the pathological obsession with HEALTHY EATING.

concepts.label: Corticobasal Degeneration
concepts.title: Corticobasal Degeneration
concepts.definition: Rare progressive neurological disorder characterized by Parkinsonism, cortical atrophy of multiple areas of the brain including the cerebral cortex and the basal ganglia, cognitive dysfunction and eye movement abnormalities.

concepts.label: Vascular Depression
concepts.title: Vascular Depression
concepts.definition: Late-life depression associated with clinical or MRI defined cerebrovascular pathology.

concepts.label: Exergaming
concepts.title: Exergaming
concepts.definition: Videogaming that involves the player's whole body in physical exercises in order to play the videogames.

concepts.label: Adolescent Mothers
concepts.title: Adolescent Mothers
concepts.definition: Mothers aged less than 19 years at the time of child's conception or birth.

concepts.label: Cognitive Restructuring
concepts.title: Cognitive Restructuring
concepts.definition: A technique drawn from COGNITIVE BEHAVIOR THERAPY that helps an individual to identify, challenge and alter stress-inducing thought patterns and beliefs.

concepts.label: Listening Effort
concepts.title: Listening Effort
concepts.definition: The deliberate allocation of mental resources to overcome obstacles in goal pursuit when carrying out a task, with listening effort applied more when tasks involved listening. (From Pichora-Fuller et al.2016)

concepts.label: Psychological First Aid
concepts.title: Psychological First Aid
concepts.definition: Early psychosocial intervention approach used during or after traumatic life events as disasters, accidents, terrorist attacks causing negative effects on individual and/or society. It focuses on determining basic physical and mental needs of individuals in major events.

concepts.label: Nordic Walking
concepts.title: Nordic Walking
concepts.definition: Form of brisk walking, utilizing walking poles, which actively engages the trunk and upper limbs during walking, maintaining the natural gait, while the hands are performing an open–close cycle in an alternating manner.

concepts.label: Vaccination Hesitancy
concepts.title: Vaccination Hesitancy
concepts.definition: Delay in acceptance of vaccination despite availability.

concepts.label: Microaggression
concepts.title: Microaggression
concepts.definition: Brief verbal, behavioral, or situational indignities that communicate hostile, derogatory, or negative slights or insults. It may may be intentional or implicit. Three subtypes have been identified: microassaults, which are purposefully discriminatory actions; microinsults, which are subtle snubs that devalue a person’s identity; and microinvalidations, which are unintentional exclusions or negations of an individual’s thoughts. (dictionary.apa.org/microaggression 12/30/2020)

concepts.label: Technology Addiction
concepts.title: Technology Addiction
concepts.definition: The inability to overcome a desire to have contact with and use technology and electronic devices.

concepts.label: Adolescent Fathers
concepts.title: Adolescent Fathers
concepts.definition: Fathers initially aged less than 19 years at the time of their child's birth.

concepts.label: Canonical Correlation Analysis
concepts.title: Canonical Correlation Analysis
concepts.definition: Mathematical procedure that transforms vectors of variables into canonical variate pairs and finds their correlation to describe strength of association.

concepts.label: Cellular Automata
concepts.title: Cellular Automata
concepts.definition: Space-oriented dynamic modeling ALGORITHMS acting in an array of cells, whose temporal states evolve based on the rules (algorithms) of the automata. They are used to model complex dynamic systems for study and analysis in a variety of scientific fields.

concepts.label: Life Course Perspective
concepts.title: Life Course Perspective
concepts.definition: An approach to analyze one’s life within the framework of various circumstances experienced in a given society throughout entirety of life.

concepts.label: Haptic Technology
concepts.title: Haptic Technology
concepts.definition: The study of the use of touch and KINESTHESIS in order to produce HAPTIC COMPUTER INTERFACES that will allow users to interact with digital objects by kinesthetic feedback, force feedback, and tactile feedback.

concepts.label: Sleep Quality
concepts.title: Sleep Quality
concepts.definition: Satisfaction with the sleep experience, integrating aspects of sleep initiation, sleep maintenance, sleep quantity, and refreshment upon awakening.

concepts.label: Core Stability
concepts.title: Core Stability
concepts.definition: A POSTURE in which an ideal body mass distribution is achieved for the ABDOMINAL CORE. Abdominal core stability and balance provides the body an ability to maintain equilibrium and control of the SPINE and PELVIC REGION during movement.

concepts.label: Epidemiological Models
concepts.title: Epidemiological Models
concepts.definition: Mathematical models of the transmission of infectious diseases. They predict spread of a disease by incorporating disease-related (e.g., infectious agent, mode of transmission, latent period, infectious period) and abiotic factors (e.g., social, cultural, demographic, and geographic factors).

concepts.label: Chemometrics
concepts.title: Chemometrics
concepts.definition: The use of statistical and mathematical methods to analyze chemical observations and phenomena, such as epidemiological analysis of spectroscopically identified bacteria or QUANTITATIVE STRUCTURE-ACTIVITY RELATIONSHIP.

concepts.label: Climate Models
concepts.title: Climate Models
concepts.definition: Computer representations that simulate or predict the behavior or activity of WEATHER systems, processes, or phenomena.

concepts.label: Cognitive Psychology
concepts.title: Cognitive Psychology
concepts.definition: Branch of psychology that explores the operation of mental processes related to perceiving, attending, thinking, language, and memory, mainly through inferences from behavior. (APA Dictionary of Psychology. http[已隐藏本地路径] accessed 3/22/2021).

concepts.label: Prolonged Grief Disorder
concepts.title: Prolonged Grief Disorder
concepts.definition: Severe and disabling grief reactions that do not remit in the 12 months after the death of a significant other. The core of the diagnosis includes persistent yearning or missing the deceased, and preoccupation with the circumstance of the death. (Carmassi, Clinical Handbook of Bereavement and Grief Reactions, 2018)

concepts.label: Mass Gatherings
concepts.title: Mass Gatherings
concepts.definition: Organized or spontaneous events where the number of people attending is sufficient to strain the planning and response resources of the community hosting the event. (WHO, 2008). These events include the gathering of people as the result of natural disasters or conflict.

concepts.label: Schizophrenia, Treatment-Resistant
concepts.title: Schizophrenia, Treatment-Resistant
concepts.definition: A subset of schizophrenia with an inadequate response in target symptoms following treatment with two or more ANTIPSYCHOTICS.

concepts.label: Neuroinflammatory Diseases
concepts.title: Neuroinflammatory Diseases
concepts.definition: Diseases characterized by inflammation of the nervous tissue.

concepts.label: Health Disparate Minority and Vulnerable Populations
concepts.title: Health Disparate Minority and Vulnerable Populations
concepts.definition: Groups of persons whose special circumstantial characteristics (e.g., SOCIAL DETERMINANTS OF HEALTH) make them a minority, vulnerable, and frequently subjected to conditions with limited levels of access to health care and other opportunities.
aliases: Health Disparate, Minority and Vulnerable Populations
Health Disparity, Minority and Vulnerable Populations

concepts.label: Vestibular System
concepts.title: Vestibular System
concepts.definition: The VESTIBULAR APPARATUS in the inner ear, the eye, the CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM and various nerves, tracts and nuclei connecting them as they relate to PROPRIOCEPTION and SPATIAL ORIENTATION. Dysfunction in the vestibular system is associated with various diseases (e.g., VESTIBULAR DISEASES; LABYRINTH DISEASES; VESTIBULAR NEURONITIS; BENIGN PAROXYSMAL POSITIONAL VERTIGO; and MOTION SICKNESS).

concepts.label: Psychogenic Nonepileptic Seizures
concepts.title: Psychogenic Nonepileptic Seizures
concepts.definition: Seizures caused by psychological factors without electrophysiological epileptic changes.

concepts.label: Census Tract
concepts.title: Census Tract
concepts.definition: Small, relatively permanent statistical subdivisions of a county or equivalent entity that are updated by local participants prior to each decennial census as part of the U. S. Census Bureau's Participant Statistical Areas Program.(http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Community Resources
concepts.title: Community Resources
concepts.definition: The financial, material, and/or human assets of a community which have the potential to improve the QUALITY OF LIFE in community.

concepts.label: Social Structure
concepts.title: Social Structure
concepts.definition: The complex of relationships and systems that organize and regulate interpersonal phenomena in a group or society. The social structure of a group includes its norms and roles and the status, attraction, and communication relations that link one member to another (see group structure). The social structure of a society includes the complex of relations among its constituent individuals, groups, institutions, customs, and mores. (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Ostracism
concepts.title: Ostracism
concepts.definition: An extreme form of rejection in which one is excluded and ignored in the presence of others.

concepts.label: Social Deprivation
concepts.title: Social Deprivation
concepts.definition: Limited access to society's resources due to poverty. discrimination, or other disadvantage. Conditions based on seven demographic characteristics collected in the American Community Survey (ACS): often include percent living in poverty, percent with less than 12 years of education,  percent of single parent households, percent living in rented housing unit, percent living in overcrowded housing unit, percent of households without a car, and percent of non-employed adults under the age of 65 years.(http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Neighborhood Characteristics
concepts.title: Neighborhood Characteristics
concepts.definition: Characteristics that may describe the demographic, social, built environment, or economic characteristics of a geographic area in which people live and can affect health and well-being of neighborhood residents. Neighborhood environments include the physical environment (unsafe air/water), built environment   (sidewalks/greenspace) and the social environment (safety, sense of community).

concepts.label: Perceived Discrimination
concepts.title: Perceived Discrimination
concepts.definition: Perception of being treated badly or unfairly on the basis of race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, physical appearance, sexual orientation, or other characteristics. This includes perceived discrimination in health care settings.

concepts.label: Urogenital Diseases
concepts.title: Urogenital Diseases
concepts.definition: Pathological processes of the URINARY TRACT and the reproductive system (GENITALIA).

concepts.label: Genital Diseases
concepts.title: Genital Diseases
concepts.definition: Pathological processes involving the reproductive tract (GENITALIA).

concepts.label: Intersectional Framework
concepts.title: Intersectional Framework
concepts.definition: Interconnections of social categorizations such as race, class, and gender, creating overlapping and interdependent systems of discrimination or disadvantage.

concepts.label: Systemic Racism
concepts.title: Systemic Racism
concepts.definition: Processes of racism that are embedded in laws (local, state, and federal), policies, and practices of society and its institutions that provide advantages to racial groups deemed as superior, while differentially oppressing, disadvantaging, or otherwise neglecting racial groups viewed as inferior. Differential access to the goods, services, and opportunities of society by race. Institutionalized racism is normative, sometimes legalized, and often manifests as inherited disadvantage. It is structural, having been codified in our institutions of custom, practice, and law, so there need not be an identifiable perpetrator. (ttp[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Social Cohesion
concepts.title: Social Cohesion
concepts.definition: Strength of relationships and the sense of belongingness and solidarity among members of a community (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Information Motivation Behavioral Skills Model
concepts.title: Information Motivation Behavioral Skills Model
concepts.definition: A model for understanding patient behaviors, recognizes three constructs—information, motivation, and behavioral skills—needed to engage in a given health behavior, as specific individual determinants of behavior and behavioral change (Fisher & Fisher; Norton, 2009).

concepts.label: Pharmacophore
concepts.title: Pharmacophore
concepts.definition: A three-dimensional representation of a molecule that is used for modeling recognition of ligands and macromolecular targets.

concepts.label: Focal Cortical Dysplasia
concepts.title: Focal Cortical Dysplasia
concepts.definition: Abnormal, non-neoplastic cell proliferation of the CEREBRAL CORTEX confined to an area in any lobe. Focal cortical dysplasia in the temporal lobe is associated with TEMPORAL LOBE EPILEPSY.

concepts.label: Hippocampal Sclerosis
concepts.title: Hippocampal Sclerosis
concepts.definition: Neuronal loss in the hippocampal regions of CA1 and CA4 and less severely CA2 and CA3. Additional loss of hippocampal stratum radiatum, hippocampal atrophy and ASTROGLIOSIS are common. Hippocampal sclerosis is associated with intractable TEMPORAL LOBE EPILEPSY.

concepts.label: Dopaminergic Imaging
concepts.title: Dopaminergic Imaging
concepts.definition: Functional brain imaging techniques that utilize various RADIONUCLIDE TRACERS that bind to different targets in the SYNAPSES of DOPAMINERGIC NEURONS.

concepts.label: Tuberculosis, Extrapulmonary
concepts.title: Tuberculosis, Extrapulmonary
concepts.definition: MYCOBACTERIUM infections of organs other than the lung.

concepts.label: Kinesiophobia
concepts.title: Kinesiophobia
concepts.definition: Anxiety disorder of persistent and irrational fear of movement following an injury. It is related to perceived disability due to injury and CATASTROPHIZING in fear of (anticipated) PAIN and possibility of REINJURY.

concepts.label: Motion Capture
concepts.title: Motion Capture
concepts.definition: Technological process of recording the MOTION and MOVEMENT of objects (e.g., surgical instrument in robotic surgery), body parts (e.g., EYE MOVEMENT), animals or people.

concepts.label: Family Support
concepts.title: Family Support
concepts.definition: Support systems that provide assistance and encouragement between and among members of a FAMILY.

concepts.label: Family Structure
concepts.title: Family Structure
concepts.definition: Structural nature of relationships among members of a household typically in reference to a MINOR residing in the same home. More broadly any organizational framework that determines family membership, and the functions and hierarchical position of family members (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Extended Family
concepts.title: Extended Family
concepts.definition: A household with members of at least three generations.

concepts.label: Psychological Well-Being
concepts.title: Psychological Well-Being
concepts.definition: Condition of existence, or state of awareness, in which psychological needs are satisfied

concepts.label: Suicide Prevention
concepts.title: Suicide Prevention
concepts.definition: Specific strategies for averting suicides. These include mental HEALTH PROMOTION and monitoring PSYCHOLOGICAL WELL-BEING and other intervention programs targeting susceptible individuals.

concepts.label: Collective Efficacy
concepts.title: Collective Efficacy
concepts.definition: A group belief and perception in its ability to complete a task successfully. It includes shared belief it can control deviant behavior of a member.

concepts.label: Group Dynamics
concepts.title: Group Dynamics
concepts.definition: Processes of change in any social group from formation to functioning. It includes various forces that drive relationship among members and interaction with other groups.

concepts.label: Theory of Planned Behavior
concepts.title: Theory of Planned Behavior
concepts.definition: The construct in which intentions to perform behaviors of different kinds can be predicted with high accuracy from attitudes toward the behavior, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control; and these intentions, together with perceptions of behavioral control, account for considerable variance in actual behavior. (from Ajzen, Organizational Behavior and Human Decision Processes, V.50, Issue 2, p.179-211.)

concepts.label: Intermittent Fasting
concepts.title: Intermittent Fasting
concepts.definition: Alternating between fasting for an extended period of time during the day and eating during a restricted time for the day.

concepts.label: Mixed Dementias
concepts.title: Mixed Dementias
concepts.definition: Dementias caused by multiple etiologies, e.g., ALZHEIMER DISEASE, and VASCULAR DEMENTIA and/or LEWY BODY DISEASE.

concepts.label: Congenital Cranial Dysinnervation Disorders
concepts.title: Congenital Cranial Dysinnervation Disorders
concepts.definition: Congenital neurodevelopmental diseases characterized by abnormal eye, eyelid, and facial movements. Congenital cranial dysinnervation disorders (CCDDs) are caused by abnormal innervation of CRANIAL NERVES (e.g., CNs III, IV and VI) resulting in aplasia or hypoplasia of the ocular and facial musculature involved in EYE MOVEMENTS.

concepts.label: Information Sources
concepts.title: Information Sources
concepts.definition: Various communications media, information centers, information services that are are utilized to obtain information.

concepts.label: Post-Infectious Disorders
concepts.title: Post-Infectious Disorders
concepts.definition: Debilitating disorder characterized by fatigue and other symptoms related to cognitive, autonomous, and immune dysfunction experienced in the aftermath of infections.
aliases: Post Active Phase of Infection Syndrome

concepts.label: Dropped Head Syndrome
concepts.title: Dropped Head Syndrome
concepts.definition: Condition characterized by sagging of the head due to severe NECK MUSCLES weakness in the back of the neck. It may result in severe cervical KYPHOSIS called chin-on-chest deformity. Dropped head syndrome is most often associated with other diseases, e.g., PARKINSON'S DISEASE; STROKES; HEAD AND NECK CANCER; and ANKYLOSING SPONDYLITIS.

concepts.label: Medium Spiny Neurons
concepts.title: Medium Spiny Neurons
concepts.definition: Medium sized, inhibitory GABAergic neurons in the CORPUS STRIATUM with highly developed dendritic trees. They are divided into neurons expressing DOPAMINE D1 RECEPTORS which project preferentially to the SUBSTANTIA NIGRA PARS RETICULATA and neurons expressing DOPAMINE D2 RECEPTORS which project preferentially to the lateral part of the GLOBUS PALLIDUS. Medium spiny neurons are preferentially lost in HUNTINGTON DISEASE.

concepts.label: Schaffer Collaterals
concepts.title: Schaffer Collaterals
concepts.definition: The main axon connection from the CA3 PYRAMIDAL CELL AREA to the CA1 PYRAMIDAL CELL AREA in the HIPPOCAMPUS. Schaffer collaterals are important in memory, learning and activity-related NEURONAL PLASTICITY.

concepts.label: Sleep Duration
concepts.title: Sleep Duration
concepts.definition: Total number of hours of sleep in a day.

concepts.label: Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Gonadal Axis
concepts.title: Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Gonadal Axis
concepts.definition: A collection of NEURONS, tracts of NERVE FIBERS, endocrine tissue, and blood vessels in the HYPOTHALAMUS, the PITUITARY GLAND and the GONADS. It plays a central role in endocrine regulation of gonadal function including release of hormones: GNRH; LUTEINIZING HORMONE; FOLLICLE-STIMULATING HORMONE and TESTOSTERONE.

concepts.label: Chronotype
concepts.title: Chronotype
concepts.definition: The natural inclination or preference of time of day in which an individual or an organism has the most activity, particularly as it relates to sleeping pattern and circadian sleep-wake preferences.

concepts.label: Obesity Paradox
concepts.title: Obesity Paradox
concepts.definition: An observation that high BODY MASS INDEX is sometimes associated with lower CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASE mortality in certain population, e.g., ELDERLY.

concepts.label: Secondary Data Analysis
concepts.title: Secondary Data Analysis
concepts.definition: Analysis or reanalysis of existing data collected by someone else usually  for a different purpose.

concepts.label: Dissection, Blood Vessel
concepts.title: Dissection, Blood Vessel
concepts.definition: A tear or separation of the layers by a blood vessel typically involving vessels under pressure, i.e., ARTERIES, e.g., AORTA. Tearing of the TUNICA INTIMA layer of a blood vessel may lead to interstitial HEMORRHAGE. Dissection between the tunica intima and TUNICA MEDIA causes luminal occlusion. Dissection at the media, or between the media and the outer ADVENTITIA causes aneurismal dilation.

concepts.label: Processing Speed
concepts.title: Processing Speed
concepts.definition: The time it takes to understand and do a mental task. Unlike REACTION TIME processing speed does not necessarily include a motor component in response. Processing speed is tested by most NEUROPSYCHOLOGICAL TESTS.

concepts.label: Nociceptin Receptor
concepts.title: Nociceptin Receptor
concepts.definition: A member of the opioid subfamily of the G PROTEIN-COUPLED RECEPTORS. It is the receptor for the endogenous neuropeptide nociceptin. It functions in modulating NOCICEPTION and the perception of pain.

concepts.label: Military Sexual Trauma
concepts.title: Military Sexual Trauma
concepts.definition: Physical and psychological injuries resulting from SEXUAL VIOLENCE during MILITARY service.

concepts.label: Antiracism
concepts.title: Antiracism
concepts.definition: Beliefs, actions or intentions, and policies that oppose RACISM or discrimination  based on RACE.

concepts.label: Psychological Safety
concepts.title: Psychological Safety
concepts.definition: An environment where people are able to act and engage without fear of punishment or humiliation from others.

concepts.label: Cognitive Reflection
concepts.title: Cognitive Reflection
concepts.definition: Deliberate and careful consideration of previous actions, events, experiences, or decisions and the thinking that accompanied these activities. (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Tuft Cells
concepts.title: Tuft Cells
concepts.definition: Epithelial chemosensory cells with apical microvilli. They are found in many different organs and they share characteristics with the chemosensory cells in taste buds. These cells can be activated by infections in the gastrointestinal tract.

concepts.label: Lacanian Theory
concepts.title: Lacanian Theory
concepts.definition: Psychoanalytic theory begun by Jacques Lacan as a philosophical linguistic re-interpretation of Freud's original teachings (see FREUDIAN THEORY).

concepts.label: Magnetic Resonance Myelography
concepts.title: Magnetic Resonance Myelography
concepts.definition: A modified magnetic resonance imaging method for generating myelogram like images, characterized by high signal intensity of the CEREBROSPINAL FLUID, which permits visualization of spinal subarachnoid spaces and nerve root sheaths.

concepts.label: Diet, Plant-Based
concepts.title: Diet, Plant-Based
concepts.definition: A diet that emphasizes consumption of plant foods, such as grains, fruits, vegetables, nuts, and LEGUMES while reducing intake of animal-based foods.

concepts.label: Inferior Olivary Complex
concepts.title: Inferior Olivary Complex
concepts.definition: A brainstem nucleus in the superior medulla and a part of the OLIVARY NUCLEUS complex. Inferior olivary complex integrates motor and proprioceptive inputs and provides feedback to cerebellar neurons.

concepts.label: Olivary Degeneration
concepts.title: Olivary Degeneration
concepts.definition: Degeneration of the OLIVARY NUCLEUS typically involving INFERIOR OLIVARY COMPLEX. It is associated with various syndromes and neurodegenerative disorders including hypertrophic olivary degeneration secondary to a Guillain-Mollaret triangle lesion.

concepts.label: Mental Health Teletherapy
concepts.title: Mental Health Teletherapy
concepts.definition: Providing mental health services via TELECOMMUNICATIONS.

concepts.label: Post-Exercise Recovery
concepts.title: Post-Exercise Recovery
concepts.definition: The subsequent return to a resting or recovered state following a bout of exercise as the body adapts to the stress associated with exercise, replenishes muscle glycogen, and repairs body tissue.

concepts.label: Post-Exercise Recovery Techniques
concepts.title: Post-Exercise Recovery Techniques
concepts.definition: Therapeutic modalities following a bout of exercise to reduce markers of muscle damage, soreness, fatigue, and inflammation.

concepts.label: Disability Discrimination
concepts.title: Disability Discrimination
concepts.definition: Discrimination against persons with physical, intellectual, or psychiatric disabilities.

concepts.label: Dignity Therapy
concepts.title: Dignity Therapy
concepts.definition: Evidence-based psychotherapeutic modality for patients who are classified as terminally ill. Such patients may have loss of autonomy, severe physical pain, and challenging existential and spiritual experience, which contribute to disintegration of patient's sense of self.

concepts.label: Genetic Risk Score
concepts.title: Genetic Risk Score
concepts.definition: Estimate of an individual's genetic liability to a trait or disease, calculated according to their genotype profile and relevant genome-wide association study data. (from Tutorial: a guide to performing polygenic risk score analyses. Nat Protoc. 2020 Sep;15(9):2759.)

concepts.label: Compulsive Sexual Behavior Disorder
concepts.title: Compulsive Sexual Behavior Disorder
concepts.definition: Persistent pattern of failure to control intense, repetitive sexual impulses or urges resulting in repetitive sexual behavior. Symptoms may include repetitive sexual activities becoming a central focus of the person’s life to the point of neglecting health and personal care or other interests, activities and responsibilities; numerous unsuccessful efforts to significantly reduce repetitive sexual behavior; and continued repetitive sexual behavior despite adverse consequences or deriving little or no satisfaction from it. (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Receptor, Serotonin, 5-HT1F
concepts.title: Receptor, Serotonin, 5-HT1F
concepts.definition: A serotonin receptor subtype found in the GLOBUS PALLIDUS; HIPPOCAMPUS; PUTAMEN; SUBSTANTIA NIGRA; and TRIGEMINAL NUCLEUS, SPINAL that can modulate the release of CALCITONIN GENE-RELATED PEPTIDE from these nerves. Unlike 5-HT1B RECEPTORS, the activation of 5-HT1F receptors does not cause VASOCONSTRICTION. 5-HT1F receptor antagonists are used for the treatment of MIGRAINE.

concepts.label: Cannabinoid Hyperemesis Syndrome
concepts.title: Cannabinoid Hyperemesis Syndrome
concepts.definition: Recurrent vomiting accompanied by nausea, abdominal pain and sometimes compulsive hot bathing behavior in chronic CANNABIS abuse.

concepts.label: Excoriation Disorder
concepts.title: Excoriation Disorder
concepts.definition: Compulsion to pick one's skin.

concepts.label: Mosquito-Borne Diseases
concepts.title: Mosquito-Borne Diseases
concepts.definition: Infectious diseases transmitted by mosquito vectors. Mosquito-borne human viral diseases include Chikungunya, Dengue, viral encephalitis (e.g., Japanese and St. Louis types), West Nile, Yellow fever, Zika virus infections. Mosquito-borne human parasitic diseases include malaria and lymphatic filariasis. Equine encephalomyelitis and dirofilariasis are mosquito-borne viral diseases mostly in animals.

concepts.label: Aberrant Motor Behavior in Dementia
concepts.title: Aberrant Motor Behavior in Dementia
concepts.definition: Aberrant motor behaviors leading to inappropriate or purposeless activities in people with dementia. Aberrant motor behaviors in people with dementia include aggression, agitation, refusal to care and wandering.
aliases: Disturbance in Motor Function in Dementia
Disturbances in Motor Function in Dementia

concepts.label: Imprinting Disorders
concepts.title: Imprinting Disorders
concepts.definition: Disorders caused by transcriptional silencing of one parental gene allele (imprinted gene). Imprinted genes show genetic expression from only one parent of the gene pair through epigenetic processes with no change in the DNA sequence.

concepts.label: Cavernous Sinus Syndromes
concepts.title: Cavernous Sinus Syndromes
concepts.definition: Disease processes of the CAVERNOUS SINUS.

concepts.label: Oppositional Defiant Disorder
concepts.title: Oppositional Defiant Disorder
concepts.definition: A repetitive and persistent pattern of behavior that develops in childhood and is characterized as recurrent disobedient, overall negative or agitated mood, a quarrelsome attitude or being vengeful toward authority figures. Unlike in conduct disorder defiant behaviors in oppositional defiant disorders typically do not involve aggression, destruction, theft, or deceit. Oppositional defiant disorder, CONDUCT DISORDER and ATTENTION DEFICIT AND HYPERACTIVITY DISORDER sometimes co-occur.

concepts.label: Community of Practice
concepts.title: Community of Practice
concepts.definition: Core concept of learning and knowledge management, a repository where knowledge is developed, maintained and reproduced. It is an important platform for knowledge sharing within an organization or among peers in other settings.
