concepts.definition: A neurophysiological phenomenon in which the response to a startling stimulus (pulse) is decreased when a weaker prestimulus (prepulse) precedes it closely in time. It is used as an operational measure of sensorimotor gating.

concepts.label: Interoception
concepts.title: Interoception
concepts.definition: The perception of and sensitivity to stimuli originating inside of the body. It is a sense of the physiological condition of the entire body.

concepts.label: Wernicke Area
concepts.title: Wernicke Area
concepts.definition: Functional region comprising posterior part of the SUPERIOR TEMPORAL GYRUS in the dominant cerebral hemisphere (see CEREBRAL DOMINANCE) and often portions of the PARIETAL LOBE. Along with BROCA AREA it is important in SPEECH and LANGUAGE processes. A lesion in the area is associated with WERNICKE APHASIA and CONDUCTION APHASIA.

concepts.label: Cerebellar Vermis
concepts.title: Cerebellar Vermis
concepts.definition: A subregion of the CEREBELLAR CORTEX, located along the midsagittal plane of the CEREBELLUM.

concepts.label: Gamma Rhythm
concepts.title: Gamma Rhythm
concepts.definition: Brain waves characterized by a relatively high voltage or amplitude and a frequency of approximately 30-100 Hz. They are primarily observed during network engagement and sensory processing activities, during both waking and sleeping states.

concepts.label: Zona Incerta
concepts.title: Zona Incerta
concepts.definition: A region of the subthalamus located ventral to the THALAMUS and dorsal to the SUBTHALAMIC NUCLEUS.

concepts.label: Pontine Tegmentum
concepts.title: Pontine Tegmentum
concepts.definition: The dorsal region of pons bounded by the middle CEREBELLAR PEDUNCLES and the ventral part of the pons. It is continuous with the TEGMENTUM MESENCEPHALI and contains CEREBELLAR NUCLEI, lemnisci and RETICULAR FORMATION.

concepts.label: Parabrachial Nucleus
concepts.title: Parabrachial Nucleus
concepts.definition: A cell group in the pontine tegmentum surrounding the surfaces of the superior CEREBRAL PEDUNCLE of the PONS.

concepts.label: Abducens Nucleus
concepts.title: Abducens Nucleus
concepts.definition: A region in the PONTINE TEGMENTUM that is the nucleus of the ABDUCENS NERVE.

concepts.label: Facial Nucleus
concepts.title: Facial Nucleus
concepts.definition: A region in the pontine tegmentum that is the nucleus of the FACIAL NERVE.

concepts.label: Superior Olivary Complex
concepts.title: Superior Olivary Complex
concepts.definition: An auditory brainstem structure in the pontine tegmentum and a part of the olivary nucleus complex.  It contains several nuclei associated with auditory localization and is a component of ascending and descending auditory pathways.

concepts.label: Trapezoid Body
concepts.title: Trapezoid Body
concepts.definition: A region in the pontine tegmentum containing nuclei and fibers associated with AUDITORY PATHWAYS.

concepts.label: Barrington's Nucleus
concepts.title: Barrington's Nucleus
concepts.definition: A nucleus in the pons with exon projections to the sacral parasympathetic nucleus associated with bladder control.

concepts.label: Kolliker-Fuse Nucleus
concepts.title: Kolliker-Fuse Nucleus
concepts.definition: A nucleus in the pons associated with RESPIRATION RATE control.

concepts.label: Middle Cerebellar Peduncle
concepts.title: Middle Cerebellar Peduncle
concepts.definition: WHITE MATTER consisting of a large bundle of paired fibers originating in the pontine nuclei in the pre pontis and the nucleus reticularis tegmenti pontis projecting to the contralateral cerebral cortex.

concepts.label: Oculomotor Nuclear Complex
concepts.title: Oculomotor Nuclear Complex
concepts.definition: A collection of nuclei in the midbrain tegmentum for the OCULOMOTOR NERVE fibers.

concepts.label: Edinger-Westphal Nucleus
concepts.title: Edinger-Westphal Nucleus
concepts.definition: Nucleus in the oculomotor nuclear complex associated with oculomotor activities and stress adaptation.

concepts.label: Protective Factors
concepts.title: Protective Factors
concepts.definition: An aspect of personal behavior or lifestyle, environmental exposure, or inborn or inherited characteristic, which, on the basis of epidemiologic evidence, is known to be associated with prevention or mitigation of a health-related condition considered important to prevent.

concepts.label: Pars Reticulata
concepts.title: Pars Reticulata
concepts.definition: A region in the substantia nigra located ventral and lateral to the PARS COMPACTA.

concepts.label: Pars Compacta
concepts.title: Pars Compacta
concepts.definition: A region in the substantia nigra located dorsal to the PARS RETICULATA.

concepts.label: Cerebral Crus
concepts.title: Cerebral Crus
concepts.definition: Anterior portion of the cerebral peduncle which contains the motor tracts.

concepts.label: Tectospinal Fibers
concepts.title: Tectospinal Fibers
concepts.definition: A neural tract which connects the TECTUM MESENCEPHALI and the SPINAL CORD and is involved in head and eye movement coordination.

concepts.label: Nucleus Raphe Magnus
concepts.title: Nucleus Raphe Magnus
concepts.definition: A nucleus located directly rostral to the NUCLEUS RAPHE OBSCURUS in the pontine part of the Raphe nuclei. Another pontine nucleus located directly rostral to the magnus nucleus is the nucleus raphe pontis.

concepts.label: Dorsal Raphe Nucleus
concepts.title: Dorsal Raphe Nucleus
concepts.definition: The dorsal region of the raphe nucleus which is a source of the SEROTONERGIC NEURONS innervating the TELENCEPHALON; DIENCEPHALON; MESENCEPHALON; and RHOMBENCEPHALON.

concepts.label: Nucleus Raphe Pallidus
concepts.title: Nucleus Raphe Pallidus
concepts.definition: A nucleus in the medullary Raphe nuclei located rostral to the NUCLEUS RAPHE OBSCURUS and caudal to the NUCLEUS RAPHE MAGNUS.

concepts.label: Nucleus Raphe Obscurus
concepts.title: Nucleus Raphe Obscurus
concepts.definition: A nucleus in the medullary Raphe nuclei located caudal to the NUCLEUS RAPHE PALLIDUS.

concepts.label: Cerebral Peduncle
concepts.title: Cerebral Peduncle
concepts.definition: Ventral portion of the mesencephalon including the MIDBRAIN TEGMENTUM; CRUS CEREBRI; and the PRETECTUM. It does not include tectum mesencephali and TROCHLEAR NERVE.

concepts.label: Spatial Memory
concepts.title: Spatial Memory
concepts.definition: Memory related to spatial information.

concepts.label: Spatial Learning
concepts.title: Spatial Learning
concepts.definition: A process through which individuals encode information about their environmental CUES to facilitate SPATIAL NAVIGATION.

concepts.label: Spatial Navigation
concepts.title: Spatial Navigation
concepts.definition: Process by which organisms use various cues to develop a route to a destination and their ability to travel such a planned route.

concepts.label: Spatial Processing
concepts.title: Spatial Processing
concepts.definition: Integration of spatial information perceived by visual and/or auditory CUES.

concepts.label: Optic Tract
concepts.title: Optic Tract
concepts.definition: Nerve fiber originating from the OPTIC CHIASM that connects predominantly to the LATERAL GENICULATE BODIES. It is the continuation of the VISUAL PATHWAY that conveys the visual information originally from the RETINA to the optic chiasm via the OPTIC NERVES.

concepts.label: Neurodevelopmental Disorders
concepts.title: Neurodevelopmental Disorders
concepts.definition: These are a group of conditions with onset in the developmental period. The disorders typically manifest early in development, often before the child enters grade school, and are characterized by developmental deficits that produce impairments of personal, social, academic, or occupational functioning.  (From DSM-5).
aliases: Mental Disorders Usually Diagnosed in Infancy, Childhood or Adolescence
Neurodevelopmental Disorders Usually Diagnosed in Infancy, Childhood or Adolescence

concepts.label: Karoshi Death
concepts.title: Karoshi Death
concepts.definition: Sudden death from overwork, most often as a result of acute CARDIOVASCULAR STROKE.

concepts.label: Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation
concepts.title: Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation
concepts.definition: A technique of brain electric stimulation therapy which uses constant, low current delivered via ELECTRODES placed on various locations on the scalp.

concepts.label: Cervical Plexus Block
concepts.title: Cervical Plexus Block
concepts.definition: A blocking of NEURAL CONDUCTION in the network of nerve fibers innervating the neck and shoulder.

concepts.label: Military Family
concepts.title: Military Family
concepts.definition: Men and women serving on active duty in the military, or in a reserve military force, and their immediate family including spouses, children, and parents.

concepts.label: Social Skills
concepts.title: Social Skills
concepts.definition: The personal set of abilities required to successfully interact and communicate with others, both verbally and non-verbally through gestures, body language and personal appearance.

concepts.label: White Matter
concepts.title: White Matter
concepts.definition: The region of CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM that appears lighter in color than the other type, GRAY MATTER. It mainly consists of MYELINATED NERVE FIBERS and contains few neuronal cell bodies or DENDRITES.

concepts.label: Gray Matter
concepts.title: Gray Matter
concepts.definition: Region of CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM that appears darker in color than the other type, WHITE MATTER. It is composed of neuronal CELL BODIES; NEUROPIL; GLIAL CELLS and CAPILLARIES but few MYELINATED NERVE FIBERS.

concepts.label: Spinal Cord Dorsal Horn
concepts.title: Spinal Cord Dorsal Horn
concepts.definition: One of three central columns of the spinal cord. It is composed of GRAY MATTER spinal laminae I-VI.

concepts.label: Spinal Cord Ventral Horn
concepts.title: Spinal Cord Ventral Horn
concepts.definition: One of three central columns of the spinal cord. It is composed of GRAY MATTER spinal laminae VIII and IX.

concepts.label: Spinal Cord Lateral Horn
concepts.title: Spinal Cord Lateral Horn
concepts.definition: One of three central columns of the spinal cord. It is composed of GRAY MATTER and is located laterally in lamina VII.

concepts.label: Basal Forebrain
concepts.title: Basal Forebrain
concepts.definition: The region of the telencephalon located rostral and ventral to the STRIATUM comprising AMYGDALA; SEPTAL NUCLEI; SUBSTANTIA INNOMINATA and ventral pallidum.

concepts.label: Allesthesia
concepts.title: Allesthesia
concepts.definition: A neurological disorder in which a sensory stimulus, usually tactile but more rarely other sensory modalities, is misperceived in a location distant from the original stimulus.

concepts.label: Sensorimotor Cortex
concepts.title: Sensorimotor Cortex
concepts.definition: A composite area of the cerebral cortex concerned with motor control and sensory perception comprising the motor cortex areas, the somatosensory areas, the gustatory cortex, the olfactory areas, the auditory cortex, and the visual cortex.

concepts.label: Cervical Cord
concepts.title: Cervical Cord
concepts.definition: The segment of the spinal cord within the CERVICAL VERTEBRAE.

concepts.label: Olfactory Cortex
concepts.title: Olfactory Cortex
concepts.definition: Basal forebrain and medial part of temporal lobe areas that receive synaptic inputs from the OLFACTORY BULB.

concepts.label: Piriform Cortex
concepts.title: Piriform Cortex
concepts.definition: An area of the olfactory cortex comprising the rostral half of the uncus of the PARAHIPPOCAMPAL GYRUS and the anterior PARAHIPPOCAMPAL GYRUS. It receives major afferents directly from the OLFACTORY BULB.

concepts.label: Olfactory Tubercle
concepts.title: Olfactory Tubercle
concepts.definition: Region in the ventral TELENCEPHALON located anterior to the OPTIC CHIASM, posterior to the OLFACTORY PEDUNCLE, rostral to the PIRIFORM AREA and ventral to the NUCLEUS ACCUMBENS.

concepts.label: Speech Sound Disorder
concepts.title: Speech Sound Disorder
concepts.definition: Persistent difficulty with speech sound production such that it interferes with verbal communication.

concepts.label: Patient-Specific Modeling
concepts.title: Patient-Specific Modeling
concepts.definition: The development and application of computational models of human pathophysiology that are individualized to patient-specific data.

concepts.label: Psychology, Developmental
concepts.title: Psychology, Developmental
concepts.definition: Field of study concerned with age-related changes in BEHAVIOR that occur in human beings over the course of life, from birth to death. It includes all aspects of human growth, including emotional, intellectual, social, perceptual and personality development.

concepts.label: Anterior Commissure, Brain
concepts.title: Anterior Commissure, Brain
concepts.definition: Bundle of MYELINATED NERVE FIBERS that connects the two CEREBRAL HEMISPHERES in the LAMINA TERMINALIS. It is located ventral to the SEPTAL NUCLEI, and caudal to the median PREOPTIC NUCLEUS.

concepts.label: Posterior Cerebellar Commissure
concepts.title: Posterior Cerebellar Commissure
concepts.definition: A bundle of nerve fibers that crosses the midline in the tectum mesencephali dorsal to the CEREBRAL AQUEDUCT.

concepts.label: Telencephalic Commissures
concepts.title: Telencephalic Commissures
concepts.definition: Set of nerve fibers that cross the midline of the TELENCEPHALON. They include the ANTERIOR COMMISSURE; the CORPUS CALLOSUM; and the HIPPOCAMPAL COMMISSURE of the fornix.

concepts.label: Craving
concepts.title: Craving
concepts.definition: An intense, urgent, or abnormal desire or longing (for food, drugs, alcohol, etc.)

concepts.label: Pretectal Region
concepts.title: Pretectal Region
concepts.definition: Region of midbrain tectum located posterior to the THALAMUS and anterior to the SUPERIOR COLLICULUS.

concepts.label: Sociological Factors
concepts.title: Sociological Factors
concepts.definition: Attributes and experiences that influence an individual's personality, attitudes, and lifestyle, which are derived from the social values and/or behavior of the groups to which an individual belongs, or aspires to belong.

concepts.label: Social Norms
concepts.title: Social Norms
concepts.definition: Customary standards that govern behavior in groups, cultures, or societies. They reflect what a group deems acceptable in a social context in terms of appropriate and inappropriate values, beliefs, attitudes, and behaviors.

concepts.label: Midbrain Reticular Formation
concepts.title: Midbrain Reticular Formation
concepts.definition: The midbrain portion of the reticular formation located in the MIDBRAIN TEGMENTUM.

concepts.label: Trigeminal Motor Nucleus
concepts.title: Trigeminal Motor Nucleus
concepts.definition: Nucleus located in the pontine tegmentum with motor neurons that innervate the muscles of the JAW through the motor portion of the TRIGEMINAL NERVE.

concepts.label: Midbrain Raphe Nuclei
concepts.title: Midbrain Raphe Nuclei
concepts.definition: Raphe nuclei located in the midbrain including the dorsal and median raphe nuclei. They are the origin of the major serotonergic innervation in the FOREBRAIN.

concepts.label: Interpeduncular Nucleus
concepts.title: Interpeduncular Nucleus
concepts.definition: A nucleus located at the midline of the ventral MIDBRAIN TEGMENTUM with primarily GABAergic projections to the median and dorsal raphe nuclei and the MIDBRAIN CENTRAL GRAY.

concepts.label: Social Theory
concepts.title: Social Theory
concepts.definition: Frameworks of empirical evidence used to study and interpret social phenomena.

concepts.label: External Capsule
concepts.title: External Capsule
concepts.definition: Thin layer of WHITE MATTER mostly of GABAERGIC NEURONS located between the PUTAMEN and the CLAUSTRUM.

concepts.label: Basolateral Nuclear Complex
concepts.title: Basolateral Nuclear Complex
concepts.definition: A set of amygdalar nuclei bordered laterally by the EXTERNAL CAPSULE and medially by the CENTRAL AMYGDALOID NUCLEUS.

concepts.label: Central Amygdaloid Nucleus
concepts.title: Central Amygdaloid Nucleus
concepts.definition: A nucleus located in the caudal half of the amygdala. It is a primary region involved in controlling responses and receives many intrinsic GABAergic amygdaloid connections.

concepts.label: Corticomedial Nuclear Complex
concepts.title: Corticomedial Nuclear Complex
concepts.definition: The rostral part of the amygdala with cortical-like layered structure. It receives major inputs from the OLFACTORY BULB and PIRIFORM CORTEX.

concepts.label: Periamygdaloid Cortex
concepts.title: Periamygdaloid Cortex
concepts.definition: The surface of the parahippocampal gyrus overlying the cortical amygdaloid nucleus.

concepts.label: Organum Vasculosum
concepts.title: Organum Vasculosum
concepts.definition: Circumventricular cellular structure in the anterior hypothalamic region. It is located in the optic recess at the anteroventral end of the THIRD VENTRICLE and forms the ventral part of the midline anterior wall.

concepts.label: Courage
concepts.title: Courage
concepts.definition: State of mind or spirit that enables one to act in the face of perceived danger, difficulty, or pain.

concepts.label: Circumventricular Organs
concepts.title: Circumventricular Organs
concepts.definition: Highly vascularized and specialized tissues distributed principally along the midline of the VENTRICULAR SYSTEM from the FOREBRAIN to the HINDBRAIN. They are distinguished by their lack of normal BLOOD-BRAIN BARRIER and fenestrated capillaries and contain either neurosecretory neurons or chemoreceptors.

concepts.label: Renshaw Cells
concepts.title: Renshaw Cells
concepts.definition: Ipsilateral glycinergic inhibitory interneurons of the SPINAL CORD VENTRAL HORN which modulate recurrent firing of MOTOR NEURONS. They develop from embryonic progenitor domain V1.Ia inhibitory interneurons which also originate from V1 are responsible for reciprocal inhibition of MOTONEURONS.
aliases: Spinal Cord Ventral Horn Interneuron Renshaw

concepts.label: Commissural Interneurons
concepts.title: Commissural Interneurons
concepts.definition: INTERNEURONS with projections to the contralateral side of the SPINAL CORD. Both excitatory and inhibitory interneurons are involved in coordinating alternative left-right activities during LOCOMOTION.

concepts.label: Ventral Striatum
concepts.title: Ventral Striatum
concepts.definition: A composite structure of the TELENCEPHALON that is defined by connectivity. It includes the NUCLEUS ACCUMBENS; the ISLANDS OF CALLEJA; and parts of the CAUDATE NUCLEUS; the PUTAMEN; and the SUBSTANTIA INNOMINATA.

concepts.label: Laser-Evoked Potentials
concepts.title: Laser-Evoked Potentials
concepts.definition: Somatosensory evoked potentials generated through the application of HEAT to the SKIN with a LASER. They are often used clinically to assess the function of the central nociceptive system and in diagnosing NOCICEPTIVE PAIN.

concepts.label: Anoxia
concepts.title: Anoxia
concepts.definition: Relatively complete absence of oxygen in one or more tissues.

concepts.label: Monkeys
concepts.title: Monkeys
concepts.definition: A non-taxonomic, non-specific term for the smaller longer-tailed PRIMATES.

concepts.label: B Fibers
concepts.title: B Fibers
concepts.definition: Type B fibers are the small myelinated fibers with a diameter up to 3 um and NEURAL CONDUCTION rates of 3-15 m/sec. They are mainly associated with the visceral autonomic nerves.

concepts.label: Bonding, Human-Pet
concepts.title: Bonding, Human-Pet
concepts.definition: The emotional attachment of individuals to PETS.

concepts.label: Butyric Acids
concepts.title: Butyric Acids
concepts.definition: 4-carbon acids, salts, and derivatives of BUTYRIC ACID.

concepts.label: Cerebral Embolism and Thrombosis
concepts.title: Cerebral Embolism and Thrombosis
concepts.definition: Embolism or thrombosis occurring in a cerebral vessel often leading to cerebral infarction.

concepts.label: Chemotactic Factors, Macrophage
concepts.title: Chemotactic Factors, Macrophage
concepts.definition: Cytotaxins liberated from normal or invading cells that specifically attract macrophages. They may be lymphokines, products of antigen, antibody and complement interactions or other.

concepts.label: Cobra Venoms
concepts.title: Cobra Venoms
concepts.definition: Venoms from snakes of the genus NAJA. They contain many specific proteins that have cytotoxic, hemolytic, neurotoxic, and other properties. Like other elapid venoms, they are rich in enzymes. They include cobramines and cobralysins.

concepts.label: 7S Collagen
concepts.title: 7S Collagen
concepts.definition: A stable peptide fragment originating from the N-terminal domain of collagen type IV.

concepts.label: Microfibril Collagen Hemostat
concepts.title: Microfibril Collagen Hemostat
concepts.definition: A topical hemostatic agent prepared from collagen.

concepts.label: Privileged Communication
concepts.title: Privileged Communication
concepts.definition: In law, a confidential statement made to a lawyer, physician, pastor, or spouse, which is privileged against disclosure in court if the privilege is claimed by the client, patient, penitent, or spouse. (Bioethics Thesaurus)

concepts.label: Consumer Participation
concepts.title: Consumer Participation
concepts.definition: Involvement of the users of services in the decision-making processes.

concepts.label: Consumer Satisfaction
concepts.title: Consumer Satisfaction
concepts.definition: Customer satisfaction or dissatisfaction with a benefit or service received.

concepts.label: Craniometry
concepts.title: Craniometry
concepts.definition: The measurement of the dimensions of the SKULL.

concepts.label: Deafness, Sudden
concepts.title: Deafness, Sudden
concepts.definition: Complete sensorineural hearing loss which develops suddenly over a period of hours or a few days.

concepts.label: Densitometry, X-Ray
concepts.title: Densitometry, X-Ray
concepts.definition: Measurement of the degree of darkening of X-ray film by means of a photocell which measures light transmission through the film.

concepts.label: Behavior Test
concepts.title: Behavior Test
concepts.definition: Written, visual, or verbal evaluation administered to assess the cognitive and emotional functioning of both humans and animals.

concepts.label: Communication Research
concepts.title: Communication Research
concepts.definition: An academic field that deals with processes of human communication.

concepts.label: Avoidance Behavior
concepts.title: Avoidance Behavior
concepts.definition: Act of choosing to move away from a potentially negative stimulus or situation.

concepts.label: Approach Behavior
concepts.title: Approach Behavior
concepts.definition: Moving towards a possibly rewarding stimulus or situation.

concepts.label: Neurological Physiotherapy
concepts.title: Neurological Physiotherapy
concepts.definition: Treatment of individuals who have neurological impairments such as traumatic brain injury or stroke, multiple sclerosis, spinal cord injury, and Parkinson's disease.

concepts.label: Legal Drinking Age
concepts.title: Legal Drinking Age
concepts.definition: The age at which an individual can lawfully consume alcohol

concepts.label: Exorcism
concepts.title: Exorcism
concepts.definition: Practice of evicting demons or other spiritual entities from a person or area believed to be possessed.

concepts.label: Gossypiboma
concepts.title: Gossypiboma
concepts.definition: Accidentally retained SURGICAL SPONGES after surgery.

concepts.label: Hypnotherapy
concepts.title: Hypnotherapy
concepts.definition: Therapeutic intervention in which a person is induced through clinical guidance into a hypnotic state.

concepts.label: Models, Mental
concepts.title: Models, Mental
concepts.definition: Cognitive representations of real, imaginary, or hypothetical situations or objects.

concepts.label: Sexual Satisfaction
concepts.title: Sexual Satisfaction
concepts.definition: Pleasure derived from sexual experiences.

concepts.label: Laughter Yoga
concepts.title: Laughter Yoga
concepts.definition: A form of exercise involving use of laughter and breathing exercises in order to improve physical and mental health.

concepts.label: Artistic Creativity
concepts.title: Artistic Creativity
concepts.definition: A quality that humans can possess involving the ability to make, create, or perform.

concepts.label: Research-Related Injuries
concepts.title: Research-Related Injuries
concepts.definition: Injuries that occur as a result of participation in a research study.

concepts.label: Hookah Smoking
concepts.title: Hookah Smoking
concepts.definition: SMOKING using a HOOKAH.

concepts.label: Sitting
concepts.title: Sitting
concepts.definition: Putting the weight of the body,  against the ground or a horizontal object such as a chair seat.

concepts.label: Family Dynamics
concepts.title: Family Dynamics
concepts.definition: Dynamics of interpersonal interaction and developmental processes taking place between and among members of a biological or socially defined family unit.

concepts.label: Diurnal Rhythm
concepts.title: Diurnal Rhythm
concepts.definition: A circadian rhythm that is synchronized with the day-night cycle.

concepts.label: Acute Exercise
concepts.title: Acute Exercise
concepts.definition: A single bout of exercise.

concepts.label: Alternative Prion Protein
concepts.title: Alternative Prion Protein
concepts.definition: An overlapping open reading frame within the PRNP gene that encodes a protein which is smaller and structurally unrelated to major prion protein.

concepts.label: Workplace Bullying
concepts.title: Workplace Bullying
concepts.definition: Aggressive behavior intended to cause harm or distress that occurs in the workplace.

concepts.label: King Cobra Venom
concepts.title: King Cobra Venom
concepts.definition: Venom of the king cobra snake (OPHIOPHAGUS HANNAH) that consists primarily of neurotoxins.

concepts.label: Social Anxiety
concepts.title: Social Anxiety
concepts.definition: Emotion characterized by feelings of tension, worried thoughts, and inadequacy in a social setting.

concepts.label: Smoking Behaviors
concepts.title: Smoking Behaviors
concepts.definition: Psychological aspects of SMOKING.

concepts.label: Smoking, Blunts
concepts.title: Smoking, Blunts
concepts.definition: Smoking of hollowed out cigars or cigarettes filled with MARIJUANA.

concepts.label: Anesthesia Refusal
concepts.title: Anesthesia Refusal
concepts.definition: Patient or surrogate refusal of specific type of anesthesia or any anesthesia.

concepts.label: Body Packers
concepts.title: Body Packers
concepts.definition: Persons who conceal drugs or other contraband within their body cavities.

concepts.label: Solution-Focused Brief Therapy
concepts.title: Solution-Focused Brief Therapy
concepts.definition: Psychotherapy that is brief and focuses on solutions, rather than on problems

concepts.label: Eurofit Test Battery
concepts.title: Eurofit Test Battery
concepts.definition: A set of nine physical fitness tests for flexibility, speed, endurance and strength developed by the Council of Europe for school age children and adults. The tests are performed within 35 to 40 minutes using very simple equipment.

concepts.label: Psychology, Perceptual
concepts.title: Psychology, Perceptual
concepts.definition: Branch of psychology concerned with perception of the beliefs, attitudes and opinions of others.

concepts.label: Schneiderian Membrane
concepts.title: Schneiderian Membrane
concepts.definition: The ciliated mucoperostium lining of the MAXILLARY SINUS.

concepts.label: Physical Inactivity
concepts.title: Physical Inactivity
concepts.definition: Less than 150 minutes of moderate to vigorous intensity physical activity per week or 75 minutes of vigorous intensity physical activity per week.

concepts.label: Material Culture
concepts.title: Material Culture
concepts.definition: Study of objects made or used by people, especially the folk artifacts produced by traditional methods, as well as techniques of their production.

concepts.label: Collective Human Rights
concepts.title: Collective Human Rights
concepts.definition: Right of peoples to self-determination and the rights to be and to live in community with other members of one's own group. The rights of communities, ranging from the family unit to the entire human community, and including national, religious, linguistic and cultural communities, taking special account of minorities, and indigenous populations.

concepts.label: Covert Racism
concepts.title: Covert Racism
concepts.definition: Practices or policies that appear to be 'neutral' or 'fair' because they treat everyone in the same way but actually adversely affect a higher proportion of people of one racial, national or ethnic group. It can occur even when there is no intention to discriminate.

concepts.label: Cultural Relativism
concepts.title: Cultural Relativism
concepts.definition: The process by which the dominant symbols, acts, or meanings of a society reinforce the perspective of a dominant group while making invisible, stereotyped, or marked as “other” the variations in symbols, acts, and meanings from culture to culture.in the perspectives of subordinate or targeted groups. This includes the presumed universality of the dominant group’s experience, culture, and religion.

concepts.label: Linguistic Rights
concepts.title: Linguistic Rights
concepts.definition: The human and civil rights concerning the individual and collective right to choose the language or languages for communication in a private or public atmosphere.

concepts.label: Minority Rights
concepts.title: Minority Rights
concepts.definition: The rights as applied to members of racial, ethnic, class, religious, linguistic or gender and sexual minorities; and, the collective rights accorded to minority groups. Minority rights may also apply simply to individual rights of anyone who is not part of a majority decision.

concepts.label: Rights of Indigenous Peoples
concepts.title: Rights of Indigenous Peoples
concepts.definition: Those rights that exist in recognition of the specific condition of indigenous peoples. This includes not only the most basic human rights of physical survival and integrity, but also the preservation of their land, language, religion, and other elements of cultural heritage that are a part of their existence as a people.

concepts.label: Anti-Semitism
concepts.title: Anti-Semitism
concepts.definition: Discrimination against or hostility towards Jewish people, whether they are religiously or ethnically defined.

concepts.label: Dialect
concepts.title: Dialect
concepts.definition: Language forms, particularly oddities of pronunciation and syntax, that are associated with a region or a group.

concepts.label: Islamophobia
concepts.title: Islamophobia
concepts.definition: Fear of or hostility toward Muslims which may be manifested in many ways including acts of violence and legislation against visible aspects of Islam.

concepts.label: Labor Exploitation
concepts.title: Labor Exploitation
concepts.definition: The process by which the results of the labor of one social group is transferred as the benefit of another group.

concepts.label: Right to Housing and Shelter
concepts.title: Right to Housing and Shelter
concepts.definition: The economic, social and cultural right to adequate housing and shelter.

concepts.label: Superior Segmental Optic Nerve Hypoplasia
concepts.title: Superior Segmental Optic Nerve Hypoplasia
concepts.definition: Underdevelopment of the superior aspect of the OPTIC NERVE HEAD.

concepts.label: Vagal Anti-inflammatory Pathway
concepts.title: Vagal Anti-inflammatory Pathway
concepts.definition: Functional circuit between the VAGUS NERVE and innate inflammatory response (see INNATE IMMUNITY).

concepts.label: Structural Violence
concepts.title: Structural Violence
concepts.definition: Individual or group aggressive behavior which is socially non-acceptable, turbulent, and often destructive. It is precipitated by frustrations, hostility, or prejudices, etc.

concepts.label: Human-Animal Bonding
concepts.title: Human-Animal Bonding
concepts.definition: Attachment of HUMANS to ANIMALS.

concepts.label: Selfish DNA
concepts.title: Selfish DNA
concepts.definition: DNA whose role appears to be its own replication, e.g., transposable elements and some SATELLITE DNA.

concepts.label: Voice Emotion Recognition
concepts.title: Voice Emotion Recognition
concepts.definition: Ability to interpret the feelings and emotions of another individual based on their vocal expressions.

concepts.label: Facial Emotion Recognition
concepts.title: Facial Emotion Recognition
concepts.definition: Ability to interpret a person's feelings and emotions based on their facial expressions.

concepts.label: Cardiometabolic Syndrome
concepts.title: Cardiometabolic Syndrome
concepts.definition: A cluster of symptoms that are risk factors for CARDIOVASCULAR DISEASES and TYPE 2 DIABETES MELLITUS. The major components not only include metabolic dysfunctions of METABOLIC SYNDROME but also HYPERTENSION, and ABDOMINAL OBESITY.

concepts.label: Prosocial Behavior
concepts.title: Prosocial Behavior
concepts.definition: Assisting or considering other people, such as providing assistance to an older adult crossing the street.

concepts.label: Antisocial Behavior
concepts.title: Antisocial Behavior
concepts.definition: Behavior that sharply deviates from social norms and violates rights of others

concepts.label: Sociality
concepts.title: Sociality
concepts.definition: The tendency to associate in or form social groups.

concepts.label: Social Cognitive Theory
concepts.title: Social Cognitive Theory
concepts.definition: Theory based on observational learning, the process of learning desirable and undesirable behaviors by observing others.

concepts.label: Social Neuroscience
concepts.title: Social Neuroscience
concepts.definition: Field of study of the interactions between social and biological neurologic processes.

concepts.label: Social Communication
concepts.title: Social Communication
concepts.definition: Process of receiving and communicating socially relevant information.

concepts.label: Trier Social Stress Test
concepts.title: Trier Social Stress Test
concepts.definition: Test that consists of an anticipation period (10 minutes) and a test period (10 minutes) in which the subjects have to deliver a free speech and perform mental arithmetic in front of an audience.

concepts.label: Economic Value of Life
concepts.title: Economic Value of Life
concepts.definition: The evaluation of the monetary value of a life lost or a life saved.

concepts.label: Embryo
concepts.title: Embryo
concepts.definition: The entities of developing ANIMALS in early stages.

concepts.label: Health Correlates
concepts.title: Health Correlates
concepts.definition: Causes and other factors that influence the occurrence of disease and other health-related events.

concepts.label: Poaching
concepts.title: Poaching
concepts.definition: Illegal taking of protected animals.

concepts.label: Food Justice
concepts.title: Food Justice
concepts.definition: Communities exercising their right to grow, sell, and eat healthy food.

concepts.label: Synaptic-Like Microvesicles
concepts.title: Synaptic-Like Microvesicles
concepts.definition: Synaptic vesicle counterpart in neuroendocrine cells.

concepts.label: Hearing in Noise Test
concepts.title: Hearing in Noise Test
concepts.definition: Test of hearing in noisy background or environment.

concepts.label: Insurance Medicine
concepts.title: Insurance Medicine
concepts.definition: Evidence-informed decisions related to health insurance coverage and health-related judgements based on diagnosis, prognosis, and effectiveness of interventions. (From www.insurance.cochrane.org assessed 12/28/2020)

concepts.label: Miscommunication
concepts.title: Miscommunication
concepts.definition: Unintentional failure to communicate.

concepts.label: Social Risk Factors
concepts.title: Social Risk Factors
concepts.definition: Social risk factors are specific adverse social conditions that are associated with poor health, like social isolation, poverty, limited community resources, or housing instability.

concepts.label: Social Exclusion
concepts.title: Social Exclusion
concepts.definition: Exclusion consists of dynamic, multi-dimensional processes driven by unequal power relationships interacting across four main dimensions - economic, political, social and cultural - and at different levels including individual, household, group, community, country and global levels. It results in a continuum of inclusion/exclusion characterized by unequal access to resources, capabilities and rights which leads to health inequalities. (http[已隐藏本地路径] 2008.pdf.)

concepts.label: Social Deprivation Index
concepts.title: Social Deprivation Index
concepts.definition: Measure of area-level measures of social deprivation based on seven demographic characteristics collected in the American Community Survey (ACS): often include percent living in poverty, percent with less than 12 years of education, percent of single parent households, percent living in rented housing unit, percent living in overcrowded housing unit, percent of households without a car, and percent of non-employed adults under the age of 65 years. Note: this is not a definition but some supporting information about what is included in a common measure. (http[已隐藏本地路径] index.)

concepts.label: Financial Hardship
concepts.title: Financial Hardship
concepts.definition: An inability to meet basic living expenses for goods and services necessary to maintain health and/or well-being.

concepts.label: Neighborhood Disadvantage
concepts.title: Neighborhood Disadvantage
concepts.definition: Neighborhood disadvantage refers to the lack of economic and social resources in a neighborhood and has been shown to exert a detrimental effect on health outcomes over and above individual level characteristics.

concepts.label: Neighborhood Safety
concepts.title: Neighborhood Safety
concepts.definition: An area that is characterized as having factors protecting residents from risk, harm, violence, or injury.

concepts.label: Dopamine Transporter Imaging
concepts.title: Dopamine Transporter Imaging
concepts.definition: Functional brain imaging utilizing RADIONUCLIDE TRACERS that are ligands of DOPAMINE TRANSPORTERS.

concepts.label: Vesicular Monoamine Transporter Type 2 Imaging
concepts.title: Vesicular Monoamine Transporter Type 2 Imaging
concepts.definition: Functional brain imaging with RADIONUCLIDE TRACERS that target VESICULAR MONOAMINE TRANSPORTER TYPE 2.

concepts.label: Dopamine Receptor Imaging
concepts.title: Dopamine Receptor Imaging
concepts.definition: Functional brain imaging of post-synaptic DOPAMINE metabolism with RADIONUCLIDE TRACER ligands of DOPAMINE RECEPTORS.

concepts.label: Credit Assignment
concepts.title: Credit Assignment
concepts.definition: The process of identifying among a set of actions chosen in a sequence of events those which are responsible for a final outcome and to identify the best, and worst, decisions made so that the best decisions are reinforced and the worst penalized. (From Wang, J. et al. (2014). Encyclopedia of Business Analytics and Optimization.)

concepts.label: Glycosylated Proteins
concepts.title: Glycosylated Proteins
concepts.definition: Proteins modified post-translationally by GLYCOSYLTRANSFERASES or synthetically by organic chemical reactions. In the past, glycosylated proteins sometimes referred to GLYCATED PROTEINS (those modified by the spontaneous, non-enzymatic attachment of reducing sugars to amino groups during the MAILLARD REACTION.)

concepts.label: Commercial Determinants of Health
concepts.title: Commercial Determinants of Health
concepts.definition: Health effects associated with activities of businesses, commercial entities or corporations.

concepts.label: Faith-based Dietary Restrictions
concepts.title: Faith-based Dietary Restrictions
concepts.definition: Limits on eating certain food or beverage sources or patterns of consumption.

concepts.label: Ableism
concepts.title: Ableism
concepts.definition: Pervasive bias against individuals with disabilities, ranging from stigma to health disparities. It exists in systems ranging from individual to communal and societal.

concepts.label: Atherothrombosis
concepts.title: Atherothrombosis
concepts.definition: Formation of a blood clot inside the artery due to atherosclerosis.

concepts.label: Pagophagia
concepts.title: Pagophagia
concepts.definition: Compulsive eating of ice or chilled beverages.

concepts.label: Disordered Eating Behavior
concepts.title: Disordered Eating Behavior
concepts.definition: Eating behaviors that are subclinical or milder forms of EATING DISORDERS such as unhealthy dieting, binge eating, and purging.

concepts.label: Social Learning Theory
concepts.title: Social Learning Theory
concepts.definition: Concept of observational learning that holds people have the ability to learn by simply watching others.

concepts.label: Body Image Postitivity
concepts.title: Body Image Postitivity
concepts.definition: Degree of positiveness with which individuals regard the various parts of their body and the appearance of those parts. (from APA Dictionary of Psychology)

concepts.label: Trichophagia
concepts.title: Trichophagia
concepts.definition: Compulsive eating of hair.

concepts.label: Ambiguous Loss
concepts.title: Ambiguous Loss
concepts.definition: A type of grief or bereavement without closure. In one type of Ambiguous Loss, a person “is physically absent under unknown, uncertain or unresolved circumstances.” (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Overanxious Disorder
concepts.title: Overanxious Disorder
concepts.definition: In the DSM-III-R1, overanxious disorder is identified by symptoms including excessive worry regarding past and future events, concerns about competence, somatic complaints, self-consciousness, an excessive need for reassurance, and enduring tension lasting for a minimum of 6 months.

concepts.label: Physical Activity
concepts.title: Physical Activity
concepts.definition: Voluntary bodily movements involving skeletal muscles that lead to energy expenditure encompass a broad spectrum of activities. These range from simple everyday tasks such as walking to class or using stairs, to more organized and planned exercises and sports.

concepts.label: Femicide
concepts.title: Femicide
concepts.definition: The killing of females.

concepts.label: Grief Counseling
concepts.title: Grief Counseling
concepts.definition: Grief counseling the provision of advice, information, and psychological support to help individuals whose ability to function has been impaired by someone’s death, particularly that of a loved one or friend. It includes counseling for the grieving process and practical advice concerning arrangements for the funeral and burial of the loved one. Grief counseling is sometimes offered by staff in specialized agencies (e.g., hospices), or it may be carried out in the context of other counseling. (http[已隐藏本地路径]

concepts.label: Clown Therapy
concepts.title: Clown Therapy
concepts.definition: Healthcare provider use of clown or other comedic image or costumes to reduce patient anxiety or fear.

concepts.label: Slamsex
concepts.title: Slamsex
concepts.definition: Sexualized intravenous drug use.

concepts.label: Assessment of Medication Adherence
concepts.title: Assessment of Medication Adherence
concepts.definition: Various measurements of proper patient compliance in medication adherence. Adherence measurement includes self-reporting forms and monitoring systems and devices used for assessing medication adherence.

concepts.label: Active Breaks
concepts.title: Active Breaks
concepts.definition: Small breaks during a worker's or student's day aiming to minimize the negative impacts of a sedentary lifestyle, especially regarding the effects of excessive SCREEN TIME.

concepts.label: Pangenome
concepts.title: Pangenome
concepts.definition: The collection of common and unique genomes present in a given species. It combines the GENES of all sampled genomes to capture genetic variability in a species.

concepts.label: TDP-43-Mediated Neurodegeneration
concepts.title: TDP-43-Mediated Neurodegeneration
concepts.definition: A neurodegenerative disorder that causes symptoms of AMYOTROPHIC LATERAL SCLEROSIS and DEMENTIA. It is associated with mutations in the TDP-43 gene.

concepts.label: Accessory Genome
concepts.title: Accessory Genome
concepts.definition: The collection of GENES present in only one or a few strains of a given species.

concepts.label: Core Genome
concepts.title: Core Genome
concepts.definition: The collection of GENES present in all genomes of a given species.

concepts.label: Egoism
concepts.title: Egoism
concepts.definition: The ethical doctrine that morality has its foundations in self-interest. Also, excessive preoccupation with one's own well-being and interests.

concepts.label: Narrative Ethics
concepts.title: Narrative Ethics
concepts.definition: An approach to ethics that focuses on the particular and the personal in the life story of an individual. (Bioethics Thesaurus)

concepts.label: Food Habits
concepts.title: Food Habits
concepts.definition: Acquired or learned food preferences.

concepts.label: Hereditary Diseases
concepts.title: Hereditary Diseases
concepts.definition: Diseases caused by genetic mutations that are inherited from a parent's genome.

concepts.label: Hermaphroditism
concepts.title: Hermaphroditism
concepts.definition: An historical term for a variety of abnormalities in sex development that lead to anomalies in the reproductive tract and/or external genitalia.

concepts.label: Enterocele
concepts.title: Enterocele
concepts.definition: An intestinal HERNIA.

concepts.label: Hydrophid Venoms
concepts.title: Hydrophid Venoms
concepts.definition: Venoms of sea snakes (HYDROPHIIDAE) found around Pacific islands. The venoms contain fewer enzymes and more neuro- or myotoxins than land snakes. The neurotoxic proteins are similar to elapid small, short, or type I neurotoxins, some of which have been characterized.

concepts.label: Laryngeal Perichondritis
concepts.title: Laryngeal Perichondritis
concepts.definition: Inflammation of LARYNGEAL CARTILAGES, usually due to infections.

concepts.label: Amaurotic Familial Idiocy
concepts.title: Amaurotic Familial Idiocy
concepts.definition: An outdated term for Tay-Sachs disease.

concepts.label: C Fibers
concepts.title: C Fibers
concepts.definition: Type C fibers are peripheral unmyelinated nerve fibers in which several AXONS are surrounded by a single Schwann cell (SCHWANN CELLS). They constitute more than half of the peripheral sensory nerve fibers as well as all the postganglionic autonomic fibers.

concepts.label: A Fibers
concepts.title: A Fibers
concepts.definition: Type A fibers are the myelinated fibers ranging from 1-22 um in diameter with NEURAL CONDUCTION rates of 5-120 m/sec. They are the typical myelinated fibers of spinal nerves. Type A fibers are further subdivided into alpha, beta, gamma, and delta fibers.

concepts.label: Inhibition, Wedensky
concepts.title: Inhibition, Wedensky
concepts.definition: A continuous refractory state preventing repolarization that occurs when the nerve is being stimulated with high electrical frequencies and ends when the application of current stops.

concepts.label: Juvenile Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinosis
concepts.title: Juvenile Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinosis
concepts.definition: This type is caused by mutation in the CLN3 gene encoding a lysosomal integral membrane protein (Battenin).

concepts.label: Late-Infantile Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinosis
concepts.title: Late-Infantile Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinosis
concepts.definition: This type is caused by mutation in the CLN2 gene encoding tripeptidyl-peptidase I, a lysosomal serine protease.

concepts.label: Neurotransmitters
concepts.title: Neurotransmitters
concepts.definition: Endogenous signaling molecules secreted by neurons that alter the behavior of neurons or effector cells. Neurotransmitter is used here in its most general sense, including not only messengers that act directly to regulate ion channels, but also those that act through second messenger systems, and those that act at a distance from their site of release. Included are neuromodulators, neuroregulators, neuromediators, neurohormones, and neurohumors, whether or not acting at synapses.

concepts.label: Client-Centered Therapy
concepts.title: Client-Centered Therapy
concepts.definition: A procedure in which the therapist refrains from directing the client, with unconditional positive regard for the client, and communication of  accurate empathy.

concepts.label: Formication
concepts.title: Formication
concepts.definition: Subjective cutaneous sensations of insects in the absence of stimulation.

concepts.label: Right to Treatment
concepts.title: Right to Treatment
concepts.definition: In law, the claim of persons involuntarily institutionalized on the ground of mental disability to receive appropriate care for their conditions or diseases. (Bioethics Thesaurus)

concepts.label: Permeases
concepts.title: Permeases
concepts.definition: Any of a group of enzymes which mediate the phenomenon of active transport (McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 5th ed). Although proteins in this class are sometimes referred to as enzymes they have not been accepted as an enzyme class by the Enzyme Commission.

concepts.label: Polycyclic Hydrocarbons
concepts.title: Polycyclic Hydrocarbons
concepts.definition: Hydrocarbons consisting of two or more ring structures.

concepts.label: Polyneuritis
concepts.title: Polyneuritis
concepts.definition: Inflammation of multiple nerves.

concepts.label: Pongidae
concepts.title: Pongidae
concepts.definition: An obsolete name for a family of Primates consisting of three genera: Pongo (PONGO PYGMAEUS), Pan (PAN TROGLODYTES and PAN PANISCUS), and Gorilla (GORILLA GORILLA).

concepts.label: Premenstrual Tension
concepts.title: Premenstrual Tension
concepts.definition: A term used to describe the psychological aspects of PREMENSTRUAL SYNDROME, such as the indescribable tension, depression, hostility, and increased seizure activity in women with seizure disorder.

concepts.label: Pseudohermaphroditism
concepts.title: Pseudohermaphroditism
concepts.definition: An historical term for a variety of abnormalities in sex development that lead to anomalies in the reproductive tract and/or external genitalia.

concepts.label: Pupillary Functions, Abnormal
concepts.title: Pupillary Functions, Abnormal
concepts.definition: Conditions in which the pupil does not react normally to dilation and constriction. Signs of pupillary abnormalities originate from the pupil's shape, position, and response to stimulation.

concepts.label: Petechiae
concepts.title: Petechiae
concepts.definition: Pinhead size (3 mm) skin discolorization due to hemorrhage.

concepts.label: Questionnaires
concepts.title: Questionnaires
concepts.definition: Predetermined sets of questions used to collect data - clinical data, social status, occupational group, etc. The term is often applied to a self-completed survey instrument.

concepts.label: Receptors, Long-Acting Thyroid Stimulator
concepts.title: Receptors, Long-Acting Thyroid Stimulator
concepts.definition: Receptors on the thyroid cells that bind the LONG-ACTING THYROID STIMULATOR or LATS, the abnormal immunoglobulins that consist of various anti-TSH receptors and anti-thyroid antibodies.

concepts.label: Sleep Disorders
concepts.title: Sleep Disorders
concepts.definition: Conditions characterized by disturbances of usual sleep patterns or behaviors. SLEEP WAKE DISORDERS may be divided into three major categories: DYSSOMNIAS (i.e. disorders characterized by insomnia or hypersomnia), PARASOMNIAS (abnormal sleep behaviors), and SLEEP WAKE DISORDERS secondary to medical or psychiatric disorders. (From Thorpy, Sleep Disorders Medicine, 1994, p187)

concepts.label: Social Characteristics
concepts.title: Social Characteristics
concepts.definition: A trait or factor of an individual that is related to the way they socialize or present themselves to others.

concepts.label: Proxemics
concepts.title: Proxemics
concepts.definition: The study of the spatial requirements of humans and animals and the effects of POPULATION DENSITY on BEHAVIOR, COMMUNICATION, and SOCIAL INTERACTION. Proxemics is a subcategory of the study of nonverbal communication along with haptics (touch), KINESICS (body movement), vocalics (paralanguage), and chronemics (structure of time).

concepts.label: Specialties, Medical
concepts.title: Specialties, Medical
concepts.definition: Various branches of medical practice limited to specialized areas.

concepts.label: Serotonin Uptake Inhibitors
concepts.title: Serotonin Uptake Inhibitors
concepts.definition: Compounds that specifically inhibit the reuptake of serotonin in the brain.

concepts.label: Delirium, Dementia, Amnestic, Cognitive Disorders
concepts.title: Delirium, Dementia, Amnestic, Cognitive Disorders
concepts.definition: Cognitive disorders including delirium, dementia, and other cognitive disorders. These may be the result of substance use, trauma, or other causes.

concepts.label: Amino Acid Permeases
concepts.title: Amino Acid Permeases
concepts.definition: Amino acid transporters found in yeasts, plants and lower organisms. However, the distinction between the terms permease and transporter has not been consistently maintained in the literature.

concepts.label: Brain Diseases, Metabolic, Acquired
concepts.title: Brain Diseases, Metabolic, Acquired
concepts.definition: Brain dysfunction or damage caused by acquired (i.e., non-inborn) metabolic disorders. Associated conditions include ENDOCRINE DISEASES; WATER-ELECTROLYTE IMBALANCE; KIDNEY DISEASES; LIVER DISEASES; anoxia (HYPOXIA, BRAIN); nutritional disorders (see NUTRITIONAL AND METABOLIC DISEASES); an encephalopathy associated with HEMODIALYSIS; and other disorders. (From Plum & Posner, Diagnosis of Stupor and Coma, 3rd ed, pp208-260)

concepts.label: Infarction, Lacunar
concepts.title: Infarction, Lacunar
concepts.definition: Brain infarction that affects small subcortical vessels due to occlusion of a penetrating artery deep in the brain. It may lead to lacunar stroke.

concepts.label: Carotid Pseudoaneurysm
concepts.title: Carotid Pseudoaneurysm
concepts.definition: An acquired abnormality resulting from leaked blood from damaged CAROTID ARTERIES, often due to TRAUMA or INFECTION. The leaked blood is contained in the surrounding tissues and forms a pulsatile neck mass.

concepts.label: Binswanger Disease
concepts.title: Binswanger Disease
concepts.definition: A form of dementia characterized by brain lesions in the deep white-matter, also known as subcortical dementia.

concepts.label: Gaucher Disease, Type 1
concepts.title: Gaucher Disease, Type 1
concepts.definition: This type afflicts both children and adults who show no neurological effect. It is more prevalent in people of Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry.

concepts.label: Gaucher Disease, Type 2
concepts.title: Gaucher Disease, Type 2
concepts.definition: This type usually shows severe neurological effect in the first year of life.

concepts.label: Gaucher Disease, Type 3
concepts.title: Gaucher Disease, Type 3
concepts.definition: This type shows moderate to severe neurological effect in childhood.
aliases: Gaucher Disease, Juvenile and Adult, Cerebral

concepts.label: Hypnic Headache
concepts.title: Hypnic Headache
concepts.definition: A primary headache disorder which occurs exclusively during sleep and regularly awakes patients at a consistent time of night.

concepts.label: Aneurysm, Basilar Artery
concepts.title: Aneurysm, Basilar Artery
concepts.definition: Outpouching of BASILAR ARTERY at the base of the skull. The basilar artery is the most important artery in the posterior cerebral circulation.

concepts.label: Royer Syndrome
concepts.title: Royer Syndrome
concepts.definition: An association of DIABETES MELLITUS with Prader-Willi Syndrome.

concepts.label: Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 7
concepts.title: Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 7
concepts.definition: A group of dominantly inherited, predominatly late-onset, cerebellar ataxias which have been divided into multiple subtypes based on clinical features and genetic mapping. Progressive ataxia is a central feature of these conditions, and in certain subtypes POLYNEUROPATHY; DYSARTHRIA; visual loss; and other disorders may develop. (From Joynt, Clinical Neurology, 1997, Ch65, pp 12-17; J Neuropathol Exp Neurol 1998 Jun;57(6):531-43)
aliases: OPCA with Macular Degeneration and External Ophthalmoplegia

concepts.label: Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors
concepts.title: Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors
concepts.definition: A malignant neurilemmoma with nerve sheath differentiation. It is often associated with NEUROFIBROMATOSIS 1 and RHABDOMYOSARCOMA.

concepts.label: Scotoma, Arcuate
concepts.title: Scotoma, Arcuate
concepts.definition: A localized defect in the visual field bordered by an area of normal vision. This occurs with a variety of EYE DISEASES (e.g., RETINAL DISEASES and GLAUCOMA), OPTIC NERVE DISEASES, and other conditions.

concepts.label: Infantile Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinosis
concepts.title: Infantile Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinosis
concepts.definition: This type is caused by mutation in the gene (CLN1or PPT1) encoding palmitoyl-protein thioesterase (THIOLESTER HYDROLASES), an enzyme involved in catabolism of lipid-modified proteins.

concepts.label: Pseudocoma
concepts.title: Pseudocoma
concepts.definition: Feigned coma or psychogenic coma. These patients appear comatose (i.e., unresponsive, unarousable, or both) but have no structural lesion, metabolic or toxic disorder.

concepts.label: Cockayne Syndrome, Type I
concepts.title: Cockayne Syndrome, Type I
concepts.definition: Caused by mutations of gene CKN1.

concepts.label: Cockayne Syndrome, Type II
concepts.title: Cockayne Syndrome, Type II
concepts.definition: Caused by mutations of gene ERCC6.

concepts.label: Cockayne Syndrome, Type III
concepts.title: Cockayne Syndrome, Type III
concepts.definition: Type C is a rare form. Its genetic defect is not clear; appears to be a heterogeneous group. OMIM suggests that Type C should not be used anymore.

concepts.label: Dysgraphia
concepts.title: Dysgraphia
concepts.definition: Some authorities use this term interchangeably with Agraphia and some do not.

concepts.label: Transesophageal Electrophysiologic Study
concepts.title: Transesophageal Electrophysiologic Study
concepts.definition: Measurements of the electrical activities of specific areas of the heart, taken from inside the ESOPHAGUS.

concepts.label: Freedom of Information Act Requests
concepts.title: Freedom of Information Act Requests
concepts.definition: The Freedom of Information Act, passed in 1966, provides the public and industry a means of acquiring information about Federal Government activities.

concepts.label: Geophagia
concepts.title: Geophagia
concepts.definition: Compulsive eating of dirt.

concepts.label: Achromatopsia
concepts.title: Achromatopsia
concepts.definition: Severely deficient color perception, typically with monochromacy and reduced visual acuity. The atypical form can include normal visual acuity with pseudomonochromacy.

concepts.label: Myogenesis
concepts.title: Myogenesis
concepts.definition: The developmental sequence of events in the formation of adult muscle tissue, including fusion of myoblasts to form myotubes, the formation of MYOFIBRILS within their cytoplasm, and the establishment of functional neuromuscular junctions (NEUROMUSCULAR JUNCTION) with MOTOR NEURONS.

concepts.label: Neurohormones
concepts.title: Neurohormones
concepts.definition: Substances secreted by neurons into the blood, CNS, or intercellular space.

concepts.label: Toxinology
concepts.title: Toxinology
concepts.definition: The science concerned with the toxins produced by bacteria, plants, and animals.

concepts.label: Feedback, Biochemical
concepts.title: Feedback, Biochemical
concepts.definition: A mechanism of communication among life processes to coordinate development, reproduction, and homeostasis. In humans, feedback loops are especially important for communication between organs that are spatially separated. Virtually all hormones from the nervous and endocrine systems are under feedback control: by peripheral hormones, cations, metabolites, osmolarity or extracellular fluid volume.

concepts.label: Watson Syndrome
concepts.title: Watson Syndrome
concepts.definition: A syndrome characterized by the presence of PULMONARY STENOSIS; CAFE-AU-LAIT SPOTS; MENTAL RETARDATION; and short stature caused by mutations in the NF1 gene (GENES, NEUROFIBROMATOSIS 1).
aliases: Cafe au Lait Spots with Pulmonic Stenosis
Pulmonic Stenosis with Cafe au Lait Spots

concepts.label: Genes, WT1 Wilms Tumor
concepts.title: Genes, WT1 Wilms Tumor
concepts.definition: Tumor suppressor gene located in the 11p13 region on the short arm of human chromosome 11. The absence of this gene is associated with the formation of Wilms tumor. It encodes several isoforms that are zinc finger containing transcription factors involved in both transactivation and repression, and are critical for normal development and function of the urogenital tract.

concepts.label: Genes, WT2 Wilms Tumor
concepts.title: Genes, WT2 Wilms Tumor
concepts.definition: Genes located at on the short arm of chromosome 11, at band p15 whose absence is associated with the formation of Wilms tumor. This Wilms tumor locus is also associated with BECKWITH-WIEDEMANN SYNDROME.
aliases: Multiple Tumor Associated Chromosome Region 1 Genes

concepts.label: Craniosacral Massage
concepts.title: Craniosacral Massage
concepts.definition: Cerebrospinal fluid flow stimulation by massage of the head and spine. Developed by William Sutherland in the early 1900's.

concepts.label: Alternative Therapies
concepts.title: Alternative Therapies
concepts.definition: Therapies are termed as Alternative when used instead of conventional treatment.

concepts.label: Research Subject Selection
concepts.title: Research Subject Selection
concepts.definition: Criteria or standards used for the determination of the appropriateness of the inclusion of subjects in clinical trials and other research protocols.

concepts.label: Nonmaleficence
concepts.title: Nonmaleficence
concepts.definition: In ethics, the principle that requires avoiding the causation of harm.

concepts.label: Taoism
concepts.title: Taoism
concepts.definition: A Chinese philosophy and system of religion that is based on the teachings of Lao-tsu in the 6th century B.C. and on subsequent revelations. (from American Heritage College Dictionary, 4th ed)

concepts.label: Regulation
concepts.title: Regulation
concepts.definition: Exercise of the authority to restrict or supervise a practice or the conduct of a facility or organization. (AN: not to be used for gene regulation or any biological practices)

concepts.label: Natural Law
concepts.title: Natural Law
concepts.definition: Rules of conduct derived from nature and considered to be binding upon human society in the absence of, or in addition to, institutional law. (Bioethics Thesaurus)

concepts.label: Normality
concepts.title: Normality
concepts.definition: The state of conforming to a type, standard, or regular pattern. (Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, 10th ed)

concepts.label: Allelochemicals
concepts.title: Allelochemicals
concepts.definition: Chemical substances, excreted by an organism into the environment, that elicit behavioral or physiological responses from organisms of a different species . Perception of these chemical signals may be olfactory or by contact. Allelochemicals are subdivided into several groups depending on the response of the receiver and its adaptive effect to the emitter. They can be allomones, kairomones, or synomones.

concepts.label: Allomones
concepts.title: Allomones
concepts.definition: Allelochemicals in that the elicited response of the receiver is adaptively favorable to the emitter but not to the receiver. They are sometimes called repellents (INSECT REPELLENTS) or deterrents.

concepts.label: Kairomones
concepts.title: Kairomones
concepts.definition: Allelochemicals in that the elicited response of the receiver is adaptively favorable to the receiver but not to the emitter. They are sometimes called attractants.

concepts.label: Synomones
concepts.title: Synomones
concepts.definition: Allelochemicals in that the elicited response of the receiver is adaptively favorable to both emitter and receiver.

concepts.label: Rietveld Refinement
concepts.title: Rietveld Refinement
concepts.definition: A least squares analysis that minimizes the differences between the calculated and measured values by adjusting the parameters needed to describe the model. It is used for POWDER DIFFRACTION crystallography.

concepts.label: Accountability
concepts.title: Accountability
concepts.definition: Responsibility for explaining or justifying one's conduct to the public or to one's superiors. (Bioethics Thesaurus)

concepts.label: Basilar Papilla
concepts.title: Basilar Papilla
concepts.definition: The equivalent of the organ of Corti in non-mammalian tetrapods although its shape has evolved into a more extended structure in mammals.

concepts.label: Community Consent
concepts.title: Community Consent
concepts.definition: Consent by a population group or its representative as proxy. Examples include a tribe, a village, or a town or city council.

concepts.label: Depotentiation
concepts.title: Depotentiation
concepts.definition: Long-term depression resulting from repeated low-frequency stimulation in only the pathway receiving the induction protocol. It follows induction of LONG-TERM POTENTIATION and reverses it.

concepts.label: Acoustic Trauma
concepts.title: Acoustic Trauma
concepts.definition: Usually refer to hearing loss due to a single noise event such as an explosion or shotgun blast.

concepts.label: Future Generations
concepts.title: Future Generations
concepts.definition: Individuals not yet in existence to whom obligations may be owed.

concepts.label: Common Good
concepts.title: Common Good
concepts.definition: The good of a community.

concepts.label: Communitarianism
concepts.title: Communitarianism
concepts.definition: A movement in social thought that emphasizes the responsibilities of the individual within the larger community.

concepts.label: Vestibule of the Mouth
concepts.title: Vestibule of the Mouth
concepts.definition: Slitlike space in the ORAL CAVITY, bounded externally by the LIPS and CHEEK, and internally by the GINGIVA and TEETH.

concepts.label: Oral Cavity Proper
concepts.title: Oral Cavity Proper
concepts.definition: Part of the oral cavity bounded laterally and ventrally by the alveolar arches and their contained TEETH. Its roof is formed by the PALATE and it communicates posteriorly with the OROPHARYNX.

concepts.label: Consanguinous Mating
concepts.title: Consanguinous Mating
concepts.definition: REPRODUCTION between genetically related individuals.

concepts.label: Functional Gastrointestinal Disorders
concepts.title: Functional Gastrointestinal Disorders
concepts.definition: Chronic or recurrent gastrointestinal disorders without an identifiable structural or biochemical explanation by the routine diagnostic tests. Functional gastrointestinal disorders are classified according to the presumed site of the disorder, such as IRRITABLE BOWEL SYNDROME, non-ulcer DYSPEPSIA, and non-cardiac CHEST PAIN.

concepts.label: Colonic Inertia
concepts.title: Colonic Inertia
concepts.definition: Symptom characterized by the passage of stool once a week or less.

concepts.label: Dyschezia
concepts.title: Dyschezia
concepts.definition: Difficult defecation.

concepts.label: Medical Nutrition Therapy
concepts.title: Medical Nutrition Therapy
concepts.definition: A medically prescribed nutrition goal for patients, generally individualized. This approach is based on the coordinated efforts of physicians, dietitians, educators, and the patients. It includes patient assessment, specific nutrition requirements, patient education, and TREATMENT OUTCOME monitoring.

concepts.label: Parasuicide
concepts.title: Parasuicide
concepts.definition: A form of self-harm in which someone mimics the act of suicide without the intent to kill themselves.

concepts.label: Fasting Hypoglycemia
concepts.title: Fasting Hypoglycemia
concepts.definition: HYPOGLYCEMIA expressed in the postabsorptive state, after prolonged FASTING, or an overnight fast.

concepts.label: Postprandial Hypoglycemia
concepts.title: Postprandial Hypoglycemia
concepts.definition: HYPOGLYCEMIA expressed after a meal or FOOD INTAKE. It is also called reactive or stimulative hypoglycemia.

concepts.label: Insulin Shock
concepts.title: Insulin Shock
concepts.definition: Sudden significant drop in BLOOD GLUCOSE or hypoglycemic shock which affects the hemodynamic equilibrium of all vital organs.

concepts.label: Compensatory Hyperinsulinemia
concepts.title: Compensatory Hyperinsulinemia
concepts.definition: A GLUCOSE-induced HYPERINSULINEMIA, a marker of insulin-resistant state. It is a mechanism to compensate for reduced sensitivity to insulin.

concepts.label: Image Compression
concepts.title: Image Compression
concepts.definition: Using coding methods, such as calculating the changes in a signal intensity, to minimize a series of images from DIAGNOSTIC IMAGING.

concepts.label: Cardiovascular Physiological Processes
concepts.title: Cardiovascular Physiological Processes
concepts.definition: Biological actions and events that support the functions of the CARDIOVASCULAR SYSTEM.

concepts.label: Inotropism, Cardiac
concepts.title: Inotropism, Cardiac
concepts.definition: The quality of affecting MYOCARDIUM contractility, positively or negatively.

concepts.label: Vascular Endothelium-Dependent Relaxation
concepts.title: Vascular Endothelium-Dependent Relaxation
concepts.definition: VASODILATION that is mediated via the ENDOTHELIUM-DEPENDENT RELAXING FACTORS or their processes.

concepts.label: Gender
concepts.title: Gender
concepts.definition: Socially-constructed identity of male or female.

concepts.label: Inotropism
concepts.title: Inotropism
concepts.definition: The quality of affecting MUSCLE contractility, positively or negatively.

concepts.label: Transient Hypertension, Pregnancy
concepts.title: Transient Hypertension, Pregnancy
concepts.definition: HYPERTENSION that develops as a result of PREGNANCY and regresses post partum. It is hypertension without PROTEINURIA or pathological EDEMA.

concepts.label: CADASILM
concepts.title: CADASILM
concepts.definition: A subvariety of CADASIL characterized by the high frequency of MIGRAINE. The acronym stands for Cerebral Autosomal Dominant Arteriopathy with Subcortical Infarcts, Leukoencephalopathy, and Migraine.

concepts.label: Puerperium
concepts.title: Puerperium
concepts.definition: A period after PARTURITION, from the time of giving BIRTH to the complete involution of the UTERUS to its pre-pregnant state. Puerperium generally lasts about six to eight weeks.

concepts.label: Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus, Type I
concepts.title: Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus, Type I
concepts.definition: X-linked congenital nephrogenic diabetes insipidus disorders occurring mostly in males and associated with V2 RECEPTOR mutations.

concepts.label: Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus, Type II
concepts.title: Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus, Type II
concepts.definition: Congenital nephrogenic diabetes insipidus associated with mutations of AQUAPORIN-2.

concepts.label: Sodium Chloride-Dependent Neurotransmitter Symporters
concepts.title: Sodium Chloride-Dependent Neurotransmitter Symporters
concepts.definition: A subclass of plasma membrane neurotransmitter transport proteins that co-transports NEUROTRANSMITTERS with SODIUM CHLORIDE.

concepts.label: Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation, Repetitive
concepts.title: Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation, Repetitive
concepts.definition: Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation with a set of pulses that is experimentally being used as a therapy for DEPRESSION. Abbreviated as rTMS.

concepts.label: Antemortem Diagnosis
concepts.title: Antemortem Diagnosis
concepts.definition: Diagnosis of a disease or condition made before DEATH.

concepts.label: Postmortem Diagnosis
concepts.title: Postmortem Diagnosis
concepts.definition: Diagnosis of a disease or condition made after DEATH.

concepts.label: Triptans
concepts.title: Triptans
concepts.definition: Derivatives of TRYPTAMINES that are SEROTONIN RECEPTOR AGONISTS acting at 5-HT1 RECEPTORS. Some are used to treat MIGRAINE DISORDERS.

concepts.label: Hypoprebetalipoproteinemia
concepts.title: Hypoprebetalipoproteinemia
concepts.definition: A condition with abnormally low levels of PREBETA-LIPOPROTEINS in the blood.

concepts.label: Active Stretching
concepts.title: Active Stretching
concepts.definition: This is where one assumes a position and then holds it there with no assistance other than using the muscle strength.

concepts.label: Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation (PNF) Stretching
concepts.title: Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation (PNF) Stretching
concepts.definition: A form of flexibility and strengthening training, which involves targeting muscle groups in functional directions. It is designed to imitate natural proprioceptive input and muscle activation patterns to improve flexibility and range of motion. It combines muscle contraction and relaxation with passive and partner-assisted stretching.

concepts.label: Passive Stretching
concepts.title: Passive Stretching
concepts.definition: A technique in which one is relaxed and makes no contribution to the range of motion. Instead, an external force is used to achieve the stretching. A position is held by another body part or person, or an apparatus.

concepts.label: Static Stretching
concepts.title: Static Stretching
concepts.definition: This is when one stretches to the farthest point and holds the stretch.

concepts.label: Isometric Stretching
concepts.title: Isometric Stretching
concepts.definition: This is a type of static stretching which involves the resistance of muscle groups through ISOMETRIC CONTRACTION.

concepts.label: Dynamic Stretching
concepts.title: Dynamic Stretching
concepts.definition: This involves moving parts of the body and gradually increasing reach, speed of movement, or both. It is a gentle and controlled stretching to the limits of one's range of motion.

concepts.label: Ballistic Stretching
concepts.title: Ballistic Stretching
concepts.definition: This uses the momentum of a moving body or a limb in an attempt to force it beyond its normal range of motion.

concepts.label: Nervous System Physiological Processes
concepts.title: Nervous System Physiological Processes
concepts.definition: Biological actions and events that constitute the functions of the NERVOUS SYSTEM.

concepts.label: Nutrition Processes
concepts.title: Nutrition Processes
concepts.definition: Biological actions and events that constitute the steps by which living organisms take in and assimilate NUTRIENTS.

concepts.label: Nutrition Phenomena
concepts.title: Nutrition Phenomena
concepts.definition: Observable or measurable characteristics of nutrition.

concepts.label: Sudden Cardiac Arrest
concepts.title: Sudden Cardiac Arrest
concepts.definition: Sudden suspension of cardiac activity that is usually due to ARRHYTHMIA, in contrast to heart attack (MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION) which occurs due to blockage. The sudden suspension of cardiac activity generally requires RESUSCITATION.

concepts.label: Pilates-Based Exercises
concepts.title: Pilates-Based Exercises
concepts.definition: A form of exercise, based on the teachings of Joseph Pilates (1880-1967), redesigned for rehabilitation after musculoskeletal injuries. It focuses on body mechanics, posture, and strengthening of the core (back and abdominal) muscles.

concepts.label: Hominini
concepts.title: Hominini
concepts.definition: A tribe (taxon between family and genus) consisting of the line leading to HUMANS after its split from the other African ape lineages. This tribe includes all of the Homo species (HOMO SAPIENS; HOMO NEANDERTHALENSIS; H. ergaster; H. rudolfensis), all of the Australopithecines (Australopithicus africanus, A. boisei, etc.) and other ancient forms like Paranthropus and Ardipithecus.

concepts.label: Prenatal Programming
concepts.title: Prenatal Programming
concepts.definition: Permanent alteration of tissue structures and functions as a result of prenatal environment, either positive or negative.

concepts.label: Narcosis
concepts.title: Narcosis
concepts.definition: A state of depressed CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM marked by stupor or insensibility.

concepts.label: Osteoconduction
concepts.title: Osteoconduction
concepts.definition: A physiological phenomenon of BONE TRANSPLANTATION, whereby the new graft matrix configures a scaffold on which cells in the recipient form new bone.

concepts.label: Antinociceptive Agents
concepts.title: Antinociceptive Agents
concepts.definition: Compounds that show activity in animal models of human PAIN such as tail flick and hot plate assays.

concepts.label: Hematoma, Basal Ganglia
concepts.title: Hematoma, Basal Ganglia
concepts.definition: A collection of blood in BASAL GANGLIA.

concepts.label: Putaminal Hematoma
concepts.title: Putaminal Hematoma
concepts.definition: A collection of blood in PUTAMEN.

concepts.label: Angioma
concepts.title: Angioma
concepts.definition: A vascular anomaly due to proliferation of blood or lymphatic vessels that forms a tumor-like mass. Vessels in the angioma may or may not be dilated.

concepts.label: Angioma, Cavernous
concepts.title: Angioma, Cavernous
concepts.definition: A tumor-like mass with large vascular space that is filled with blood or lymph.

concepts.label: Fusiform Aneurysm
concepts.title: Fusiform Aneurysm
concepts.definition: Elongated, spindle-shaped dilation in the wall of blood vessels, usually large ARTERIES with ATHEROSCLEROSIS.

concepts.label: Third Generation H1 Antagonists
concepts.title: Third Generation H1 Antagonists
concepts.definition: Active enantiomers and selective derivatives of second generation H1 antagonists.

concepts.label: Phenomenography
concepts.title: Phenomenography
concepts.definition: Research approach designed to determine how people make sense of their experience. The research approach, developed within educational research, is a content-related approach investigating the different qualitative ways in which people develop an understanding of their environment.

concepts.label: Protein Interaction Domains
concepts.title: Protein Interaction Domains
concepts.definition: Recognition modules in proteins that mediate interactions between specific proteins involved in SIGNAL TRANSDUCTION PATHWAYS. They fold to form recognition pockets complementary to the short interaction sequence motifs on their LIGANDS.

concepts.label: Protein Interaction Motifs
concepts.title: Protein Interaction Motifs
concepts.definition: Short AMINO ACID SEQUENCES which are the BINDING SITES on the LIGANDS of protein interaction domains.

concepts.label: Microbiome
concepts.title: Microbiome
