concepts.definition: The full collection of microbes (bacteria, fungi, virus, etc.) that naturally exist within a particular biological niche as identified by the presence of their genomic sequence regardless of whether or not they can be cultured.

concepts.label: Human Microbiome
concepts.title: Human Microbiome
concepts.definition: The full collection of microbes (bacteria, fungi, virus, etc.) that naturally exist within the human body as identified by their genomic sequence regardless of whether or not they can be cultured.

concepts.label: Clinically Isolated Syndrome, CNS Demyelinating
concepts.title: Clinically Isolated Syndrome, CNS Demyelinating
concepts.definition: The first region-restricted episode of CNS inflammatory demyelination in a patient. It is usually characterized by an acute monosymptomatic presentation of the optic nerves, brainstem, or spinal cord. It may not reoccur (isolated), or it may progress to MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS.

concepts.label: Medication Persistence
concepts.title: Medication Persistence
concepts.definition: The duration of time from initiation to discontinuation of drug therapy.

concepts.label: Cicatrization
concepts.title: Cicatrization
concepts.definition: The formation of fibrous tissue in the place of normal tissue during the process of WOUND HEALING. It includes scar tissue formation occurring in healing internal organs as well as in the skin after surface injuries.

concepts.label: External Nose
concepts.title: External Nose
concepts.definition: Its major components are NASAL BONES; NASAL CARTILAGES; and NASAL SEPTUM.

concepts.label: Retinal Rod Cell
concepts.title: Retinal Rod Cell
concepts.definition: Each rod cell contains highly differentiated compartments: include the outer segment (ROD OUTER SEGMENT), inner segment, connecting cilium, cell body, and synaptic terminal.

concepts.label: Type 1 Cystatins
concepts.title: Type 1 Cystatins
concepts.definition: Cystatins that occur primarily as intracellular proteins.

concepts.label: Type 2 Cystatins
concepts.title: Type 2 Cystatins
concepts.definition: Cystatins that occur primarily as extracellular proteins.

concepts.label: Type 3 Cystatins
concepts.title: Type 3 Cystatins
concepts.definition: Cystatins that occur as plasma proteins.

concepts.label: Excitatory Postsynaptic Currents
concepts.title: Excitatory Postsynaptic Currents
concepts.definition: The flow of ions into or out of cells that cause EXCITATORY POSTSYNAPTIC POTENTIALS.

concepts.label: End Plate Potentials
concepts.title: End Plate Potentials
concepts.definition: Excitatory postsynaptic potentials at the NEUROMUSCULAR JUNCTION.

concepts.label: Miniature End Plate Potentials
concepts.title: Miniature End Plate Potentials
concepts.definition: A subthreshold depolarizing postsynaptic potential generated at the NEUROMUSCULAR JUNCTION from a spontaneous release of neurotransmitters.

concepts.label: Inhibitory Postsynaptic Currents
concepts.title: Inhibitory Postsynaptic Currents
concepts.definition: The flow of ions into or out of cells that cause INHIBITORY POSTSYNAPTIC POTENTIALS.

concepts.label: Postsynaptic Potentials
concepts.title: Postsynaptic Potentials
concepts.definition: The membrane potentials across the SYNAPTIC MEMBRANES of the target cells of the NEUROTRANSMISSION pathway.

concepts.label: Postsynaptic Current
concepts.title: Postsynaptic Current
concepts.definition: The ion flow that effects the POSTSYNAPTIC POTENTIAL.

concepts.label: Sandplay Therapy
concepts.title: Sandplay Therapy
concepts.definition: A therapeutic method involving the use of sandtray or sandbox, and the nonverbal imageries created by sandplay.

concepts.label: Physicochemical Phenomena
concepts.title: Physicochemical Phenomena
concepts.definition: The physical phenomena and properties underlying the structure of atoms and molecules, and their reaction and interaction processes.

concepts.label: Global Positioning Systems
concepts.title: Global Positioning Systems
concepts.definition: Satellite-based systems providing worldwide continuous position, velocity, time, and related data.

concepts.label: Light Signal Transduction, Visual
concepts.title: Light Signal Transduction, Visual
concepts.definition: The transducing of light energy to afferent nerve impulses in the retinal rods and cones. After light photons are absorbed by the visual photopigments, the signal is transmitted to the outer segment membrane by the cyclic GMP second messenger system, where it closes the sodium channels. This channel gating ultimately generates an action potential in the inner retina.

concepts.label: Depression, Involutional
concepts.title: Depression, Involutional
concepts.definition: Form of depression in those MIDDLE AGE with feelings of ANXIETY.

concepts.label: Psychosis, Involutional
concepts.title: Psychosis, Involutional
concepts.definition: Severe mental disorder with onset in MIDDLE AGE, marked by withdrawal, abnormal affect, disturbed intellectual processes, and there may be regression.

concepts.label: Delusional Disorder
concepts.title: Delusional Disorder
concepts.definition: Disorder with presentation of a facade of coldness with characteristic pervasive mistrust and suspiciousness of others.

concepts.label: Hippotherapy
concepts.title: Hippotherapy
concepts.definition: A treatment strategy that uses the movement of the horse as a treatment tool for the rider who has physical, developmental or other limitations (e.g., cerebral palsy). Typically, a hippotherapy session involves a team of a health professional (e.g., occupational therapist), a horse handler, and the rider. The rhythm of the horse's movement is thought to challenge and influence the rider in improving balance, muscle symmetry, gross motor functions, etc.

concepts.label: Brainwave Biofeedback
concepts.title: Brainwave Biofeedback
concepts.definition: A biofeedback during which a continuous brain wave pattern is shared with the person in order to increase the percentage of a certain type of brain wave, such as ALPHA RHYTHM, which is associated with a state of relaxation.

concepts.label: Diffusion Tractography
concepts.title: Diffusion Tractography
concepts.definition: The tracing of neural or muscle fibers by diffusion tensor imaging.

concepts.label: Saccular Aneurysm
concepts.title: Saccular Aneurysm
concepts.definition: Localized distended sac affecting only part of the wall of blood vessels.

concepts.label: Position Frequency Matrices
concepts.title: Position Frequency Matrices
concepts.definition: The tabular notation of the count per position of each potential residue as observed from an aligned set of sequences.

concepts.label: Sequence Logo
concepts.title: Sequence Logo
concepts.definition: A graph of the data from a position weight matrix using the letters of the residues drawn in a size that corresponds to their likelihood in the sequence. It is an alternative representation of the CONSENSUS SEQUENCE, including more information, specifically, the information about the less frequently occurring residues as well as the most frequently occurring residues.

concepts.label: CA4 Region, Hippocampal
concepts.title: CA4 Region, Hippocampal
concepts.definition: A subsection of the hippocampal formation, described by Lorente de No, that composes the hilus of the DENTATE GYRUS.

concepts.label: CA1 Pyramidal Cell Area
concepts.title: CA1 Pyramidal Cell Area
concepts.definition: The pyramidal cell layer (stratum pyramidale) of the HIPPOCAMPUS CA1 FIELD.

concepts.label: CA3 Pyramidal Cell Area
concepts.title: CA3 Pyramidal Cell Area
concepts.definition: The pyramidal cell layer (stratum pyramidale) of the hippocampus CA3 field.

concepts.label: CA2 Pyramidal Cell Area
concepts.title: CA2 Pyramidal Cell Area
concepts.definition: The pyramidal cell layer (stratum pyramidale) of the HIPPOCAMPUS CA2 FIELD.

concepts.label: Spectroscopy
concepts.title: Spectroscopy
concepts.definition: The study of electromagnetic spectra arising from either emission or absorption of radiant energy by various substances. (from McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 6th ed)

concepts.label: Spectrometry
concepts.title: Spectrometry
concepts.definition: The use of spectrographic techniques for deriving the physical constants of materials. (McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 6th ed)

concepts.label: Embryonic Structures, Mammalian
concepts.title: Embryonic Structures, Mammalian
concepts.definition: The anatomical parts that make up a mammalian organism in the early stages of development.

concepts.label: Metazoa
concepts.title: Metazoa
concepts.definition: A division of multicellular organisms that was a subkingdom under Animalia in the old five kingdom paradigm.

concepts.label: Steatohepatitis
concepts.title: Steatohepatitis
concepts.definition: Inflammation of the liver related to lipid accumulation in fatty liver.

concepts.label: Protein Misfolding Disorders
concepts.title: Protein Misfolding Disorders
concepts.definition: Disorders caused by dysfunctions in PROTEIN FOLDING and degradation or clearance of misfolded proteins.

concepts.label: Exposure Therapy
concepts.title: Exposure Therapy
concepts.definition: A method for treatment of anxiety disorders using repeated presentations of a specific stimulus to habituate the subject, and extinguish normal innate and acquired fear.

concepts.label: Assertive Community Treatment
concepts.title: Assertive Community Treatment
concepts.definition: Team treatment model designed to provide community-based and supportive psychiatric services.

concepts.label: Pedagogy
concepts.title: Pedagogy
concepts.definition: The art or science of TEACHING.

concepts.label: Medical Home
concepts.title: Medical Home
concepts.definition: Ongoing integrated provision of care and services focused on the needs of the individual including preventive, ambulatory, and acute hospital-based.

concepts.label: Mobile Health
concepts.title: Mobile Health
concepts.definition: Health services supported by remote or mobile devices.

concepts.label: Years of Potential Life Lost
concepts.title: Years of Potential Life Lost
concepts.definition: Estimation of the average time a person lost due to premature death.

concepts.label: Offenders
concepts.title: Offenders
concepts.definition: Persons who have committed a crime but have not yet been convicted of the offense.

concepts.label: Text Mining
concepts.title: Text Mining
concepts.definition: Use of sophisticated tools to parse, organize, and examine textual information.

concepts.label: Stroop Effect
concepts.title: Stroop Effect
concepts.definition: Response showing selective inattention to complex stimuli.

concepts.label: Stroop Paradigm
concepts.title: Stroop Paradigm
concepts.definition: The automatic nature of accessing word meaning.

concepts.label: Inappropriate Prescriptions
concepts.title: Inappropriate Prescriptions
concepts.definition: Medications administered in a manner that poses more risk than benefit, particularly where safer alternatives exist.

concepts.label: Bodywork
concepts.title: Bodywork
concepts.definition: Approaches that emphasize manipulation and realignment of the body's structure in order to improve function as well as mental outlook.

concepts.label: Ethnopsychiatry
concepts.title: Ethnopsychiatry
concepts.definition: Comparative PSYCHIATRY of different ethnic and cultural groups

concepts.label: Okihiro Syndrome
concepts.title: Okihiro Syndrome
concepts.definition: A syndrome consisting of Duane's syndrome, radial ray anomaly, and frequently, HEARING LOSS, SENSORINEURAL.
aliases: Duane Anomaly with Radial Abnormalities and Deafness

concepts.label: Alpha-Sarcoglycanopathies
concepts.title: Alpha-Sarcoglycanopathies
concepts.definition: Limb girdle muscular dystrophies due to mutations in the gene for the ALPHA-SARCOGLYCAN or deficiencies in alpha-sarcoglycan due to a mutation in another gene (secondary alpha-sarcoglycanopathy).
aliases: Duchenne Like Autosomal Recessive Muscular Dystrophy, Type 2
Duchenne-Like Autosomal Recessive Muscular Dystrophy, Type 2
Muscular Dystrophy Limb Girdle with Alpha Sarcoglycan Deficiency
Muscular Dystrophy Limb-Girdle with Alpha-Sarcoglycan Deficiency

concepts.label: Cingulate Cortex
concepts.title: Cingulate Cortex
concepts.definition: The GRAY MATTER of the cingulate gyrus, possessing multiple intracortical and subcortical connections, and involved in motor control and decision making.

concepts.label: Community Composition, Ecological
concepts.title: Community Composition, Ecological
concepts.definition: The distribution and abundance of taxa in a biological or ecological community.

concepts.label: Community Structure, Ecological
concepts.title: Community Structure, Ecological
concepts.definition: A technical term that describes the organization of a biological community with respect to ecological interactions. These interactions include competition, mutualism, predation, and commensalism.

concepts.label: Memory, Remote
concepts.title: Memory, Remote
concepts.definition: Information learned before age 12 and less subject to disruption than intermediate memory.

concepts.label: Intersexuality
concepts.title: Intersexuality
concepts.definition: An historical term for a variety of abnormalities in sex development that lead to anomalies in the reproductive tract and/or external genitalia.

concepts.label: Intersex Conditions
concepts.title: Intersex Conditions
concepts.definition: An historical term for a variety of abnormalities in sex development that lead to anomalies in the reproductive tract and/or external genitalia.

concepts.label: Cerebral Ventriculomegaly
concepts.title: Cerebral Ventriculomegaly
concepts.definition: Enlargement of CEREBRAL VENTRICLES. Although it is often isolated without other CNS anomalies it can be associated with other congenital malformations (e.g., ARNOLD-CHIARI MALFORMATION; DANDY-WALKER MALFORMATION, and ACROCALLOSAL SYNDROME).

concepts.label: Combat Stress Disorders
concepts.title: Combat Stress Disorders
concepts.definition: Reactions to fierce combat or operations other than war, which may be both physical and psychological.

concepts.label: Body-Mind Relations
concepts.title: Body-Mind Relations
concepts.definition: Interaction of human feelings and thoughts with physical existence.

concepts.label: Health Information Technology
concepts.title: Health Information Technology
concepts.definition: Comprehensive, knowledge-based system capable of providing information to those who need it to make sound decisions about health.

concepts.label: Self-Evaluation
concepts.title: Self-Evaluation
concepts.definition: Process by individual in valuation of specific traits, qualities, or abilities related to the individual.

concepts.label: Self-Appraisal
concepts.title: Self-Appraisal
concepts.definition: Process by individual in characterizing specific traits, qualities, or abilities.

concepts.label: Intelligent Design
concepts.title: Intelligent Design
concepts.definition: Assertion that the presence of complex life on earth is best explained by the creative actions of an intelligent designer, not the chance consequences of random mutation and differential survival that natural selection proposes.

concepts.label: Group Thinking
concepts.title: Group Thinking
concepts.definition: A faulty dynamic with a group that may lead to poor conclusions and beliefs.

concepts.label: Shell Shock
concepts.title: Shell Shock
concepts.definition: Used in World War I to designate a wide variety of MENTAL DISORDERS presumably due to combat experience. from Americanl Psychiatric Glossary, 7th ed.

concepts.label: Reflex, Dento-Cardiac
concepts.title: Reflex, Dento-Cardiac
concepts.definition: Trigeminocardiac reflex variant seen during TOOTH EXTRACTION procedures.

concepts.label: Noradrenergic Neurons
concepts.title: Noradrenergic Neurons
concepts.definition: Neurons whose primary neurotransmitter is NOREPINEPHRINE.

concepts.label: Widespread Chronic Pain
concepts.title: Widespread Chronic Pain
concepts.definition: A form of chronic pain that tends to be non-localized and wide-reaching.

concepts.label: Vascular Medicine
concepts.title: Vascular Medicine
concepts.definition: The study, diagnosis, and treatment of diseases of the blood vessels (VASCULAR DISEASES) and vessels of lymphatic system (LYMPHATIC DISEASES).

concepts.label: Developmental Dyscalculia
concepts.title: Developmental Dyscalculia
concepts.definition: A disorder characterized by impaired ability to comprehend numerical representation and rules, recall numerical facts, and perform arithmetic and related operations due to innate neurological lesion in areas of the brain that are important in numerical processing.

concepts.label: Acquired Dyscalculia
concepts.title: Acquired Dyscalculia
concepts.definition: Impairment in mathematical abilities secondary to a damage to a specific region of the brain often caused by a stroke, tumor, or trauma.

concepts.label: TNM Staging
concepts.title: TNM Staging
concepts.definition: Classification of neoplasm according to the characteristics of the tumor (T), such as size; the degree of involvement of the lymph nodes (N); and the amount of detectable metastasis (M).

concepts.label: Partin Tables
concepts.title: Partin Tables
concepts.definition: Nomograms used for predicting the stages of PROSTATE CANCER. They are comprised of the serum PROSTATE-SPECIFIC ANTIGEN levels, the GLEASON SCORE, and the TNM STAGING category.

concepts.label: Gleason Grading
concepts.title: Gleason Grading
concepts.definition: System of grading PROSTATE CANCER based on the degree of abnormality of the glandular archtecture of the tumor.

concepts.label: Adenoma Sebaceum
concepts.title: Adenoma Sebaceum
concepts.definition: Facial ANGIOFIBROMA in tuberous sclerosis

concepts.label: Hypervigilance
concepts.title: Hypervigilance
concepts.definition: Condition of elevated sensory sensitivity, perception of risk of threats, and low threshold for stimuli.

concepts.label: Memory, Prospective
concepts.title: Memory, Prospective
concepts.definition: Dissociable form of episodic memory involving the ability to execute a future intention. (Campbell's Psychiatric Dictionary, 9th ed.)

concepts.label: Patient Elopement
concepts.title: Patient Elopement
concepts.definition: Termination of hospitalization by PATIENTS against advice of healthcare provider and unknown to the provider or institution.

concepts.label: Absolute Risk Reduction
concepts.title: Absolute Risk Reduction
concepts.definition: The difference in rates of bad outcomes between experimental and control participants in a trial.

concepts.label: Nicotine Patch
concepts.title: Nicotine Patch
concepts.definition: A device for administering NICOTINE by facilitating its absorption through the skin (SKIN ABSORPTION).

concepts.label: Nicotine Replacement Products
concepts.title: Nicotine Replacement Products
concepts.definition: DOSAGE FORMS of NICOTINE designed to deliver nicotine to the body as alternatives to using TOBACCO.

concepts.label: Smoking Cessation Products
concepts.title: Smoking Cessation Products
concepts.definition: Non-medical products used to aid in ending a SMOKING habit.

concepts.label: Body Schema
concepts.title: Body Schema
concepts.definition: Individual's non-conscious representation of their bodies that regulates posture and movement.

concepts.label: Visual Impairment
concepts.title: Visual Impairment
concepts.definition: Limitation in visual functions.

concepts.label: Databases, Molecular
concepts.title: Databases, Molecular
concepts.definition: Databases devoted to knowledge about specific molecules.

concepts.label: Spatial Autocorrelation
concepts.title: Spatial Autocorrelation
concepts.definition: The degree of interdependence among data arranged on a three-dimensional grid. (McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 6th ed)

concepts.label: Kriging
concepts.title: Kriging
concepts.definition: A weighted, moving-average estimation technique based on geostatistics that uses the spatial correlation of point measurements to estimate values at adjacent, unmeasured points. htt[已隐藏本地路径] (Oct. 18,2011)

concepts.label: Dasymetric Mapping
concepts.title: Dasymetric Mapping
concepts.definition: Depiction of quantitative areal data using boundaries that divide the area into zones of relative data homogeneity to portray the data distribution.

concepts.label: Choropleth Mapping
concepts.title: Choropleth Mapping
concepts.definition: A method of mapping to display quantitative information in defined jurisdictions such as countries, states, or counties.

concepts.label: Informal care
concepts.title: Informal care
concepts.definition: Care rendered by non-professionals.

concepts.label: Rehabilitation of Hearing Impaired
concepts.title: Rehabilitation of Hearing Impaired
concepts.definition: Procedures for restoring hearing impairment.

concepts.label: Self-Criticism
concepts.title: Self-Criticism
concepts.definition: Critical or analytical evaluation of self.

concepts.label: Drug Use Error
concepts.title: Drug Use Error
concepts.definition: Inappropriate use of drugs or medication due to unavailable or misleading information.

concepts.label: Georeferencing
concepts.title: Georeferencing
concepts.definition: Defining location using map coordinates.

concepts.label: Space-Time Geography
concepts.title: Space-Time Geography
concepts.definition: The study of spatial location of entities over time.

concepts.label: Geocoding
concepts.title: Geocoding
concepts.definition: Determining and assigning the geographic coordinates of a location.

concepts.label: Transsexual Persons
concepts.title: Transsexual Persons
concepts.definition: Those individuals with gender dysphoria and with a persistent desire to undergo GENDER-AFFIRMING PROCEDURES.

concepts.label: Connectomics
concepts.title: Connectomics
concepts.definition: A field of NEUROSCIENCE which deals with the physical mapping of neural circuits that collect, process, and archive information, in the nervous system. Such maps could ultimately shed light on the early development of the human brain and on diseases such as AUTISM and SCHIZOPHRENIA, linked to faulty neural connections.

concepts.label: Human Connectome Project
concepts.title: Human Connectome Project
concepts.definition: A concerted research effort financed by the National Institutes of Health to map and create a database of neural connections of the human brain.

concepts.label: Human Connectome
concepts.title: Human Connectome
concepts.definition: Connectome of human nervous systems.

concepts.label: Central Pattern Generator Neurons
concepts.title: Central Pattern Generator Neurons
concepts.definition: The nerve cells in a network that controls the firing patterns (timing, phasing, and intensity) of MOTOR NEURONS resulting in a coordinated activation of muscle cells that produces rhythmic movements such as MASTICATION; LOCOMOTION; RESPIRATION; and PERISTALSIS.

concepts.label: Racial Segregation
concepts.title: Racial Segregation
concepts.definition: Barriers based on ethnicity or other group group membership.

concepts.label: Mechanobiological Phenomena
concepts.title: Mechanobiological Phenomena
concepts.definition: The mechanisms and processes by which mechanical forces elicit molecular response and regulate cell form and function.

concepts.label: Interferential Current Electrotherapy
concepts.title: Interferential Current Electrotherapy
concepts.definition: A type of electric stimulation therapy using a current produced by mixing two slightly out-of-phase medium frequency currents.

concepts.label: Same-Sex Marriage
concepts.title: Same-Sex Marriage
concepts.definition: The social institution involving legal and/or religious sanction whereby individuals of the same gender are joined together.

concepts.label: Muller Cells
concepts.title: Muller Cells
concepts.definition: The principal macroglial cells of the RETINA with polygonal cell body shape and having processes that span the full thickness of the retina and contact VITREOUS BODY and the sub-retinal space.

concepts.label: Tanycytes
concepts.title: Tanycytes
concepts.definition: Specialized ependymal cell that has elongated cell body and processes to the outer surface of the CNS and HYPOTHALAMUS. Found principally in the THIRD VENTRICLE.

concepts.label: Muscle Tenderness
concepts.title: Muscle Tenderness
concepts.definition: Painful sensation felt when pressure is applied to the muscles.

concepts.label: Anosognosia
concepts.title: Anosognosia
concepts.definition: A condition in which a person who suffers illness or disability seems unaware of or denies the existence of the illness or disability.

concepts.label: Mechanobiology
concepts.title: Mechanobiology
concepts.definition: The study of mechanisms and processes by which mechanical forces elicit molecular response and regulate cell form and function.

concepts.label: Hopefulness
concepts.title: Hopefulness
concepts.definition: Feeling of optimism or expectation for a desired outcome.

concepts.label: Allocative Efficiency
concepts.title: Allocative Efficiency
concepts.definition: Optimal distribution of goods and services.

concepts.label: Primary Motor Cortex
concepts.title: Primary Motor Cortex
concepts.definition: A thin band of cells on the posterior portion of the precentral gyrus. It forms a parallel band just anterior to primary motor cortex, and the supplementary motor area occupies the central portion of the premotor cortex, along the midline surface of both hemispheres.

concepts.label: Alliesthesia
concepts.title: Alliesthesia
concepts.definition: The dependence of feelings of pleasure or displeasure upon exposure to an external stimulus, based on the interior state of the organism.

concepts.label: Delayed Gratification
concepts.title: Delayed Gratification
concepts.definition: The ability to resist the temptation for an immediate reward and wait for a later reward.

concepts.label: Acoustic Startle Reflex
concepts.title: Acoustic Startle Reflex
concepts.definition: Startle reaction elicited by a sudden, unexpected auditory stimulus.

concepts.label: Reflex, Moro
concepts.title: Reflex, Moro
concepts.definition: A reflex found in normal infants, observed when the infant is startled or feels the sensation of falling and characterized by sudden extension of the arms. It is only seen in children and adults suffering from disorders of the CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM, and is distinct from the startle reflex found in normal children and adults.

concepts.label: P50 Evoked Potentials
concepts.title: P50 Evoked Potentials
concepts.definition: A positive waveform component of the electrical response recorded approximately 50 milliseconds after a stimulus.

concepts.label: N100 Evoked Potentials
concepts.title: N100 Evoked Potentials
concepts.definition: A negative waveform component of the electrical response that peaks approximately 90-200 milliseconds after a stimulus.

concepts.label: P200 Evoked Potentials
concepts.title: P200 Evoked Potentials
concepts.definition: A positive waveform component of the electrical response peaking approximately 100-250 milliseconds after a stimulus.

concepts.label: N200 Evoked Potentials
concepts.title: N200 Evoked Potentials
concepts.definition: A negative waveform component of the electrical response that peaks approximately 200 milliseconds after a stimulus.

concepts.label: N400 Evoked Potentials
concepts.title: N400 Evoked Potentials
concepts.definition: A negative waveform component of the electrical response that peaks approximately 300-600 milliseconds after a stimulus.

concepts.label: Allocortex
concepts.title: Allocortex
concepts.definition: Type of cerebral cortex which does not pass through a perinatal phase of six-layered structure as in the NEOCORTEX and develops into three or four layers in the mature brain. Allocortex has three subareas: archi- paleo- and periallo-cortex.

concepts.label: Social Competence
concepts.title: Social Competence
concepts.definition: Possessing the social, emotional, and intellectual skills and behaviors needed to succeed as a member of society.

concepts.label: Allochiria
concepts.title: Allochiria
concepts.definition: A condition in which a person experiences a given stimulus, usually tactile but more rarely other sensory modalities, on the corresponding opposite side of the body from the side of the stimulation.

concepts.label: Subventricular Zone
concepts.title: Subventricular Zone
concepts.definition: Specialized region of the anterior wall of the lateral ventricle which is rich in NEURAL STEM CELLS.

concepts.label: CA3 Stratum Lucidum
concepts.title: CA3 Stratum Lucidum
concepts.definition: Mossy fiber axon layer of the hippocampus CA3 field.

concepts.label: Families of Veterans
concepts.title: Families of Veterans
concepts.definition: Families in which a member of the household served in the active military or reserve and was discharged or released.

concepts.label: Dyschiria
concepts.title: Dyschiria
concepts.definition: A condition in which a person is unable to tell which side of the body has been touched.

concepts.label: Physiome
concepts.title: Physiome
concepts.definition: The quantitative and integrated description of the functional behavior of the physiological state of an individual or species.

concepts.label: Allotriophagy
concepts.title: Allotriophagy
concepts.definition: An unusual desire or craving for abnormal foods.

claims.subject: con_e5fde2e10d9d48d8
claims.statement: 丘脑皮层节律失常（Thalamocortical Dysrhythmia, TCD）是一种理论框架，用于解释神经系统疾病（如帕金森病、神经性疼痛、耳鸣、癫痫）及神经精神疾病（如抑郁症、精神分裂症、强迫症等）引发的阳性和阴性症状。其核心机制为：丘脑水平兴奋性输入减弱或抑制性输入增强，导致丘脑皮层神经元从紧张性发放（tonic firing）转换为爆发性发放（burst firing），进而以约5Hz的病理振荡夹带丘脑和皮层区域；在功率谱上表现为θ波段（theta band）相干性和双相干性增高，提示皮层与丘脑在病理性θ节律产生中存在紧密耦合。该理论得到脑磁图（MEG）、脑电图（EEG）及手术中局部场电位（LFP）记录的支持。

claims.statement: 脂毒性（lipotoxicity）是一种代谢综合征，由脂质中间产物在非脂肪组织中累积引起，导致细胞功能障碍和死亡。正常细胞中脂质产生与氧化/运输处于平衡；脂毒性状态下，脂肪酸进入细胞后转化为二酰甘油、神经酰胺、脂肪酰辅酶A等脂质中间产物，而非中性无害的三酰甘油，这些中间产物损害细胞功能。当脂肪细胞储存能力超负荷，脂质溢出至无充足储存空间的非脂肪组织，超出其储存容量后即引发细胞功能障碍和/或死亡。脂毒性被认为与心力衰竭、肥胖和糖尿病有关。
